Long-WAM: Scaling the Context of World-Action Models VLA

world-action model autoregressive pretraining long-horizon manipulation real-time control vision-language-action

简要说明：Long-WAM 扩展了因果世界-动作模型的视觉历史上下文，以满足实时机器人控制的需求，证明在机器人视频上进行自回归预训练能利用更长的历史提升性能，并在基准测试和真实机器人上取得了优异结果。

TLDR: Long-WAM scales the visual history context of causal world-action models for real-time robot control, demonstrating that autoregressive pretraining on robot videos unlocks performance gains from longer history, and achieves strong results on both benchmarks and real robots.

Abstract: Real-time robot control demands enough visual history to infer motion and task progress, but processing that history can delay action. We present Long-WAM, a model-system framework for scaling the context of causal world-action models under real-time control constraints. Our central finding is that access to history is not the same as using it: longer histories pay off far more when the video foundation is pretrained autoregressively (AR). We first learn causal prediction from robot and egocentric videos without action labels, then preserve this history-to-future structure during world-action adaptation. On RoboCasa GR-1, increasing context from 0.0 to 19.2 seconds raises success from 63.3% to 78.7%, whereas a bidirectionally pretrained initialization shows no net gain; robot-domain AR pretraining further raises peak success on GR-1 and LIBERO-Long. Long-WAM also achieves the best results among compared methods on LIBERO-Long, RoboTwin 2.0, and DOMINO. Streaming observation encoding, asynchronous execution, and hardware-specific acceleration enable deployment on RTX 5090, DGX Spark, and Jetson AGX Thor without dropping future prediction; on RTX 5090, each action chunk, including future-video latent prediction, takes 107.4 ms. Real-time deployment on Unitree G1 and YAM supports dynamic and long-horizon manipulation, including 95% success on dynamic cup stacking, where Pi0.5 and Fast-WAM succeed in none of 20 trials. As a memory-informed executor, Long-WAM also complements higher-level planning in composite tasks.

摘要（中文）：实时机器人控制需要足够的视觉历史信息来推断运动状态与任务进度，但处理这些历史信息可能会延迟动作执行。我们提出Long-WAM，一种在实时控制约束下扩展因果世界-动作模型上下文的模型-系统框架。我们的核心发现是：能够访问历史信息并不等同于有效利用历史信息——当视频基础模型采用自回归（AR）方式进行预训练时，更长的历史信息所带来的收益显著更大。我们首先在不使用动作标签的情况下，从机器人和第一人称视角视频中学习因果预测，然后在世界-动作适配过程中保留这种从历史到未来的结构。在RoboCasa GR-1上，将上下文长度从0.0秒增加到19.2秒，成功率从63.3%提升至78.7%，而双向预训练初始化则没有表现出净收益；机器人领域的AR预训练进一步提升了GR-1和LIBERO-Long上的峰值成功率。Long-WAM在LIBERO-Long、RoboTwin 2.0和DOMINO上相较于对比方法也取得了最优结果。流式观测编码、异步执行和硬件特定加速使其能够在RTX 5090、DGX Spark和Jetson AGX Thor上部署，且不会丢弃未来预测信息；在RTX 5090上，每个动作块（包括未来视频潜变量预测）耗时107.4毫秒。在Unitree G1和YAM上的实时部署支持动态和长时程操作，包括在动态叠杯任务中达到95%的成功率，而Pi0.5和Fast-WAM在20次试验中均未成功。作为具有记忆感知能力的执行器，Long-WAM在复合任务中还能与更高层级的规划器形成互补。

Authors: Wei Huang, Bohan Zhang, Chenzhi Liu, Isabella Liu, Shuai Yang, Weian Mao, Luozhou Wang, Yicheng Xiao, Weifeng Lin, Qixin Hu, Bryan Chu, Sifei Liu, Linxi Fan, Xiaojuan Qi, Song Han, Yukang Chen

Rephrase Before You Act: Characterizing and Mitigating Language Sensitivity in Vision-Language-Action Models VLA

language sensitivity instruction rephrasing zero-shot robustness VLA policies rule distillation

简要说明：本文发现视觉-语言-动作模型对指令措辞高度敏感，细微措辞变化可导致成功率大幅波动。作者提出一种无需重新训练的方法，利用大语言模型从训练任务中提炼改写规则并在部署时重写指令，从而提升冻结VLA策略在不同措辞下的鲁棒性。

TLDR: This paper identifies and characterizes the sensitivity of Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) to instruction phrasing, showing that small wording changes can drastically affect success rates. It introduces a training-free method that uses an LLM to distill rephrasing rules from training data and applies them to rewrite instructions at deployment, improving the robustness of frozen VLA policies across various tasks and phrasings.

Abstract: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) are strikingly sensitive to instruction phrasing and do not inherit the language robustness of the vision-language models they are built on. A one-word edit can move success by tens of points: $π_{0.5}$ turns on a LIBERO stove 100% of the time for "switch on the stove" and 2% for "switch on the hot plate", and a $π_0$ checkpoint finetuned with rephrase augmentation still shows swings of up to 61 points. We characterize this sensitivity with statistically tested single-edit swings and an oracle phrase search, which shows that phrasing alone nearly closes the 21-point gap between in-distribution and out-of-distribution tasks. We then reduce it without modifying the policy. Because the sensitivity is systematic, it can be expressed as explicit rules: we score many phrasings of a few training tasks, have a large language model distill the evidence into ten to twenty rephrasing rules, and at deployment rewrite each incoming instruction once under these rules. The rules improve the frozen $π_0$ by 16 to 27% relative on twelve held-out tasks across adversarial, VLM-generated, and human-generated phrasings, with gains concentrated on out-of-distribution tasks. The pipeline replicates on $π_{0.5}$ and LIBERO, lifting in-finetune success from 93.6% to 97.8%. The method requires no retraining and no per-step verification, and applies zero-shot to unseen tasks and instructions. Project website: https://sttawm.github.io/rephrase-before-you-act

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作模型（VLAs）对指令措辞极其敏感，且并未继承其底层视觉-语言模型所具有的语言鲁棒性。一个词的改动即可使成功率发生数十个百分点的波动：在LIBERO环境中，$π_{0.5}$ 对“打开炉灶”（"switch on the stove"）的成功率为100%，而对“打开电热板”（"switch on the hot plate"）的成功率仅为2%；此外，使用改写增强（rephrase augmentation）微调的$π_0$检查点仍表现出高达61个百分点的波动。我们通过经统计检验的单词替换波动（single-edit swings）和预言机短语搜索（oracle phrase search）来刻画这一敏感性，结果表明，仅凭措辞变化就几乎弥合了分布内任务与分布外任务之间21个百分点的差距。随后，我们在不修改策略的前提下降低了该敏感性。由于该敏感性具有系统性，可以将其表示为显式规则：我们对少量训练任务的多种措辞进行评分，让大语言模型将这些证据提炼为十条至二十条改写规则，并在部署阶段按照这些规则对每条输入指令进行一次重写。实验表明，这些规则在十二个保留任务（涵盖对抗性、VLM生成及人工生成的措辞）上，将冻结的$π_0$相对提升了16%至27%，且增益集中在分布外任务上。该流程在$π_{0.5}$和LIBERO上也得到复现，将微调内成功率从93.6%提升至97.8%。该方法无需重新训练，也无需逐步验证，并可零样本直接应用于未见任务和指令。项目网站：https://sttawm.github.io/rephrase-before-you-act

Authors: Mikey Watts, Yuchen Cui

RoboJEPA: Scaling Robotic Latent World Models WorldModel

latent world model JEPA scaling laws multi-embodiment zero-shot planning

简要说明：RoboJEPA提出了一种基于JEPA的机器人潜空间世界模型，在12个机器人实体上训练，并展示了其潜空间推演误差遵循幂律，从而能够预测超出训练规模的模型质量和下游规划性能，并在真实硬件上实现零样本部署。

TLDR: RoboJEPA introduces a JEPA-based latent world model for robotics, trained on 12 embodiments, and demonstrates that its latent rollout error follows a power law, enabling prediction of model quality and downstream planning performance beyond training scale, with zero-shot deployment on real hardware.

Abstract: Latent world models have shown a remarkable ability to predict future states and to plan in the real world. In practice, however, we lack a principled way to estimate how their capabilities scale with model size, data, and compute, an open problem that slows progress in the field. In this work we present RoboJEPA, a world model based on the Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) and trained on a large-scale dataset spanning 12 robotic embodiments. We show that RoboJEPA's imagination error, the error of its latent rollouts, follows a second-order power law in compute, allowing us to predict model quality well beyond the scale at which the law is fit. We further show that downstream robotic planning performance improves predictably with compute, and that imagination error is strongly correlated with it, making it a reliable proxy for real-robot evaluation. Finally, we demonstrate that latent world models can be deployed zero-shot as robotic agents, planning toward a single goal image to solve tasks requiring long-horizon planning on real hardware. We release all model checkpoints together with our training and robot deployment code. To our knowledge, this is the first work to establish scaling laws for multi-embodiment robotic world models trained on real robot data, and RoboJEPA, at 8B parameters, is the largest JEPA predictor model trained to date.

摘要（中文）：潜在世界模型已展现出在真实世界中预测未来状态和进行规划的卓越能力。然而，在实践中，我们缺乏一种原则性的方法来估计其能力如何随模型规模、数据和计算量而扩展，这一开放问题阻碍了该领域的进展。在本工作中，我们提出RoboJEPA，一种基于联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）的世界模型，并在覆盖12种机器人形态的大规模数据集上进行训练。我们证明，RoboJEPA的想象误差，即其潜在轨迹展开的误差，在计算量上遵循二阶幂律，从而使我们能够预测远超该定律拟合规模的模型质量。我们进一步表明，下游机器人规划性能随计算量可预测地提升，且想象误差与其高度相关，使其成为真实机器人评估的可靠代理指标。最后，我们证明潜在世界模型可以作为机器人智能体零样本部署，通过规划朝向单一目标图像，在真实硬件上解决需要长时域规划的任务。我们开源所有模型检查点以及训练和机器人部署代码。据我们所知，这是首个为基于真实机器人数据训练的多形态机器人世界模型建立缩放定律的工作，而RoboJEPA以80亿参数规模，是迄今训练的最大JEPA预测模型。

Authors: Artem Zholus, Nicolas Beltran-Velez, Jianhao Yuan, Sarath Chandar, Tushar Nagarajan, Daniel Severo, Koustuv Sinha, Michal Drozdzal, Adriana Romero Soriano, Jeannette Bohg, Nicolas Ballas, Mahmoud Assran

Video Prediction Policy 2: Predict Better, Act Better VLA

World action model Video prediction Robot manipulation Zero-shot generalization Mixture-of-transformers

简要说明：VPP2 通过大规模操作视频预训练、事件级预训练、蒸馏和混合变换器动作模块，增强了用于机器人操作的世界动作模型，在真实世界和基准任务上实现了最先进的零样本和微调性能。

TLDR: VPP2 enhances world action models for robot manipulation through large-scale video pretraining, event-level pretraining, distillation, and a mixture-of-transformers action module, achieving state-of-the-art zero-shot and fine-tuned performance on real-world and benchmark tasks.

Abstract: World action models (WAMs) have emerged as an important class of generalist robot policies, aiming to transfer video prediction priors to action learning. However, we find that existing WAMs frequently produce incorrect motion predictions in open-ended environment, leading to erroneous actions. We attribute this limitation to two factors: (1) base video models are not optimized for manipulation, and (2) naively incorporating action components into video models can substantially degrade their generalization capabilities. We introduce Video Prediction Policy 2 (VPP2), a WAM that enables strong zero-shot generalization in both video prediction and action generation. First, we curate a large-scale, diverse dataset of manipulation videos to continue pretraining the base video foundation model. We annotate video clips with detailed captions and perform \textit{event-level} video pretraining to promote generalization across open-ended manipulation tasks. Second, we post-train and distill the video model into a single-step visual planner with fixed prediction horizon. Finally, we introduce action module via a mixture-of-transformers (MoT) architecture to learn implicit inverse dynamics model. Experiments demonstrate three key results: (1) VPP2-14B outperforms Cosmos3-64B by 11.0\% points in video prediction instruction-following success rate on open-ended tasks; (2) VPP2 surpasses the strongest baseline by 18.5\% points in success rate on real-world zero-shot ALOHA manipulation tasks; and (3) following benchmark-specific post-training, VPP2 achieves the highest success rates among evaluated methods on the challenging LIBERO-Pro, LIBERO-OOD, and RoboDojo benchmarks.

摘要（中文）：世界动作模型（WAMs）已成为一类重要的通用机器人策略，旨在将视频预测先验知识迁移至动作学习。然而，我们发现现有WAMs在开放环境中经常产生错误的运动预测，从而导致错误动作。我们将这一局限归因于两个因素：（1）基础视频模型未针对操作任务进行优化；（2）将动作组件简单纳入视频模型会大幅削弱其泛化能力。为此，我们提出视频预测策略2（VPP2），一种在视频预测和动作生成中均实现强大零样本泛化能力的WAM。首先，我们构建了一个大规模、多样化的操作视频数据集，用于对基础视频基础模型进行继续预训练。我们为视频片段标注详细描述，并进行\textit{事件级}视频预训练，以促进跨开放操作任务的泛化。其次，我们对视频模型进行后训练并将其蒸馏为具有固定预测时域的单步视觉规划器。最后，我们通过混合变换器（MoT）架构引入动作模块，以学习隐式逆动力学模型。实验证明了三个关键结果：（1）VPP2-14B在开放任务的视频预测指令遵循成功率上比Cosmos3-64B高出11.0个百分点；（2）VPP2在真实世界零样本ALOHA操作任务上的成功率比最强基线高出18.5个百分点；（3）在特定基准的后训练之后，VPP2在具有挑战性的LIBERO-Pro、LIBERO-OOD和RoboDojo基准上取得了评估方法中的最高成功率。

Authors: Yanjiang Guo, Haodong Yan, Zhide Zhong, Zhongru Zhang, Qingyuan Yang, Qingzhou Lu, Xiaoyu Chen, Yen-Jen Wang, Shuying Deng, Chenghan Yang, Puzhen Yuan, Chenxin Liu, Tun Ban, Xiang Zhu, Yichen Liu, Kun Feng, Haoang Li, Jianyu Chen

Many Ways to Succeed: Diversity-Driven RL Fine-Tuning for VLA Generalization VLA

diversity-driven RL VLA fine-tuning out-of-domain generalization success-conditioned intrinsic reward temporal alignment

简要说明：本文提出DRIVE，一种面向VLA模型的多样性驱动强化学习微调方法，通过显式奖励成功行为多样性来提升分布外泛化能力，在仿真基准和真实双臂机器人部署中均取得显著提升。

TLDR: This paper introduces DRIVE, a diversity-driven RL fine-tuning method for VLA models that explicitly rewards successful-behavior diversity, improving out-of-domain generalization across simulation benchmarks and real dual-arm robot deployment.

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) fine-tuning improves vision-language-action (VLA) policies through closed-loop experience, yet generalization beyond the fine-tuning distribution remains limited. Our analysis reveals a selective reshaping of exploration: RL contracts behavior globally, yet diversifies successful trajectories, elicits success with fewer rollouts, and covers more of the latent task-valid solution space than supervised fine-tuning. Broader successful-mode coverage may provide alternative strategies under distribution shifts. Inspired by this, we introduce DRIVE (Diversity-driven RL fIne-tuning for VLA gEneralization), which turns successful-behavior diversity into an explicit RL objective. DRIVE groups rollouts under matched task conditions, compares their trajectories with temporal alignment, and derives a success-conditioned intrinsic reward from relative behavioral diversity. This design encourages broader coverage of feasible solutions without rewarding diverse failures or superficial timing differences. Across LIBERO-Plus, ManiSkill3, and RoboTwin 2.0, DRIVE improves the average out-of-domain (OOD) performance over vanilla RL fine-tuning by 5.3 points on $π_0$ and 2.0 points on $π_{0.5}$. On a dual-arm AgileX PiPER-X platform, DRIVE further increases average OOD success from 64.1% to 73.3% (+9.2 points), demonstrating gains that persist under physical deployment.

摘要（中文）：强化学习（RL）微调通过闭环经验提升视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的性能，但在微调分布之外的泛化能力仍然受限。我们的分析揭示了探索行为的选择性重塑：与监督微调相比，RL在全局上收缩行为，却使成功轨迹多样化，以更少的尝试次数获得成功，并覆盖更多潜在任务有效解空间。更广泛的成功模式覆盖可能在分布偏移下提供替代策略。受此启发，我们提出DRIVE（面向VLA泛化的多样性驱动RL微调），将成功行为多样性转化为显式的RL目标。DRIVE在匹配的任务条件下对回合进行分组，通过时间对齐比较其轨迹，并从相对行为多样性中推导出基于成功条件的内在奖励。该设计鼓励更广泛地覆盖可行解，同时不奖励多样的失败或表面的时间差异。在LIBERO-Plus、ManiSkill3和RoboTwin 2.0上，DRIVE在$π_0$上将平均分布外（OOD）性能比普通RL微调提升了5.3个百分点，在$π_{0.5}$上提升了2.0个百分点。在双机械臂AgileX PiPER-X平台上，DRIVE进一步将平均OOD成功率从64.1%提升至73.3%（+9.2个百分点），证明了该增益在实际部署中持续有效。

Authors: Haoru Li, Jinmei Liu, Zhiyong Wang, Xiaoming Li, Zhenhong Sun, Daoyi Dong, Chunlin Chen, Zhi Wang

Juno: Taming Predictive Latents for Vision-Language-Action Models VLA

JEPA vision-language-action model world model test-time adaptation manipulation

简要说明：Juno 提出了一个统一的框架，利用动作条件化的 JEPA 为 VLA 模型提供控制对齐的表示、预测教师和可适应的动力学模型，从而在仿真和真实机器人的分布变化下提升操作性能。

TLDR: Juno introduces a unified framework using an action-conditioned JEPA to provide control-aligned representations, predictive teaching, and adaptable dynamics for VLA models, improving manipulation performance in simulation and on real robots under distribution shifts.

Abstract: Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) predict masked or future observations in representation space, offering a natural source of predictive latents for vision-language-action (VLA) models. Yet making these latents useful across pretraining, policy learning, and deployment requires addressing three failures: mismatch with embodiment-specific control, interference with action learning, and teacher miscalibration under distribution shifts. We introduce Juno, a unified framework built around one action-conditioned JEPA that serves as a control-aligned representation backbone, a predictive teacher, and an adaptable dynamics model. During pretraining, we train it on embodiment-matched trajectories and use a dynamic CLS loss to transfer motion-weighted patch dynamics to a compact global state. During policy learning, we fuse current-frame JEPA patches into VLA perception and use a decoupled reasoning branch with separate transformation parameters to distill future latent states for action generation. During deployment, we adapt the world model on all observed transitions, including failed rollouts, freeze the adapted teacher, and re-align the policy on verified executions using LoRA adapters and a trainable action head, without expert corrections or task rewards. On SimplerEnv, Juno raises average success from $60.9\%$ to $68.5\%$ over Qwen3GR00T, the strongest baseline, and test-time adaptation further reaches $72.7\%$; on a real robot, it retains $70\%$--$75\%$ success under background, height, and object shifts where the base policy collapses to $0\%$.

摘要（中文）：联合嵌入预测架构(JEPAs)在表示空间中预测掩蔽或未来的观测，为视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型提供了预测性潜在表示的自然来源。然而，要使这些潜在表示在预训练、策略学习和部署中均发挥作用，需要解决三个问题：与具身特定控制的不匹配、对动作学习的干扰，以及分布偏移下教师模型的校准失当。我们提出Junos—一个统一框架，围绕单一动作条件化JEPA构建，同时充当控制对齐的表示骨干、预测性教师模型和可适应的动力学模型。在预训练阶段，我们在具身匹配的轨迹上训练该模型，并使用动态CLS损失将运动加权的块级动态迁移到紧凑的全局状态中。在策略学习阶段，我们将当前帧的JEPA块特征融合到VLA感知中，并使用具有独立变换参数的解耦推理分支来蒸馏未来潜在状态以生成动作。在部署阶段，我们在所有观测到的转移(包括失败的 rollout)上适应世界模型，冻结适应后的教师模型，并利用LoRA适配器和可训练的动作头在验证过的执行轨迹上重新对齐策略，无需专家修正或任务奖励。在SimplerEnv上，Junos将平均成功率从最强基线Qwen3GR00T的$60.9\%$提升至$68.5\%$，测试时适应进一步达到$72.7\%$；在真实机器人上，在背景、高度和物体偏移条件下，Junos保持了$70\%$--$75\%$的成功率，而基线策略在这些条件下完全失效，成功率降至$0\%$。

Authors: Yuchen Zhu, Chenyi Xu, Yulin Zhang, Gang Xu, Wentao Zhu

Do Better Visual Representations Always Lead to Better End-to-End Autonomous Driving? AutonomousDriving

visual representation alignment end-to-end autonomous driving visual foundation models diffusion-based planner NAVSIM

简要说明：本文提出ViRA，一个与规划器无关的视觉表示对齐框架，用于端到端自动驾驶，证明持续提升驾驶性能，并开发ViRA-Diffusion，在NAVSIM上达到最先进EPDMS。

TLDR: This paper introduces ViRA, a planner-agnostic framework to align visual representations with VFMs for end-to-end autonomous driving, showing consistent driving improvements and developing ViRA-Diffusion that achieves state-of-the-art EPDMS on NAVSIM.

Abstract: Visual foundation models (VFMs) are increasingly integrated into end-to-end autonomous driving for their powerful representations, yet it remains unclear when these representations improve driving performance. To investigate this question, we introduce ViRA, a planner-agnostic visual representation alignment framework that keeps the planner architecture and inference cost unchanged. Our study reveals three findings: (1) VFM-guided visual representations consistently improve driving performance across diverse end-to-end planners, with gains extending to zero-shot closed-loop evaluation. (2) The choice of VFM target matters for planning performance, and alignment to a different VFM can further benefit planners with pre-trained VFM encoders. (3) Auxiliary perception supervision reduces sensitivity to VFM target selection, narrowing the EPDMS spread across five targets from 2.7 to 0.5 points and potentially compensating for less effective VFM targets. Guided by these findings, we develop ViRA-Diffusion, a diffusion-based planner trained without auxiliary perception supervision, which achieves 92.3 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2 navtest, outperforming recent methods in our comparison by at least 1.9 points. The results motivate jointly considering target selection and planner supervision when integrating VFMs into end-to-end autonomous driving. The results and demo are available at https://github.com/OpenDriveLab/ViRA.

摘要（中文）：视觉基础模型（VFM）因其强大的表征能力，正越来越多地集成到端到端自动驾驶系统中，然而，这些表征在何种条件下能够提升驾驶性能仍不明确。为探究这一问题，我们提出了ViRA——一种与规划器无关的视觉表征对齐框架，该框架在不改变规划器架构和推理成本的前提下运行。我们的研究揭示了三点发现：（1）VFM引导的视觉表征能够持续提升多种端到端规划器的驾驶性能，且增益可延伸至零样本闭环评估场景。（2）VFM目标的选择对规划性能具有显著影响，而对不同VFM的对齐可进一步惠及已使用预训练VFM编码器的规划器。（3）辅助感知监督能够降低对VFM目标选择的敏感性，将五种目标下的EPDMS差距从2.7分缩小至0.5分，并可能弥补效果较弱的VFM目标带来的不足。基于上述发现，我们开发了ViRA-Diffusion——一种无需辅助感知监督训练的基于扩散模型的规划器，其在NAVSIM v2 navtest上取得了92.3的EPDMS成绩，在对比方法中至少领先1.9分。上述结果提示，在将VFM集成至端到端自动驾驶系统时，应综合考虑目标选择与规划器监督。相关结果与演示代码见 https://github.com/OpenDriveLab/ViRA。

Authors: Zihao Zhang, Haochen Tian, Tianyu Li, Changhui Jing, Jingliang He, Naisheng Ye, Ziyuan Pu, Zhenjie Yang

Co-Evolving Robot Orchestrators and Policies through Deployment VLA

co-evolution orchestrator policy fine-tuning deployment self-improving

简要说明：Robo-COP 提出了一种协同进化框架，在部署过程中联合微调 VLM 编排器和 VLA 策略，利用自身执行的演示和策略验证，在仿真和现实任务中迭代提升机器人性能。

TLDR: Robo-COP introduces a co-evolution framework where a VLM orchestrator and a VLA policy are jointly fine-tuned during deployment, using self-curated demonstrations and policy verification to iteratively improve robot performance across simulated and real-world tasks.

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies trained on large datasets are capable within their training domains, yet they still fail to generalize to the variety of situations a robot meets in real-world deployment. Agentic robot systems complement the policy with a vision-language model (VLM) orchestrator that learns when to call the policy, how to instruct it, and when to use scripted skills instead. However, because the harness is built around a frozen policy that has limited language steerability, the orchestrator can avoid the policy's failures but never overcome them. The policy becomes the bottleneck of the whole system. Fine-tuning the policy can remove this bottleneck, but updating it alone decouples it from an orchestrator tuned to its old behavior. We propose Robo-COP, in which the orchestrator and policy co-evolve during deployment. Robo-COP curates skill demonstrations from its own executions, fine-tunes the policy when this data can address recurring failures, and adopts each new policy only after it improves the skills it was trained for. Across ten simulated RoboLab tasks, Robo-COP raises mean held-out success from 64.8% to 73.8% over the same harness with a frozen policy, while fine-tuning on a fixed schedule without verification reaches only 65.8%. On three real-world tasks, Robo-COP raises held-out success from 38.3% to 50.0%. Robo-COP turns deployment into a self-improving flywheel in which robots learn by doing, with each improvement in execution producing better data for the next round of learning. Videos and code are available at https://robo-cop.pages.dev/.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略在大型数据集上训练后，在其训练领域内具备一定能力，但在机器人实际部署所遇到的多样化情境中仍然难以泛化。智能体机器人系统通过引入一个视觉-语言模型（VLM）编排器来补充策略，该编排器学习何时调用策略、如何下达指令，以及何时改用脚本化技能。然而，由于该外层框架是围绕一个语言可控性有限的冻结策略构建的，编排器只能规避策略的失败，却无法从根本上克服这些失败。策略因而成为整个系统的瓶颈。对策略进行微调可以消除这一瓶颈，但仅更新策略本身会使其与原本适配旧行为的编排器脱节。我们提出Robo-COP，在该框架中，编排器与策略在部署过程中共同进化。Robo-COP从自身的执行中筛选技能演示数据，当这些数据能够解决反复出现的失败时对策略进行微调，并且只有在新策略确实提升了其训练目标技能的表现后，才会采纳该策略。在十个模拟RoboLab任务中，与使用冻结策略的同一框架相比，Robo-COP将保留任务的成功率从64.8%提升至73.8%，而按固定计划微调且不加验证的方法仅达到65.8%。在三个真实世界任务中，Robo-COP将保留任务的成功率从38.3%提升至50.0%。Robo-COP将部署过程转变为自我改进的飞轮机制，使机器人能够边做边学，每一次执行上的提升都为下一轮学习产生更优质的数据。视频和代码可在 https://robo-cop.pages.dev/ 获取。

Authors: Xilun Zhang, Maggie Wang, Erik Bauer, Hong-Xing Yu, Huang Huang, Jiajun Wu, Marco Pavone

PAIR: Bridging Perception and Action in Vision-Language-Action Models VLA

Vision-Language-Action representation learning action latent tokens bridge module continuous robot actions

简要说明：PAIR 通过桥接模块将视觉-语言特征与动作潜在标记对齐，为连续动作 VLA 模型学习共享的感知-动作表征，在 LIBERO、CALVIN 及真实机器人任务上提升了性能。

TLDR: PAIR introduces a shared perception-action representation for continuous-action VLA models by aligning visual-language features with action latent tokens via a Bridge Module, improving performance on LIBERO, CALVIN, and real-robot tasks.

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models map visual observations and language instructions to continuous robot actions. This task requires a transition from representations that describe the scene and instruction to representations that support action generation. Many continuous-action VLAs leave this transition implicit and supervise it mainly through the final action-prediction loss. We introduce PAIR, a framework that learns a shared perception-action representation between these two spaces. During training, a Masked Action Autoencoder encodes expert action chunks into horizon-aligned Action Latent Tokens. A Bridge Module extracts task-relevant features from the current visual-language representations. PAIR aligns these features with the Action Latent Tokens to form Bridge Tokens that preserve task information and capture the structure of expert actions. The Bridge Tokens are then projected into the action-token space and injected into the initial Action Tokens, providing an action-ready starting point for Action Expert refinement. At inference, the autoencoder is removed, and the Bridge Tokens are generated only from the current observation and instruction. Experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and CALVIN ABC-D show gains for the evaluated OpenVLA-OFT and VLA-Adapter models. On LIBERO-Plus, PAIR raises VLA-Adapter's success rate from 59.1% to 64.2%. On CALVIN, it increases VLA-Adapter's average completed sequence length from 4.42 to 4.53. Across seven real-world tasks, PAIR raises OpenVLA-OFT's success rate from 51.4% to 65.0%. Representation analyses show that Bridge Tokens retain task information while making continuous-action information accessible before Action Expert refinement. These results support a shared intermediate representation as a useful interface between perception and action in continuous-action VLAs.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型将视觉观察和语言指令映射为连续的机器人动作。这一任务要求从描述场景和指令的表征过渡到支持动作生成的表征。许多连续动作VLA模型将这一过渡隐式化，并主要通过最终的动作预测损失进行监督。我们提出PAIR框架，在该框架中学习这两个空间之间的共享感知-动作表征。在训练阶段，掩码动作自编码器将专家动作块编码为水平对齐的动作潜变量令牌。桥接模块从当前的视觉-语言表征中提取任务相关特征。PAIR将这些特征与动作潜变量令牌对齐，形成保留任务信息并捕捉专家动作结构的桥接令牌。随后，桥接令牌被投影到动作令牌空间，并注入初始动作令牌，为动作专家精化提供可直接用于动作生成的起点。在推理阶段，自编码器被移除，桥接令牌仅由当前观察和指令生成。在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus和CALVIN ABC-D上的实验表明，所评估的OpenVLA-OFT和VLA-Adapter模型均取得性能提升。在LIBERO-Plus上，PAIR将VLA-Adapter的成功率从59.1%提升至64.2%。在CALVIN上，PAIR将VLA-Adapter的平均完成序列长度从4.42提升至4.53。在七项真实世界任务中，PAIR将OpenVLA-OFT的成功率从51.4%提升至65.0%。表征分析表明，桥接令牌在动作专家精化之前保留任务信息的同时，使连续动作信息可被访问。这些结果支持共享中间表征可作为连续动作VLA中感知与动作之间的有效接口。

Authors: Kaixi Feng, Guoheng Sun, Ang li

RoboPrompt: Intuitive Robot Policy Steering with Sparse Human Input Manipulation

robot policy steering sparse human input diffusion policy flow-matching DAgger

简要说明：RoboPrompt 是一个轻量级、通用的机器人策略引导系统，通过将稀疏人类输入（手绘轨迹、目标点、方向指令）转换为动作草稿并在噪声空间中精炼，无需修改基础策略即可引导行为，并通过 DAgger 提升成功率、减少人工干预。

TLDR: RoboPrompt is a lightweight, general-purpose system that steers robot policies via sparse human inputs (drawn traces, target points, directions) by converting them into action drafts refined in noise space, without modifying the base policy, and improves success rates and reduces interventions via DAgger.

Abstract: End-to-end robot policies trained through imitation learning remain constrained by limited data diversity, making reliable zero-shot deployment in real-world settings challenging. Shared-autonomy methods enable human correction through teleoperation, but specialized hardware and operator training hinder deployment at scale. Other approaches incorporate human guidance as additional policy inputs, often requiring architectural changes and dedicated training for steerability, which limits their applicability across policies. We present RoboPrompt, a general-purpose, lightweight robot policy steering system that enables users to guide policy behavior through intuitive, sparse inputs, including drawn traces, target points, and coarse directional instructions. RoboPrompt decouples human-intention translation from the underlying policy: a reusable module converts human guidance into action drafts, which are refined through the diffusion or flow-matching dynamics of the base policy. By controlling action generation in noise space, RoboPrompt balances human intent with the policy prior without modifying the base policy architecture or fine-tuning it for steerability. Experiments demonstrate effective steering across Diffusion Policy, $π_{0.5}$, and FastWAM. We further use steered rollouts for online policy improvement through DAgger. After 2-3 rounds of iteration, average success rates increase by 15.5\% for $π_{0.5}$ across three tasks and by 21.3\% across three policies(Diffusion Policy, $π_{0.5}$, FastWAM) on the Insert Bread task, while average human intervention counts decrease by 44.0\% (2.86 to 1.60) and 81.9\% (2.60 to 0.47), respectively.

摘要（中文）：通过模仿学习训练的端到端机器人策略仍受限于数据多样性的不足，使得在现实场景中实现可靠的零样本部署面临挑战。共享自主方法通过遥操作实现人工校正，但专用硬件和操作员培训阻碍了其大规模部署。其他方法将人类指导作为额外的策略输入，通常需要对架构进行修改并针对可控性进行专门训练，这限制了其在不同策略中的适用性。我们提出RoboPrompt，一种通用、轻量级的机器人策略引导系统，使用户能够通过直观的稀疏输入（包括手绘轨迹、目标点和粗略方向指令）来引导策略行为。RoboPrompt将人类意图转换与底层策略解耦：一个可复用模块将人类指导转换为动作草案，再通过基础策略的扩散或流匹配动力学进行优化。通过在噪声空间中控制动作生成，RoboPrompt在不修改基础策略架构或针对可控性进行微调的情况下，实现了人类意图与策略先验之间的平衡。实验表明，该系统在Diffusion Policy、$π_{0.5}$和FastWAM上均能实现有效的引导。我们进一步利用引导式轨迹通过DAgger进行在线策略改进。经过2-3轮迭代后，$π_{0.5}$在三个任务上的平均成功率提升了15.5\%，三个策略（Diffusion Policy、$π_{0.5}$、FastWAM）在Insert Bread任务上的平均成功率提升了21.3\%，而平均人工干预次数分别减少了44.0\%（从2.86降至1.60）和81.9\%（从2.60降至0.47）。

Authors: Yanwen Zou, Chenyang Shi, Guoxuan Xu, Wenye Yu, Wendi Chen, Ye Pan, Cewu Lu, Chuan Wen

Factorized Tactile Representation and Control for Sim-to-Real Manipulation Manipulation

tactile representation sim-to-real robotic manipulation contact-rich force control

简要说明：该论文提出一种分解的触觉表示与控制框架，将法向力和接触区域信息分离，提升了接触丰富的操作任务（如插销）的仿真到现实迁移能力。

TLDR: The paper introduces a factorized tactile representation and control framework that separates normal force and contact patch information, improving sim-to-real transfer for contact-rich manipulation tasks like peg insertion.

Abstract: Tactile sim-to-real learning must bridge simulated contact and device-specific sensor responses while preserving information needed for control. We propose a factorized tactile representation and control framework that maps normal force and contact patch to an effective contact response recoverable from sensor readings. The response is separated into contact geometry, force distribution, and temporal contact change, with representation-specific encoding and randomization. A Tactile Gated Policy preserves these representations separately through control and operates over all mask configurations without retraining. We evaluate the approach through response reconstruction, spatial alignment, force regulation, and contact-rich adversarial peg insertion in simulation and the real world, enabling the utility and transfer reliability of different tactile representations to be assessed independently. The approach achieves <1 mm contact localization, 1.69 N force-tracking error on unseen geometries, and a 35% improvement in real-world adversarial peg insertion over the unfactorized response, with different tactile representations benefiting different interactions.

摘要（中文）：触觉仿真到现实的学习必须在模拟接触与设备特定传感器响应之间建立桥梁，同时保留控制所需的信息。我们提出了一种分解式触觉表示与控制框架，将法向力和接触区域映射为可从传感器读数恢复的有效接触响应。该响应被分解为接触几何、力分布和时间接触变化三个部分，并针对每种表示进行特定编码和随机化处理。一种触觉门控策略在控制过程中分别保留这些表示，并能在无需重新训练的情况下适用于所有掩码配置。我们通过响应重建、空间对齐、力调节以及仿真和现实世界中的对抗性插销插入任务来评估该方法，从而能够独立评估不同触觉表示的有效性和迁移可靠性。该方法在未见几何形状上实现了小于1毫米的接触定位误差、1.69牛顿的力跟踪误差，并在现实世界对抗性插销插入任务中相比未分解响应提升了35%的性能，且不同触觉表示对不同交互任务各有优势。

Authors: Siqi Shang, Bianca Aumann, Tye Brady, Joshua Migdal, Taskin Padir

HuMBLE: Human Motion-Driven Behavior Learning for Embodied Locomotion Locomotion

humanoid locomotion teacher-student distillation multi-task reinforcement learning biomimetic gait proprioceptive policy

简要说明：本文提出HuMBLE，一种结合教师-学生蒸馏和多任务强化学习的框架，用于合成可实时操控、鲁棒且仿人的人形机器人运动策略，并在三款人形机器人上验证，包括真实场景部署。

TLDR: This paper introduces HuMBLE, a learning framework that combines teacher-student distillation and multi-task RL to synthesize real-time steerable, robust, and biomimetic locomotion policies for humanoid robots, validated on three platforms including real-world deployments.

Abstract: Despite recent advances in humanoid locomotion, controllers optimized for command tracking and robustness tend to produce mechanical gaits, whereas controllers tied to human motion data often fail to generalize to commands outside the data distribution. This work introduces a learning framework that balances these competing objectives to synthesize real-time steerable, robust, and biomimetic locomotion policies from human data. Using an in-house curated locomotion dataset covering diverse speeds and directions, we first learn a natural locomotion prior policy through a teacher-student distillation process. Specifically, we train a full-body reference-conditioned policy with Reinforcement Learning (RL), then distill it into a lightweight prior policy conditioned solely on proprioception and a planar torso-velocity steering command. Next, we fine-tune the prior policy with multi-task RL to expand command coverage and robustness beyond the data distribution, pairing a goal-conditioned task that tracks arbitrary commands with a reference-guided task that tracks the human data as an explicit style regularizer. We validate our framework on three humanoid robots: the Boston Dynamics Atlas R1, Atlas D1, and Unitree G1. Experimental results demonstrate robust performance across real-world scenarios, including direct user-controlled locomotion in indoor and outdoor environments, and integration as the locomotion layer within hierarchical control stacks. Benchmarks against Tabula Rasa RL policies trained without human data and ablation studies confirm that our framework yields a lightweight, deployable policy that reconstructs coordinated whole-body behavior from a steering command, retaining the human gait characteristics while remaining robust and fully steerable.

摘要（中文）：尽管人形机器人运动控制近期取得了进展，但针对指令跟踪和鲁棒性进行优化的控制器往往会产生机械式步态，而与人类运动数据绑定的控制器则常常无法泛化到数据分布之外的指令。本文提出了一种学习框架，在兼顾这两种相互竞争目标的基础上，从人类数据中合成实时可控、鲁棒且具有仿生特征的运动策略。利用我们内部整理、覆盖多种速度和方向的运动数据集，我们首先通过教师-学生蒸馏过程学习一个自然运动先验策略。具体而言，我们使用强化学习训练一个全身参考条件策略，然后将其蒸馏为一个仅依赖于本体感觉和平面躯干速度转向指令的轻量级先验策略。接下来，我们通过多任务强化学习对先验策略进行微调，以扩展其在数据分布之外的指令覆盖范围和鲁棒性，将跟踪任意指令的目标条件任务与跟踪人类数据作为显式风格正则项的参考引导任务相结合。我们在三款人形机器人上验证了该框架：波士顿动力Atlas R1、Atlas D1和宇树G1。实验结果表明，该方法在真实场景中表现出鲁棒性能，包括室内外环境中直接由用户控制的运动，以及作为分层控制栈中运动层的集成应用。与未使用人类数据训练的Tabula Rasa强化学习策略的基准对比以及消融研究证实，该框架能够生成一个轻量级、可部署的策略，从转向指令中重建协调的全身行为，在保持人类步态特征的同时，依然具备鲁棒性和完全可控性。

Authors: Mike Zhang, Dongho Kang, Kevin Bergamin, Nicola Burger, Robin Deits, Jonathan Foster, Bilal Hammoud, Katie Hughes, Francesco Iacobelli, Twan Koolen, M. Eva Mungai, Zach Nobles, Shane Rozen-Levy, Jean Pierre Sleiman, Fangzhou Yu, Yunbo Zhang, Alfred Rizzi, Jessica Hodgins, Scott Kuindersma, Yeuhi Abe, Sylvain Bertrand, Farbod Farshidian

Agentic RSR: Real-to-Sim-to-Real through Scene Reconstruction and Execution-Grounded Robot Policies Manipulation

Real-to-Sim-to-Real Scene Reconstruction Executable Robot Policies MuJoCo Real-Robot Deployment

简要说明：Agentic RSR 提出了一个框架，将场景重建、基于仿真的策略开发和真实机器人执行统一起来，在18个场景中实现了80%的仿真到现实任务成功率保持。

TLDR: Agentic RSR presents a framework that unifies scene reconstruction, simulation-based policy development, and real-robot execution for manipulation tasks, achieving a simulated-to-real task success rate retention of 80% across 18 scenes.

Abstract: A simulation of a real robot workspace must preserve task-relevant interactions, while policies developed in it must operate on observations available to the real robot. Yet scene reconstruction and policy development are often treated separately. We present Agentic Real-to-Sim-to-Real (Agentic RSR), a framework that links scene reconstruction, policy development, and real-robot execution through the same manipulation task. Given a workspace video, a task description, and a known robot model, an agent recovers metric scale, iteratively refines the scene using visual feedback, and checks task-relevant interactions in MuJoCo. A coding agent then develops an executable policy, progressing from privileged object poses to visual observations and randomized simulation. The policy can interleave multiple observations and actions within one invocation, while the agent uses execution feedback to continue, retry, or revise its approach. A shared task-level interface carries the policy and accumulated experience to the real robot, where fresh observations and safety checks guide execution. Across 18 reconstructed scenes involving two robots, the mean four-view Depth MAE against reference depth estimates is 0.1057 m, the mean Lab $ΔE_{76}$ is 11.04, and the mean grayscale SSIM is 0.6990. In real-robot experiments, the aggregate task success rate reaches 80% of the simulation task success rate, indicating substantial retention of simulated performance on hardware. Code and reconstructed scene data will be made publicly available.

摘要（中文）：对真实机器人工作空间进行仿真，必须保留与任务相关的交互，而在仿真中开发的策略必须能够处理真实机器人可获取的观测信息。然而，场景重建与策略开发往往被分开处理。我们提出了一种名为“智能体化真实-仿真-真实”（Agentic Real-to-Sim-to-Real，简称Agentic RSR）的框架，该框架通过同一操作任务将场景重建、策略开发与真实机器人执行相连接。给定一段工作空间视频、一个任务描述以及已知的机器人模型，智能体能够恢复度量尺度，利用视觉反馈迭代式地优化场景，并在MuJoCo中检查与任务相关的交互。随后，一个编码智能体开发出可执行的策略，从特权物体位姿逐步过渡到视觉观测和随机化仿真。该策略可在单次调用中交错处理多个观测与动作，同时智能体利用执行反馈来继续、重试或修正其方法。一个共享的任务级接口将策略与累积的经验传递至真实机器人，在真实环境中，新的观测信息与安全检查引导执行过程。在涉及两台机器人的18个重建场景中，与参考深度估计相比，平均四视角深度平均绝对误差（Depth MAE）为0.1057米，平均Lab ΔE₇₆色差为11.04，平均灰度结构相似性指数（SSIM）为0.6990。在真实机器人实验中，任务综合成功率达到了仿真任务成功率的80%，表明仿真性能在硬件上得到了显著保持。代码与重建场景数据将公开发布。

Authors: Yihan Li, Yating Feng, Shengjiu Sun, Jianing Chen, Hao Ren, Bowen Yang, Weisheng Xu, Qiwei Wu, Hui Cheng, Renjing Xu

LLA-MPPI: Rapidly Adaptive Whole-body Control of Legged Robots with GPU-Accelerated Parallel Simulations Locomotion

model predictive path integral whole-body control legged robots GPU-accelerated simulation adaptive control

简要说明：本文提出了LLA-MPPI，一种用于腿式机器人的实时自适应全身控制器，通过预测误差在GPU批量接触模拟器中选择最匹配的模型，并使用MPPI优化控制，在仿真和硬件上无需离线训练即实现了高成功率。

TLDR: This paper introduces LLA-MPPI, a real-time adaptive whole-body controller for legged robots that selects among GPU-batched contact simulators based on prediction errors and optimizes controls via MPPI, achieving high success rates in simulation and hardware experiments without offline training.

Abstract: Real-time whole-body controllers for legged robots typically plan through a fixed nominal model and degrade when the deployed dynamics change. Adaptive methods typically require a model structure that contact dynamics do not provide, or they need offline training for each anticipated condition. We present Look-back and Look-ahead Adaptive Model Predictive Path Integral control (LLA-MPPI). The method converts whole-body adaptation into selection over a bank of GPU-batched contact simulators with different physical or structural parameters. Windowed prediction errors select the simulator that best explains recent motion. A whole-body MPPI planner optimizes controls through the selected model. The framework requires no offline training, and its selected hypotheses are physically interpretable. Across four simulated tasks, it achieves 97.5% success while the strongest baseline reaches 74% and an oracle with the true model reaches 98.5%. Hardware validation on a Unitree Go2 shows the robot walking under a payload added mid-run, walking after one leg is disabled, and pushing a box to its goal while increasing its mass on the fly. Code, videos, and project details are available at: https://lla-control.github.io

摘要（中文）：实时全身控制器通常基于固定的标称模型进行规划，当部署环境中的动力学发生变化时，其性能会下降。自适应方法通常需要接触动力学无法提供的模型结构，或者需要对每种预期情况进行离线训练。我们提出了一种回望与前瞻自适应模型预测路径积分控制方法（LLA-MPPI）。该方法将全身适应问题转化为在一组具有不同物理或结构参数的GPU批量接触模拟器之间的选择问题。利用窗口化预测误差选出最能解释近期运动的模拟器。一个全身MPPI规划器通过所选模型优化控制指令。该框架无需离线训练，且其选中的假设具有物理可解释性。在四个模拟任务中，该方法达到了97.5%的成功率，而最强的基线方法为74%，使用真实模型的理想方法为98.5%。在宇树Go2上的硬件验证显示，机器人在运行中途加载负载后仍能行走、在一条腿失效后仍能行走，以及在运动中不断增加自身质量的同时将箱子推至目标位置。代码、视频和项目详情请参见：https://lla-control.github.io

Authors: Sebin Jung, Maitham F. AL-Sunni, Juan Alvarez-Padilla, Zachary Manchester, Changliu Liu, John M. Dolan

FoldBack: Self-Correcting Masked Generative Policy for Long-Horizon Garment Folding Manipulation

self-correcting policy masked generative policy garment folding long-horizon manipulation inference-time recovery

简要说明：FoldBack提出了一种自校正掩码生成策略，用于长时程衣物折叠任务，无需重新训练即可在推理时检测、撤销和修复失败操作，在真实衣物上显著优于先前基线。

TLDR: FoldBack introduces a self-correcting masked generative policy for long-horizon garment folding that detects, undoes, and repairs failed interactions at inference time without retraining, achieving significant improvements over prior baselines on real garments.

Abstract: We present FoldBack, a self-correcting masked generative policy for long-horizon garment folding. Existing long-trajectory policies may continue after a missed or slipped grasp even when the garment has not reached the intended configuration. We structure FoldBack's recovery mechanisms around three inference-time decisions: when to refine and verify, how to roll back, and where and how to retry. FoldBack aligns refinement and grasp verification with pick-and-place events, returns the robot to a retryable pre-grasp configuration while preserving successful grasps, and selectively regenerates the failed segment and selected future actions while avoiding previous failed grasp locations. To our knowledge, FoldBack is the first editable full-trajectory policy to unify these decisions, enabling failed interactions to be detected, undone, and repaired before execution continues, without recovery demonstrations or base-policy retraining. Across 33 real garments from six categories, FoldBack achieves 75.2% final folding success and 0.837 final-mask IoU, versus 45.7% and 0.689 for the strongest prior baseline.

摘要（中文）：我们提出FoldBack，一种面向长时程衣物折叠任务的自校正掩码生成策略。现有的长轨迹策略可能在抓取遗漏或滑落之后仍然继续执行，即使衣物尚未达到预期构型。我们将FoldBack的恢复机制构建在三个推理时决策之上：何时进行细化与验证，如何回退，以及在何处并如何重试。FoldBack将细化操作与抓取验证对齐到拾放事件上，在保留成功抓取的同时，将机器人恢复到可重试的预抓取构型，并有选择性地重新生成失败片段及选定的未来动作，同时避开先前失败的抓取位置。据我们所知，FoldBack是首个将上述决策统一起来的可编辑全轨迹策略，使得失败交互能够在执行继续之前被检测、撤销并修复，而无需恢复示范或对基础策略进行重新训练。在来自六个类别的33件真实衣物上，FoldBack实现了75.2%的最终折叠成功率和0.837的最终掩码IoU，而最强先前基线的对应指标分别为45.7%和0.689。

Authors: Lipeng Zhuang, Shiyu Fan, Yingdong Ru, Zhuo He, Florent P. Audonnet, Paul Henderson, Gerardo Aragon Camarasa

RFPO: Rectified Flow Policy Optimization for Embodied Control RLRobot

flow-based policy few-step discretization gap online Reflow one-step execution legged locomotion

简要说明：RFPO通过奖励感知的在线Reflow和固定的高斯PPO监督，使基于流的机器人策略对单步Euler执行稳健，在多种腿式机器人和真实宇树Go2上保持了全步控制性能。

TLDR: RFPO introduces a reward-aware online Reflow and frozen Gaussian PPO supervision to make flow-based robot policies robust to one-step Euler execution, preserving full-step control performance across multiple legged robots and a real Unitree Go2.

Abstract: Flow-based policies provide an expressive framework for continuous robot control, but their iterative ODE integration incurs substantial inference cost. Naively reducing the integration budget can severely degrade control, since policies optimized under full-step execution are not explicitly constrained to remain reliable under coarse numerical integration. We refer to this mismatch as the few-step discretization gap. To address this problem, we introduce RFPO, a flow-policy optimization framework for reliable few-step execution. Reward-aware online Reflow rectifies student-induced transport paths during on-policy learning, making the resulting policy more robust to coarse integration. A frozen Gaussian PPO controller supplies complementary action-space supervision at full and intermediate integration budgets, while the deployed policy remains a single flow student executed with one Euler step. Across Unitree Go2, Boston Dynamics Spot, Unitree H1, and Unitree G1, RFPO consistently preserves full-step control performance under one-step execution, with one-step returns remaining within 2.4% of their corresponding 64-step values across both zero and random initialization. On Unitree Go2, one-step execution retains 98.5% of the 64-step reward while reducing onboard mean inference latency from 4.39 ms to 0.08 ms, yielding a 54.9x speedup. Real-robot experiments further validate stable one-step locomotion. Code: https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/RFPO. Website: https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/RFPO.

摘要（中文）：基于流策略为连续机器人控制提供了一种表达力强的框架，但其迭代式常微分方程积分带来了显著的推理成本。简单地减少积分预算会严重降低控制性能，因为在完整步长执行下优化的策略，并未被明确约束为在粗粒度数值积分下依然保持可靠。我们将这种不匹配称为少步离散化间隙。为解决这一问题，我们引入了RFPO，一种面向可靠少步执行的流策略优化框架。奖励感知的在线Reflow在策略学习过程中修正由学生模型诱导的传输路径，使所得策略对粗粒度积分更具鲁棒性。一个冻结的高斯PPO控制器在完整和中间积分预算下提供补充的动作空间监督，而部署的策略仍为通过单步欧拉法执行的学生流模型。在Unitree Go2、Boston Dynamics Spot、Unitree H1和Unitree G1上，RFPO在单步执行下持续保持完整的控制性能，在零初始化和随机初始化两种情况下，单步回报与相应的64步值的偏差保持在2.4%以内。在Unitree Go2上，单步执行保留了64步奖励的98.5%，同时将机载平均推理延迟从4.39毫秒降至0.08毫秒，实现了54.9倍的加速。真实机器人实验进一步验证了稳定的单步运动。代码：https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/RFPO。网站：https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/RFPO。

Authors: Ting Huang, Lisiyu Pan, Haoyu Wang, Zeyu Zhang, Siyuan Qian, Yanjun Li, Yandong Guo, Boxin Shi, Hao Tang

Q-Learning with Scalar Adjoint Matching RLRobot

flow policies off-policy RL scalar adjoint Q-learning VLA fine-tuning

简要说明：本文提出SQAM方法，利用闭式标量伴随和值惩罚对基于流的策略进行离策略RL微调，在OGBench基准和真实双臂机器人VLA策略上取得了改进。

TLDR: This paper proposes SQAM, a method for fine-tuning flow-based policies with off-policy RL using a closed-form scalar adjoint and a value penalty, demonstrating improvements on OGBench benchmarks and a real bimanual robot with a VLA policy.

Abstract: Flow policies capture rich and diverse action distributions, and fine-tuning them with off-policy RL to improve beyond the demonstrations has drawn growing interest. However, fine-tuning a flow policy against a learned value function is not trivial, because the policy generates its action over many flow steps. Adjoint matching offers a principled way to update the flow model itself by propagating value information from the final action back to each flow step, but it requires a vector--Jacobian product through the policy at every step, a cost that grows with the number of flow steps and the policy size. We observe that the batch-averaged velocity Jacobian of pretrained flow policies concentrates on its diagonal. Motivated by this finding, we derive a closed-form scalar adjoint that scales the value gradient at the final action by the flow time, eliminating the per-step vector--Jacobian products. We further find that controlling the critic's value at policy-generated actions is particularly important under the scalar adjoint. Based on these findings, we propose Q-learning with Scalar Adjoint Matching (SQAM), which combines the scalar adjoint with a value penalty at those actions. SQAM's gains concentrate on the four hardest OGBench domains, where its success rate exceeds that of the strongest baseline in each domain by 18 to 35 percentage points. To test whether SQAM extends to large pretrained policies, we also fine-tune a vision-language-action policy on a real bimanual robot. SQAM improves over supervised fine-tuning on all three tasks.

摘要（中文）：摘要：流策略可捕获丰富多样的动作分布，而通过离线强化学习对其进行微调以超越示范性能，已引起越来越多的关注。然而，针对学习到的价值函数对流策略进行微调并非易事，因为该策略会通过多个流步骤生成其动作。伴随匹配提供了一种原则性的方法，通过将最终动作的价值信息传播回每个流步骤来更新流模型本身，但该方法需要在每一步计算策略的向量-雅可比乘积，其成本随流步骤数和策略规模的增长而增加。我们观察到，预训练流策略的批量平均速度雅可比矩阵集中在其对角线上。基于这一发现，我们推导出一种闭式标量伴随项，将最终动作处的价值梯度按流时间缩放，从而消除了逐步骤的向量-雅可比乘积。我们进一步发现，在标量伴随项下，对策略生成动作处的评论家价值进行控制尤为重要。基于这些发现，我们提出了一种带标量伴随匹配的Q学习方法（SQAM），该方法将标量伴随项与这些动作处的价值惩罚相结合。SQAM的增益集中在最具挑战性的四个OGBench领域中，其在每个领域的成功率超过该领域最强基线18至35个百分点。为测试SQAM是否可扩展至大规模预训练策略，我们还在真实双臂机器人上对视觉-语言-动作策略进行了微调。在所有三个任务上，SQAM均优于监督微调方法。

Authors: Yonghoon Dong, Minsung Yoon, Jaehyuk Kim, Jungwoo Park, Changyeon Kim, Jinwoo Shin

AirGroundVLN: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Goal-Oriented Air-Ground Collaborative Vision-and-Language Navigation VLN

Vision-and-Language Navigation air-ground collaboration goal-oriented navigation collaborative memory aerial-guided planning

简要说明：本文提出了AirGroundVLN，一个大规模空地协同视觉语言导航基准，并提出了AG-CoNAV参考框架，通过协同记忆与空中引导规划解决跨平台空间一致性与非对称观测问题。

TLDR: This paper introduces AirGroundVLN, a large-scale benchmark for goal-oriented air-ground collaborative Vision-and-Language Navigation, along with a reference framework AG-CoNAV that addresses cross-platform spatial consistency and asymmetric observability through collaborative memory and aerial-guided planning.

Abstract: Goal-oriented Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) requires agents to locate and reach targets described in natural language without prescribed routes. Air--ground collaboration is valuable for tasks requiring both wide-area search and fine-grained localization. However, systematic study of goal-oriented air--ground collaborative VLN remains limited by the lack of large-scale, diverse benchmarks and two core challenges: 1) substantial differences between aerial and ground views, together with useful observations becoming unavailable as navigation proceeds, make it difficult to maintain spatially consistent context across platforms and over time; and 2) asymmetric spatial observability makes ground perception locally detailed but spatially limited and aerial perception broad but locally coarse, limiting the reliability of single-platform planning. To address these limitations, we introduce AirGroundVLN, a benchmark containing 10,281 navigation episodes and 955 target instances across 19 Unreal Engine environments, with seen/unseen splits and an aerial-visibility protocol for systematic evaluation. Alongside the benchmark, we propose AG-CoNAV, a trainable reference framework comprising two key components: Spatiotemporally Anchored Collaborative Memory (SACM) and Aerial-Guided Regional-to-Local Planning (AGRLP). SACM maintains and retrieves spatially consistent historical context across aerial and ground observations. Meanwhile, AGRLP combines regional aerial guidance with fine-grained ground navigation. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of AG-CoNAV and establish AirGroundVLN as a comprehensive benchmark for future exploration.

摘要（中文）：面向目标的视觉与语言导航（VLN）要求智能体在没有预设路线的情况下，根据自然语言描述定位并到达目标位置。对于需要广域搜索与细粒度定位相结合的任务，空—地协同具有重要价值。然而，受限于缺乏大规模、多样化的基准数据集，以及两大核心挑战，面向目标的空—地协同VLN系统研究仍十分有限：1）空中视角与地面视角之间存在显著差异，且随着导航推进，部分有效观测信息会逐渐不可用，这使得跨平台、跨时间维持空间一致的上下文变得困难；2）空间可观测性的不对称性导致地面感知局部精细但空间范围有限，空中感知覆盖广泛但局部粗糙，从而限制了单一平台规划的可靠性。为应对上述问题，我们提出了AirGroundVLN基准数据集，包含19个虚幻引擎环境中的10,281个导航片段和955个目标实例，并提供了已见/未见场景划分以及空中可见性协议，以支持系统化评估。在基准数据集之外，我们还提出了AG-CoNAV，一个可训练参考框架，包含两个关键组件：时空锚定协同记忆（SACM）和空中引导的区域到局部规划（AGRLP）。SACM负责在空—地观测之间维护并检索空间一致的历史上下文，而AGRLP则将区域级空中引导与细粒度地面导航相结合。大量实验验证了AG-CoNAV的有效性，并确立了AirGroundVLN作为未来探索的综合基准。

Authors: Zhenxuan Zeng, Qingle Wu, Wei Suo, Maojia Wu, Bairong Zhang, Hangzheng Yu, Peng Wang

RoboQuest: Generalist Physical Agents that Search, Inspect and Test Manipulation

embodied exploration mobile manipulation multimodal agents benchmark interactive testing

简要说明：RoboQuest 是一个具身探索基准，要求智能体通过物理交互主动获取任务相关信息，评估显示前沿多模态智能体和微调策略表现不佳，失败主要源于过早停止探索。

TLDR: RoboQuest is a benchmark for embodied exploration where agents must actively acquire task-relevant information through physical interaction in mobile manipulation tasks, revealing that frontier multimodal agents and fine-tuned policies struggle, with failures mainly due to premature stopping and insufficient exploration.

Abstract: Recent advances in multimodal foundation models have made them capable generalist physical agents for a range of manipulation tasks. However, successful operation in an unfamiliar environment may require an agent to seek task-relevant information through interaction when it is absent from the observations: it may need to determine where a relevant object is, inspect an unobserved property, or discover the effect of an unfamiliar tool. We thus introduce RoboQuest, a benchmark for goal-directed embodied exploration, where agents must actively acquire task-relevant information through physical interaction, use the resulting evidence to adapt subsequent actions, and autonomously decide when to commit to task completion. RoboQuest comprises ten mobile manipulation tasks centered on three forms of uncertainty: search, manipulation-based inspection, and interactive testing. We evaluate five frontier multimodal agents through a common visuomotor interface, as well as a $π_{0.5}$ policy fine-tuned on the full-episode demonstrations we release. The best agent succeeds in only 23\% of the episodes, and the fine-tuned policy almost never succeeds. Isolated tests of the execution skills the tasks are built from, with the hidden information supplied, show that the agents can carry out most of the required actions, and our failure analysis attributes only a minority of the failures to execution. Our failure analysis further finds that the agents often stop exploring too early as they make decisions before observing the required evidence for task completion. We also find that agents rarely prevent or repair the disturbances caused by their exploration. Moreover, learning by trial and error remains difficult for most models.

摘要（中文）：近期在多模态基础模型方面的进展，使其能够成为处理多种操作任务的通用物理智能体。然而，在陌生环境中成功运作可能要求智能体在观察中缺失任务相关信息时，通过交互主动寻求该信息：它可能需要确定相关物体的位置、检查未被观察到的属性，或发现不熟悉工具的效果。因此，我们引入了RoboQuest，一个面向目标导向的具身探索的基准测试，其中智能体必须通过物理交互主动获取任务相关信息，利用所得证据调整后续行动，并自主决定何时完成任务的承诺。RoboQuest包含十项移动操作任务，围绕三种不确定性形式：搜索、基于操作的检查以及交互测试。我们通过一个共同的视觉运动接口评估了五个前沿多模态智能体，以及一个在我们发布的完整演示数据集上微调的\( \pi_{0.5} \)策略。表现最佳的智能体仅在23%的轮次中成功，而微调策略几乎从未成功。对构成这些任务的执行技能的孤立测试（提供隐藏信息）显示，智能体能够执行大部分所需动作，我们的失败分析将少数失败归因于执行环节。进一步的分析发现，智能体常常过早停止探索，因为它们在观察到完成任务的必要证据之前就做出了决策。我们还发现，智能体很少防止或修复其探索过程中造成的干扰。此外，通过试错进行学习对大多数模型而言仍然困难重重。

Authors: Liu Renhang, Navonil Majumder, Tej Deep Pala, Soujanya Poria

OpenViTac: Learning and Benchmarking Visuo-Tactile Policies in a Unified Sim-and-Real Framework VLA

visuo-tactile manipulation tactile representation sim-to-real VLA policies benchmark

简要说明：OpenViTac 提出了一个统一的仿真与真实世界视觉-触觉操作基准，将接触丰富的任务组织为四个能力维度，用于评估 VLA、WAM 和 VTLA 策略，并提出了 OpenVTLA，一种通过最佳触觉表示和集成策略增强预训练 VLA 模型的触觉增强框架。

TLDR: OpenViTac introduces a unified sim-and-real benchmark for visuo-tactile manipulation, organizing contact-rich tasks into four capability dimensions to evaluate VLA, WAM, and VTLA policies, and proposes OpenVTLA, a tactile augmentation framework that improves pretrained VLA models with the best tactile representation and integration strategy.

Abstract: Tactile feedback provides embodied agents with physical information beyond visual observations, enabling more reliable interaction with the real world. However, despite the rapid progress of vision-tactile-language-action (VTLA) policies, there remains a lack of unified benchmarks for evaluating tactile-enabled robot manipulation across simulation and the real world. To address this gap, we introduce OpenViTac, a visuo-tactile manipulation benchmark for evaluating robot policies across simulation and the real world. OpenViTac organizes contact-rich manipulation into four tactile-relevant capability dimensions and provides paired simulation-real-world settings for consistent evaluation of VLA, WAM, and VTLA policies. Building upon this benchmark, we investigate how different tactile representations and integration strategies affect the performance of pretrained VLA models. Correspondingly, we introduce OpenVTLA, a tactile augmentation framework that combines the best-performing representation and integration strategy. Furthermore, we leverage the paired benchmark setting to study sim-real co-training and analyze factors affecting cross-domain policy learning. Together, OpenViTac provides a unified platform for evaluating and advancing visuo-tactile robot manipulation.

摘要（中文）：触觉反馈为具身智能体提供了超越视觉观测的物理信息，使其能够更可靠地与真实世界进行交互。然而，尽管视觉-触觉-语言-动作（VTLA）策略取得了快速发展，目前仍缺乏统一的基准来评估跨仿真和真实世界的触觉增强机器人操作。为解决这一问题，我们提出了OpenViTac——一个用于在仿真和真实世界中评估机器人策略的视觉-触觉操作基准。OpenViTac将接触密集操作归纳为四个与触觉相关的能力维度，并提供仿真-真实世界配对设置，以一致地评估VLA、WAM和VTLA策略。基于该基准，我们研究了不同触觉表示和集成策略如何影响预训练VLA模型的性能。相应地，我们提出了OpenVTLA，一个结合了最优表示和集成策略的触觉增强框架。此外，我们利用配对基准设置研究仿真-真实协同训练，并分析影响跨域策略学习的因素。OpenViTac共同为评估和推进视觉-触觉机器人操作提供了一个统一平台。

Authors: Yifan Wu, Qin Li, Nan Min, Guojin Zhong, Haoyu Zhao, Zhiyuan Li, Houze Xu, Shengqi Xu, Xingyao Lin, Zijie Diao, Zhaoxiang Liu, Shiguo Lian, Shunlin Lu, Shihao Zhao, Ziyi Ye, Zuxuan Wu, Yu-Gang Jiang

Energy-Efficient Gait Adaptation via Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning for Quadrupedal Locomotion Across Diverse Terrains Locomotion

hierarchical reinforcement learning gait adaptation energy efficiency quadrupedal locomotion sim-to-real transfer

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于四足机器人运动的分层强化学习框架，将高频关节控制与低频步态适应分离以最小化能量消耗，并在 Unitree AlienGo 机器人上实现了零样本仿真到现实的迁移。

TLDR: This paper proposes a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework for quadrupedal locomotion that separates high-frequency joint control from low-frequency gait adaptation to minimize energy consumption, achieving zero-shot sim-to-real transfer on a Unitree AlienGo robot.

Abstract: While energy efficiency is a critical objective for legged-robot locomotion control, achieving low energy consumption while maintaining robust performance across different velocity ranges and terrain conditions remains a key challenge. This is particularly true for end-to-end RL policies, where gait generation, motion execution, and energy optimization are tightly coupled, leading to high sensitivity to reward design. In this work, we propose a hierarchical reinforcement learning (HRL) framework that separates a high-frequency policy for stable and robust joint-level motion execution from low-frequency gait adaptation that explicitly minimizes the cost of transport (CoT). The three-stage Isaac-based training procedure enables zero-shot sim-to-real transfer with improved tracking accuracy, robustness, and energy efficiency. The learned hierarchy exhibits automatic speed-dependent gait adaptation, transitioning from pacing at low speeds to trotting at higher speeds. We validate the proposed approach in simulation against representative single-policy and hierarchical locomotion baselines, demonstrating reduced CoT over a broad range of commanded velocities, while maintaining robust locomotion across flat, uneven rough, and inclined terrains. We further demonstrate its practical feasibility through zero-shot deployment on a physical Unitree AlienGo quadruped.

摘要（中文）：虽然能效是腿式机器人运动控制的关键目标，但在不同速度范围和地形条件下，实现低能耗同时保持稳健性能仍然是一项核心挑战。这一问题对于端到端强化学习策略尤为突出，因为步态生成、运动执行和能量优化紧密耦合，导致对奖励设计高度敏感。在本研究中，我们提出了一种分层强化学习（HRL）框架，将用于稳定且稳健的关节级运动执行的高频策略，与显式最小化运输成本（CoT）的低频步态适应相分离。基于Isaac的三阶段训练流程实现了零样本仿真到现实的迁移，提升了跟踪精度、鲁棒性和能效。学习到的分层结构展现出随速度自动调整的步态适应能力，从低速时的踱步步态过渡到高速时的小跑步态。我们在仿真中将所提方法与具有代表性的单策略及分层运动基线进行对比验证，结果表明在广泛指令速度范围内运输成本显著降低，同时在地面平坦、崎岖不平及倾斜地形上均保持稳健运动。此外，我们通过在实体Unitree AlienGo四足机器人上的零样本部署，进一步验证了该方法的实际可行性。

Authors: Ammar Issa, Anubhav Singh, Anton Tsaritsin, Sergey Kolyubin

Temporal Visuo-Tactile Learning for Dexterous Grasp Stability Manipulation

grasp stability prediction visuo-tactile learning dexterous manipulation temporal multimodal models Digit 360 sensors

简要说明：本文研究了高分辨率动态触觉感知如何提高灵巧手抓取稳定性预测，并引入了包含10,000次抓取试验的视觉-触觉数据集和时序多模态模型，在真实机器人重抓取中提升了10.5个百分点的成功率。

TLDR: This paper investigates how high-resolution dynamic tactile sensing improves grasp stability prediction for dexterous robotic hands, introducing a 10,000-trial visuo-tactile dataset and a temporal multimodal model that boosts real-robot regrasping success by 10.5 percentage points.

Abstract: Humans can grasp everyday objects with almost perfect success rates using fingertip tactile feedback, yet much of the robotic grasping literature emphasizes vision-based grasp selection with parallel grippers. In this work, we systematically investigate how high-resolution, dynamic tactile sensing contributes to grasp stability prediction and model-guided grasping in dexterous robotic hands. To this end, we collected a dataset of 10,000 grasp trials across 200 objects using a multi-fingered robotic hand equipped with four Digit 360 tactile sensors, recording external vision, proprioception, and tactile streams throughout each grasp. With this dataset, we trained end-to-end temporal multimodal models to predict post-lift stability from pre-lift grasp observations and compared sensing modalities and encoding backbones. Experimental results and controlled input ablations show that incorporating touch, and particularly high-resolution, dynamic touch, improves grasp stability prediction. Finally, we deployed the learned predictor as an online stability gate on the real robot, where visuo-tactile model-guided regrasping improved the success rate among executed lifts by 10.5 percentage points over a non-tactile gate. These results show how rich fingertip sensing and expressive temporal models that capture the dynamics of touch can support learned grasping with multi-fingered hands without explicit contact or force modeling, providing a scalable data-driven path from tactile experience toward stable dexterous manipulation. The dataset is publicly available at https://lasr-lab.github.io/dexterous-grasp-stability/.

摘要（中文）：人类几乎可以凭借指尖触觉反馈，以近乎完美的成功率抓取日常物品，然而大量机器人抓取文献却侧重于基于视觉的平行夹爪抓取选择。在本研究中，我们系统地探讨了高分辨率、动态触觉感知如何促进灵巧机器人手的抓取稳定性预测及模型引导抓取。为此，我们使用配备四个Digit 360触觉传感器的多指机器人手，在200个物体上收集了10,000次抓取试验的数据集，并在每次抓取过程中记录外部视觉、本体感觉及触觉流数据。基于该数据集，我们训练了端到端的时序多模态模型，以从抓取前观测中预测提升后的稳定性，并比较了不同感知模态与编码骨干网络。实验结果及受控输入消融研究表明，融合触觉信息，尤其是高分辨率动态触觉信息，能够提升抓取稳定性预测。最后，我们将所学习的预测器作为在线稳定性门控部署于真实机器人上，相较于无触觉门控，视觉-触觉模型引导的重新抓取将执行提升的成功率提高了10.5个百分点。这些结果展示了丰富的指尖感知及捕捉触觉动态的具表达力时序模型，如何在不依赖显式接触或力建模的情况下支持多指手的习得性抓取，为从触觉经验迈向稳定灵巧操作提供了一条可扩展的数据驱动路径。该数据集公开获取于 https://lasr-lab.github.io/dexterous-grasp-stability/。

Authors: Ken Nakahara, Aleksei Buvailik, Prokhor Kotov, Roberto Calandra

Do Vision-Language-Action Models Understand Instructions? A Mechanistic Interpretability Study on Language Grounding VLA

mechanistic interpretability language grounding activation patching attribution patching LIBERO benchmark

简要说明：本文通过机械可解释性方法研究了两个VLA模型（π0.5和GR00T N1.7）的语言接地能力，发现两者对抽象改写不敏感，但对方向性语言敏感，且因果定位和归因可靠性因模型而异。

TLDR: This paper investigates the language grounding capabilities of two VLA models (π0.5 and GR00T N1.7) using mechanistic interpretability methods, finding that both are insensitive to abstract rephrasing but sensitive to directional language, with varying causal loci and attribution reliability.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action models are designed to generalise across environments and task descriptions, raising the question of whether their action generation actually depends on the language instruction, or whether they largely rely on visual cues and superficial correlations. Robustness to variance in the visual and linguistic observation space is critical for real-world deployment, yet VLAs lack explicit grounding modules and instead rely on the intrinsic language grounding capabilities of their Vision-Language model backbones. For this reason, we conduct a controlled mechanistic interpretability study on the language grounding capabilities of two state-of-the-art Vision-Language-Action models, $π_{0.5}$ and GR00T N1.7, by applying activation and attribution patching to the residual stream of the action generation modules. We systematically corrupt the task instruction of input samples of the LIBERO benchmark following five strategies: synonym replacement, semantic scaling, directional corruption, random object substitution, and empty string. Our experiments find that both models are comparatively insensitive to abstract rephrasing and to referencing non-existent objects, but react strongly to empty task descriptions and, especially, to directional language. During action generation, this sensitivity is concentrated in different loci for each model: mainly in the early, periodic cross-attention layers for GR00T N1.7, versus distributed across the earliest and selected later layers for $π_{0.5}$. For GR00T N1.7, directional perturbations drive some of the largest causal effects while leaving the internal representational geometry comparatively unchanged, a dissociation we do not observe clearly for $π_{0.5}$. Finally, the reliability of attribution patching is model-dependent: it closely tracks activation patching for GR00T N1.7 but not for $π_{0.5}$.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作模型旨在跨环境和任务描述进行泛化，这引出了一个关键问题：其动作生成究竟是否真正依赖于语言指令，还是在很大程度上依赖视觉线索和表面相关性。对于现实世界的部署而言，对视觉和语言观测空间中的变化保持鲁棒性至关重要，然而VLA模型缺乏显式的接地模块，而是依赖其视觉-语言模型骨干网络固有的语言接地能力。为此，我们针对两个最先进的视觉-语言-动作模型——π₀.5和GR00T N1.7，开展了一项受控的机制可解释性研究，通过将激活修补（activation patching）和归因修补（attribution patching）应用于动作生成模块的残差流，考察其语言接地能力。我们按照五种策略系统性地破坏LIBERO基准测试中样本的任务指令：同义词替换、语义缩放、方向性破坏、随机物体替换以及空字符串。实验发现，两个模型对抽象改写和引用不存在物体的操作相对不敏感，但对空任务描述，尤其是方向性语言，反应强烈。在动作生成过程中，这种敏感性在两个模型中集中在不同的位点：GR00T N1.7主要集中于早期的周期性交叉注意力层，而π₀.5则分布在最早层和选定的较后层。对于GR00T N1.7，方向性扰动产生了某些最大的因果效应，同时内部表征几何结构相对保持不变，而这种分离现象在π₀.5中并未明显观察到。最后，归因修补的可靠性依赖于具体模型：它与GR00T N1.7的激活修补结果高度吻合，但π₀.5则不吻合。

Authors: Theodor Wulff, Angelo Cangelosi

RealtimeWAM: How Fast Can I Run My World Action Model? WorldModel

world action model low-latency inference parallel execution adaptive computation feature reuse

简要说明：RealtimeWAM 是一个无需训练的框架，通过层间依赖重叠观测处理与预测，并利用选择性特征重用的自适应计算来降低世界动作模型的推理延迟，在 FastWAM 和 OpenWAM 上实现了显著加速，同时在仿真和真实机器人操作中保持或提高了任务成功率。

TLDR: RealtimeWAM is a training-free framework that reduces inference latency in World Action Models by overlapping observation processing and prediction through layerwise dependencies and adaptive computation via selective feature reuse, achieving significant speedups on FastWAM and OpenWAM while maintaining or improving task success rates in simulation and real-world robotic manipulation.

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) combine visual dynamics modeling with action generation, but their high inference latency limits responsive robot control. Recent efforts accelerate inference by removing explicit future-video generation at test time, as in FastWAM, an approach that requires a specially tailored architectural design. More general caching strategies exploit feature redundancy, but redundancy alone does not capture the changing computational demands of closed-loop control. To address these challenges, we present RealtimeWAM, a general, training-free framework that coordinates parallel execution with adaptive computation for low-latency inference across diverse WAM architectures. We exploit layerwise dependencies to overlap observation processing with prediction. However, concurrent branches still compete for GPU resources, limiting the benefit of parallel execution. We therefore adapt computation throughout the pipeline through selective reuse, caching observation features in visually stable regions and reusing Transformer residuals while reserving additional refinement for small predicted adjustments. We evaluate RealtimeWAM on FastWAM and OpenWAM across RoboTwin, LIBERO, and LIBERO-Plus. On an RTX 4090, measured mean inference latencies are 24.09 and 63.09 ms, corresponding to average speedups of 8.90$\times$ and 10.67$\times$. Average success rates are 82.75% and 87.41%, respectively, within 0.02 and 0.53 percentage points of native inference. Across five real-world tasks, RealtimeWAM improves average success rates over native inference by 17.2 and 37.2 percentage points on FastWAM and OpenWAM, respectively.

摘要（中文）：世界动作模型（WAMs）将视觉动态建模与动作生成相结合，但其高推理延迟限制了机器人的实时控制能力。近期研究通过省去测试阶段的显式未来视频生成来加速推理，如FastWAM，该方法需要专门定制的架构设计。更通用的缓存策略利用特征冗余，但仅靠冗余无法捕捉闭环控制中不断变化的计算需求。为解决这些挑战，我们提出RealtimeWAM，一种通用的、无需训练的框架，将并行执行与自适应计算相协调，在多种WAM架构上实现低延迟推理。我们利用层间依赖关系将观测处理与预测重叠进行。然而，并行分支仍会竞争GPU资源，限制并行执行的收益。因此，我们通过选择性复用在整个流程中自适应调整计算量，在视觉稳定区域缓存观测特征，复用Transformer残差，同时为小幅预测调整保留额外的细化计算。我们在FastWAM和OpenWAM上，基于RoboTwin、LIBERO和LIBERO-Plus数据集对RealtimeWAM进行评估。在RTX 4090上，测得的平均推理延迟分别为24.09毫秒和63.09毫秒，对应平均加速比为8.90倍和10.67倍。平均成功率分别为82.75%和87.41%，与原生推理相差仅0.02和0.53个百分点。在五项真实世界任务中，与原生推理相比，RealtimeWAM在FastWAM和OpenWAM上的平均成功率分别提升了17.2和37.2个百分点。

Authors: Huanan Liu, Ye Li, Kangye Ji, Xiaoyu Chen, Hanyun Cui, Yutian Shen, Yuan Meng, Chenglei Wu, Jingyan Jiang, Bo Li, Zhi Wang

Beyond Policy Support: Interaction Constrained Offline Reinforcement Learning for Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

offline reinforcement learning interaction distribution shift autonomous driving contrastive density-ratio estimation closed-loop evaluation

简要说明：本文提出了ICDP，一种用于自动驾驶的离线强化学习框架，通过对比密度比估计将联合支持退化分解为自我支持分量和交互支持分量，显式约束交互级分布偏移，并在nuPlan、Interplan和真实卡车实验中展示了在交互关键驾驶场景中的性能提升。

TLDR: This paper proposes ICDP, an offline reinforcement learning framework for autonomous driving that explicitly constrains interaction-level distribution shift by decomposing joint-support degradation into ego-support and interaction-support components, using contrastive density-ratio estimation. It demonstrates improved performance in interaction-critical driving scenarios in closed-loop evaluations on nuPlan, Interplan, and real-world truck experiments.

Abstract: Offline reinforcement learning enables reward-driven policy improvement from fixed datasets without requiring online exploration, making it particularly attractive in safety-critical domains. A central challenge, however, is distribution shift: policy optimization may favor actions that are weakly supported by the offline data, rendering value estimates unreliable. Existing approaches primarily control this shift in the policy's own action space. In interactive environments such as autonomous driving, this can be insufficient: a candidate ego trajectory may remain well supported under the marginal behavior distribution while being poorly supported jointly with the surrounding-agent behavior observed in the logged interaction. We refer to this degradation in interaction support as \emph{interaction distribution shift} (IDS), and introduce \emph{Interaction-Constrained Drive Policy} (ICDP), an offline reinforcement learning framework that explicitly controls interaction-level distribution shift. Starting from the joint data distribution over ego and surrounding-agent futures, we show that joint-support degradation decomposes exactly into an ego-support component and a residual interaction-support component. We recover the latter through contrastive density-ratio estimation, isolating interaction compatibility without explicit joint-density modeling, surrounding-agent prediction, or rollouts in reactive simulators or learned world models during policy optimization. Closed-loop evaluations on nuPlan, Interplan and real-world truck experiments show that ICDP suppresses high-value yet interaction-unsupported trajectory selections and improves performance in interaction-critical driving scenarios. Project webpage: https://mahmoud-selim.github.io/ICDP/

摘要（中文）：离线强化学习使得从固定数据集中进行奖励驱动的策略改进成为可能，且无需在线探索，这使其在安全关键领域尤为具有吸引力。然而，一个核心挑战在于分布偏移：策略优化可能倾向于选择在离线数据中支持度较弱的动作，从而导致价值估计不可靠。现有方法主要在该策略自身的动作空间内控制这种偏移。在诸如自动驾驶等交互式环境中，这种做法可能并不充分：候选自车轨迹在边际行为分布下可能具有良好的支持度，但在与日志数据中记录的环境智能体行为联合考量时，其联合支持度却可能较低。我们将这种交互支持度的退化称为\emph{交互分布偏移}（IDS），并引入\emph{交互约束驾驶策略}（ICDP）——一种显式控制交互级分布偏移的离线强化学习框架。从自车与环境智能体未来轨迹的联合数据分布出发，我们证明联合支持度的退化可精确分解为自车支持度分量和残差交互支持度分量。我们通过对比密度比估计恢复后者，从而在策略优化过程中无需显式联合密度建模、环境智能体预测，也无需在反应式模拟器或学习的世界模型中进行 rollout，即可隔离交互兼容性。在nuPlan、Interplan上的闭环评估以及真实卡车实验中，ICDP抑制了高价值但缺乏交互支持的轨迹选择，并在交互关键驾驶场景中提升了性能。项目网页：https://mahmoud-selim.github.io/ICDP/

Authors: Mahmoud Selim, Cristina Cipriani, Karl Henrik Johansson

ΔWAM: Distilling Action Tangent Fields into World Action Models WorldModel

World Action Models Action Tangent Fields Residual-VAE Action-conditioned world model Distillation

简要说明：该论文提出了动作切向场，通过将动作条件世界模型的监督蒸馏到世界动作模型中，聚焦于与动作相关的动态，从而在没有大规模预训练的情况下提高对环境扰动的鲁棒性。

TLDR: The paper introduces Action Tangent Fields, a method to distill action-conditioned world model supervision into World Action Models by focusing on action-relevant dynamics, improving robustness to environmental perturbations without large-scale pretraining.

Abstract: World Action Models (WAM) improve robot policies by augmenting sparse action supervision with dense future prediction. However, much of the predictable future is dominated by appearance and scene persistence rather than action-dependent dynamics. We observe that several recent WAM designs, including optical flow, motion-centric representations, and latent actions, can be understood from a common perspective in which world supervision becomes more efficient as it contains a higher proportion of action-relevant variation. Based on this insight, we introduce Action Tangent Fields, which reformulate world supervision through a local Taylor expansion of how actions induce changes in future dynamics. We represent future dynamics in Residual-VAE space, where the future latent remains recoverable from the current latent and its residual, and use a strong action-conditioned world model (ACWM) to probe the local correspondence between action variations and residual-world variations. This local first-order structure is distilled into the WAM to guide its denoising supervision toward dynamics that are more tightly coupled to action, rather than merely predictable from appearance. Across LIBERO-Plus, RoboTwin, and RoboTwin2.0-Plus, our method consistently improves robustness to lighting, background, camera, layout, and other environmental perturbations. Despite using no large-scale embodied pretraining, it achieves stronger robustness under several distribution shifts than pretrained policies. We further distill multi-step VideoDiT denoising into a single step for efficient inference. Our results suggest that effective WAM supervision should remain information-rich while concentrating its predictive capacity on the directions along which actions change the future.

摘要（中文）：世界动作模型（WAM）通过用密集的未来预测增强稀疏的动作监督来改进机器人策略。然而，可预测的未来很大程度上由外观和场景持续性主导，而非依赖于动作的动态变化。我们观察到，近期几种WAM设计，包括光流、以运动为中心的表征和潜在动作，可以从一个共同视角来理解，即当世界监督中包含更高比例的动作相关变化时，其效率会更高。基于这一见解，我们引入了动作切向量场（Action Tangent Fields），通过动作如何引发未来动态变化的局部泰勒展开来重新构建世界监督。我们在残差变分自编码器（Residual-VAE）空间中表示未来动态，其中未来潜在表示可从当前潜在表示及其残差中恢复，并使用强动作条件世界模型（ACWM）来探测动作变化与残差世界变化之间的局部对应关系。这种局部一阶结构被蒸馏到WAM中，引导其去噪监督朝向与动作更紧密耦合的动态，而非仅可从外观预测的内容。在LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin和RoboTwin2.0-Plus上，我们的方法持续提升了对光照、背景、相机、布局及其他环境扰动的鲁棒性。尽管未使用大规模具身预训练，在多种分布偏移下，它仍比预训练策略实现了更强的鲁棒性。我们进一步将多步VideoDiT去噪蒸馏为单步，以实现高效推理。我们的结果表明，有效的WAM监督应保持信息丰富，同时将其预测能力集中在动作改变未来的方向上。

Authors: Ke Wu, Hanwen Huang, Bo Gu, Kaizhao Zhang, Xiangting Meng, Yupeng Zheng, Zijun Xu, Jieru Zhao, Wenchao Ding

YUBI-STAG: Contact and Semantic-Rich Alignment for VLAs via Automated Video-Language Grounding VLA

VLA annotation grounding bimanual contact segmentation

简要说明：YUBI-STAG 利用分割和视觉语言模型自动为机器人操作演示添加细粒度的接触和语义注释，并将其蒸馏为 YUBI-VLM 以高效注释；在这些注释上对 VLA 策略进行后训练可提高指令跟随和双臂控制能力。

TLDR: YUBI-STAG automatically enriches robot manipulation demonstrations with fine-grained contact and semantic annotations using segmentation and VLMs, and distills this into YUBI-VLM for efficient annotation; post-training VLA policies on these annotations improves instruction following and bimanual control.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models acquire broad manipulation capabilities via large-scale pretraining, yet eliciting them through language requires fine-grained alignment between instructions and physical interactions. Existing robot demonstrations typically provide only coarse task descriptions, omitting how actions are executed, including which gripper acts, which object is contacted, and how it is grasped and moved. We introduce YUBI-STAG, a framework for Spatio-Temporal Annotation and Grounding that automatically enriches manipulation demonstrations with interaction-rich semantics to align pretrained VLAs with fine-grained manipulation language. Combining contact-object segmentation with vision-language models, YUBI-STAG annotates object identities, attributes and states, per-gripper actions, bimanual coordination, and spatially grounded interactions. To address YUBI-STAG's reliance on localized sequences and multi-stage VLM inference, we distill it into YUBI-VLM. YUBI-VLM directly recovers action structure and annotations from raw, unsegmented video in few inference calls and operates from wrist views alone. We evaluate both frameworks on YUBI-STAG-Bench across temporal, semantic, and spatial grounding tasks. YUBI-VLM retains much of YUBI-STAG's annotation accuracy with fewer inference calls and shorter runtime while generalizing to unseen manipulations. Finally, post-training VLA policies on these annotations aligns them with fine-grained language and contact-aware structure. Bimanual experiments demonstrate improved performance and instruction following, including control over object identity, acting gripper, target location, and spatial relations absent from original labels.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过大规模预训练获得了广泛的操作能力，但通过语言引导这些能力需要在指令与物理交互之间实现细粒度的对齐。现有的机器人演示通常仅提供粗略的任务描述，省略了动作的执行方式，包括哪个夹爪执行操作、接触哪个物体，以及如何抓取和移动该物体。我们提出YUBI-STAG，一个时空标注与对齐（Spatio-Temporal Annotation and Grounding）框架，能够自动为操作演示丰富交互相关的语义，从而将预训练的VLA模型与细粒度的操作语言对齐。该框架结合接触物体分割与视觉-语言模型，对物体身份、属性和状态、各夹爪动作、双手协调以及空间定位的交互进行标注。为解决YUBI-STAG对局部序列和多阶段VLM推理的依赖，我们将其蒸馏为YUBI-VLM。YUBI-VLM能够直接从原始未分割的视频中，以少量推理调用恢复动作结构和标注，并仅依靠腕部视角即可运行。我们在YUBI-STAG-Bench上对两个框架进行了时间、语义和空间定位任务的评估。YUBI-VLM在减少推理调用和缩短运行时间的同时，保留了YUBI-STAG的大部分标注准确性，并能泛化到未见过的操作场景。最后，基于这些标注对VLA策略进行后训练，使其与细粒度语言和接触感知结构对齐。双手操作的实验表明，策略性能和指令跟随能力均有提升，包括对物体身份、执行夹爪、目标位置以及原始标签中不存在的空间关系的控制。

Authors: Masatoshi Tateno, Takehiko Ohkawa, Yueh-Hua Wu, Hanlong Li, Tatsuya Matsushima, Yoichi Sato, Kei Ota

Adaptive Code Generation for Controlling Robots VLA

Large Language Models Vision-Language Model code generation replanning robotic control

简要说明：本文提出一种双AI框架，结合LLM进行代码生成和VLM进行语义基础，通过受限、反应式代码生成和重新规划，使机器人能够在动态环境中执行高级自然语言意图。

TLDR: This paper presents a dual-AI framework combining an LLM for code generation and a VLM for semantic grounding, enabling robots to execute high-level natural language intentions in dynamic environments through constrained, reactive code generation and replanning.

Abstract: Deploying robots as Complex Adaptive Systems (CAS) in unknown and dynamic environments necessitates a transition from rigid command libraries toward intention-based autonomy, as natural language represents the only medium capable of articulating complex goals beyond the capacity of finite instruction sets. While Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a path toward natural language goal description, their integration introduces significant challenges: the formalization gap between imprecise intentions and executable actions, the taxonomy gap induced by unpredictable environments, and the challenge of maintaining temporal state and progress awareness. This work introduces an architectural framework that enables robotic control by leveraging generative AI. The system follows a dual-AI design: an LLM translates high-level intentions into executable program code restricted to a formal robotic library and constrained by verifiable syntax, while a Vision-Language Model (VLM) provides semantic grounding via a distillation process. To ensure robustness, the framework incorporates environment-driven replanning triggers based on geometric and semantic thresholds, complemented by continuous runtime monitoring and an adaptive planning loop. Benchmarked across frontier models, our framework architecture demonstrates that grounding generative AI in a reactive, constrained loop enables robust fulfillment of complex intentions in dynamic and unknown environments.

摘要（中文）：将机器人作为复杂自适应系统部署在未知和动态环境中，需要从刚性指令库向基于意图的自主性转变，因为自然语言是唯一能够表达超出有限指令集范围的复杂目标的中介。尽管大型语言模型（LLMs）为自然语言目标描述提供了途径，但其集成引发了重大挑战：不精确意图与可执行动作之间的形式化差距、由不可预测环境引发的分类差距，以及维持时间状态和进度意识的挑战。本研究提出了一种架构框架，通过利用生成式人工智能实现机器人控制。该系统采用双AI设计：一个LLM将高层意图转换为受限的正式机器人库中的可执行程序代码，并通过可验证语法加以约束；同时，一个视觉-语言模型（VLM）通过蒸馏过程提供语义基础。为确保鲁棒性，该框架引入了基于几何和语义阈值的环境驱动重规划触发器，并辅以持续运行时监控和自适应规划循环。在多个前沿模型上进行的基准测试表明，我们的框架架构证明了将生成式人工智能置于反应性、受限循环中，能够在动态和未知环境中实现复杂意图的稳健履行。
