Authors: Justus Flerlage, Thorsten Wittkopp, Alexander Acker, Odej Kao

Point It, Strike It: Direction-Conditioned Dynamic Manipulation of Deformable Linear Objects Manipulation

deformable linear object dynamic manipulation sim-to-real flow matching simulator acceleration

简要说明：本文提出了TRACE和RECAP，用于可变形线性物体的方向条件动态操作，利用加速模拟器(DeformX2.0)和流匹配策略，在仿真中达到高精度，并在真实机器人上提高了成功率。

TLDR: This paper introduces TRACE and RECAP for direction-conditioned dynamic manipulation of deformable linear objects, using an accelerated simulator (DeformX2.0) and a flow-matching policy to achieve high accuracy in simulation and improved success on a real robot.

Abstract: Goal-conditioned dynamic manipulation of deformable linear objects has mainly specified goals as positions for a rope tip to reach. Many tasks, however, depend on how the tip arrives. We therefore study single-swing rope striking with goals that specify the tip's 3D position and arrival direction, across the workspace and on different ropes. This is challenging because rope dynamics are hard to model, no demonstrations exist, distinct swings reach the same goal with different reliability, and the sim-to-real gap extends beyond the rope. To address these challenges, we extend the state-of-the-art DLO simulator DeformX with GPU acceleration, a stable Cosserat rod solver, and a cross-flow aerodynamic model, yielding DeformX2.0, which is more than $20{,}000\times$ faster. We then propose TRACE (Trace-rooted Adaptive Cross-Entropy), which generates striking data by warm-starting each new target from the stored swing whose tip path passes closest to it. Its cost penalizes rope bending and abrupt tip motion to favor repeatable swings. A conditional flow-matching policy trained on this data reaches 92.1% accuracy in simulation. Finally, we propose RECAP (Residual Calibration Policy), which fits the simulator's rope and rig parameters to a few calibration swings and adapts actions with a correction policy trained in simulation. On a real robot, across three ropes, RECAP raises success within 5cm from 72% to 87% for position goals, and within 10cm and 10° from 50% to 79% for goals that also specify the arrival direction.

摘要（中文）：目标条件下的可变形线性物体动态操作通常将目标定义为绳端需要到达的位置。然而，许多任务取决于绳端到达的方式。因此，我们研究了单次挥动绳索击打任务，其目标同时指定绳端的三维位置和到达方向，覆盖整个工作空间并适用于不同绳索。这一任务具有挑战性，因为绳索动力学难以建模、不存在示范数据、不同挥动方式到达同一目标的可靠性各异，且仿真到现实的差距超出了绳索本身的范围。为应对这些挑战，我们对最先进的DLO仿真器DeformX进行了扩展，加入了GPU加速、稳定的Cosserat杆求解器和横流气动模型，形成了DeformX2.0，其速度提升了超过$20{,}000$倍。随后，我们提出了TRACE（基于轨迹根的自适应交叉熵方法），该方法通过从存储的挥动轨迹中选择绳端路径最接近新目标的挥动作为热启动，生成击打数据。其代价函数对绳索弯曲和绳端突变运动进行惩罚，以偏向可重复的挥动方式。基于这些数据训练的条件流匹配策略在仿真中达到了92.1%的准确率。最后，我们提出了RECAP（残差校准策略），该策略通过若干次校准挥动拟合仿真器的绳索和装置参数，并利用在仿真中训练的校正策略调整动作。在真实机器人上，针对三种绳索，RECAP将位置目标在5cm误差内的成功率从72%提升至87%，对同时指定到达方向的目标，在10cm和10°误差内的成功率从50%提升至79%。

Authors: Yi Yang, Xiang Fei, Lehong Wang, Zilin Dai, Ruogu Li, Jiting Cai, Liyao Chang, Xinyi Yang, Henry Kou, Ruijie Fu, Lu Li, Howie Choset

Targeted Modality Dropout for Real-Robot Manipulation Robust to Intermittent Vision Loss Manipulation

Targeted Modality Dropout multimodal imitation learning robustness to vision loss bimanual manipulation entropy regularization

简要说明：本文提出目标模态丢弃（TMD）方法，通过注意力估计模态依赖并选择性丢弃主导模态，结合熵正则化，使模仿学习策略在视觉丢失时保持鲁棒；在双臂真实机器人操作实验中，TMD在视觉丢失下维持任务执行，而传统随机丢弃则失败。

TLDR: This paper introduces Targeted Modality Dropout (TMD), a method that estimates modality dependence via attention and selectively drops the dominant modality during training, combined with entropy regularization, to make imitation learning policies robust to vision loss; real-robot bimanual manipulation experiments show TMD maintains task execution under vision loss while conventional random dropout fails.

Abstract: Imitation learning policies that integrate multiple sensory modalities are prone to overreliance on a dominant modality, such as vision, during training, which can disrupt policy execution when that modality is lost at inference time. In this paper, we introduce Targeted Modality Dropout (TMD), in which the dependence on each modality is estimated using attention and the most dominant modality is selectively dropped. This is combined with entropy regularization over the dependence distribution. Through real-robot evaluation using a bimanual manipulator, we show that under vision loss the success rate of the baseline policy drops substantially, whereas TMD sustains task execution. In contrast, a conventional dropout that selects the dropped modality at random, without the entropy regularization, fails on many tasks even without vision loss.

摘要（中文）：模仿学习策略在整合多种感官模态时，容易在训练过程中过度依赖某一种主导模态（如视觉），当推理时该模态丢失，策略执行便会受到干扰。本文提出了一种目标模态丢弃（TMD）方法，通过注意力机制估计各模态的依赖程度，并选择性地丢弃最主导的模态。同时，结合对依赖分布的熵正则化处理。通过使用双臂操作机器人的真实机器人评估，我们表明，在视觉丢失的情况下，基线策略的成功率大幅下降，而TMD能够维持任务执行。相比之下，未采用熵正则化且随机选择丢弃模态的常规丢弃方法，即使在视觉未丢失的情况下，也在多项任务中失败。

Authors: Genki Shikada, Kazuki Osamura, Masaru Ide, Tetsuya Ogata, Kanata Suzuki

Contact-Aware Imitation Learning Through Contact Factorization Manipulation

contact-rich manipulation imitation learning contact factorization force generalization robot policy

简要说明：FACE 提出一种接触因子化的模仿学习框架，将任务意图与环境依赖的接触条件分离，通过学习的接触法线和摩擦估计器调整力观测和策略输出，使真实机器人接触丰富操作在未知表面变化下稳健泛化。

TLDR: FACE introduces a contact-factorized imitation learning framework that separates task intent from environment-dependent contact conditions, using learned contact-normal and friction estimators to adapt force observations and policy outputs for robust real-robot contact-rich manipulation under unseen surface variations.

Abstract: Generalizable contact-rich manipulation requires robots to preserve intended task behavior while adapting its physical realization to changing contact conditions. However, interaction forces can vary substantially with small changes in surface geometry, orientation, and friction, making policies trained directly on raw force measurements difficult to transfer beyond demonstrated conditions. We introduce FACE, a contact-factorized imitation learning framework that separates intended task behavior from environment-dependent contact factors. Our representation expresses interaction forces in normalized, contact-relative coordinates, while a learned contact-normal estimator and an online friction estimator infer the local contact normal and effective friction scale. Together, these estimators enable force observations to be encoded and policy outputs to be decoded into physical motion and force commands during execution. In this way, FACE adapts execution to current contact conditions while preserving the intended task behavior, without updating the policy parameters. We evaluate FACE on real-robot contact-rich manipulation under unseen variations in surface properties and geometry, demonstrating robust generalization across contact conditions through controlled comparisons with variants that adapt prior approaches to our setting. Videos and additional materials can be found on the project page: https://rcilab.khu.ac.kr/face.

摘要（中文）：可泛化的接触丰富的操作任务要求机器人在保持预期任务行为的同时，将其物理实现方式适应变化的接触条件。然而，相互作用力会随着表面几何形状、朝向和摩擦力的微小变化而产生显著差异，这使得直接在原始力测量上训练的策略难以推广到演示条件之外。我们提出了FACE，一种接触因式分解的模仿学习框架，将预期任务行为与环境相关的接触因子分离开来。我们的表示方法在归一化的、接触相对坐标中表达相互作用力，同时，一个学习的接触法线估计器和一个在线摩擦力估计器推断局部接触法线和有效摩擦力尺度。这些估计器共同使得在执行过程中，力观测能够被编码，策略输出能够被解码为物理运动和力指令。通过这种方式，FACE在保持预期任务行为的同时，适应当前的接触条件，且无需更新策略参数。我们在真实机器人上，针对表面属性和几何形状的未见变化进行了接触丰富的操作任务评估，通过与适用于我们设置的先前方法变体进行受控比较，展示了在接触条件变化下的鲁棒泛化能力。视频和其他材料可在项目页面找到：https://rcilab.khu.ac.kr/face。

Authors: Jiho Hong, Daeun Song, Sanghyun Kim, Mingyo Seo

Not All Uncertainty Matters: Simulation-in-the-Loop Fast-Slow Reasoning for Decision-Critical Autonomous Driving System AutonomousDriving

fast-slow collaboration expected planning gain simulation-in-the-loop cloud VLM invocation CARLA

简要说明：SIGMA 是一个闭环仿真框架，利用预期规划增益（EPG）决定何时调用云端VLM推理，从而在CARLA中减少不必要的云端交互并提升规划效率。

TLDR: SIGMA is a simulation-in-the-loop framework that uses expected planning gain (EPG) to decide when to invoke cloud VLM reasoning in autonomous driving, reducing unnecessary cloud interactions and improving planning efficiency in CARLA.

Abstract: Large vision-language models (VLMs) provide powerful open-world perception and reasoning for autonomous driving, but their high computational cost and inference latency make continuous cloud-side use impractical. This motivates fast--slow collaboration, where efficient onboard modules handle real-time perception and control while cloud models provide high-level reasoning only when needed. The key challenge is deciding when cloud reasoning should influence time-critical driving decisions. Existing methods often rely on perception uncertainty, heuristic triggers, or resource-driven policies, without assessing whether resolving an uncertainty will improve planning. We propose \textbf{SIGMA}, a simulation-in-the-loop framework for task-oriented fast--slow collaboration. SIGMA embeds the planner into uncertainty assessment and evaluates how plausible scene realizations under semantic and geometric uncertainty affect feasible trajectories and planning cost. Based on these outcomes, it estimates the expected reduction in planning cost from resolving uncertainty. We further introduce expected planning gain (EPG), a decision-level metric for cloud invocation, cloud-guidance integration, and request prioritization under deadline and resource constraints. Experiments in CARLA show that SIGMA reduces unnecessary cloud interactions while improving planning, efficiency, and navigation success in static and dynamic obstacle scenarios. Compared with fixed-period collaboration, SIGMA reduces unnecessary cloud interactions by 50\%, improves navigation success by more than 6\%, and cuts finish time by up to 26.2\% in dynamic scenarios.

摘要（中文）：大型视觉语言模型（VLM）为自动驾驶提供了强大的开放世界感知与推理能力，但其高昂的计算成本和推理延迟使得持续依赖云端使用不切实际。这促使了“快—慢”协作模式的出现，即高效的车载模块负责实时感知与控制，而云端模型仅在需要时提供高层推理。关键挑战在于决定何时云端推理应影响时延敏感型驾驶决策。现有方法通常依赖感知不确定性、启发式触发条件或资源驱动策略，而未评估消解不确定性是否能够改善规划结果。为此，我们提出\textbf{SIGMA}，一种面向任务导向型快—慢协作的仿真闭环框架。SIGMA将规划器嵌入不确定性评估中，考察在语义与几何不确定性下，各种合理场景实现如何影响可行轨迹及规划成本，并据此估计消解不确定性所带来的规划成本预期降幅。我们进一步引入期望规划增益（EPG），一种面向决策层的度量指标，用于在截止时间和资源约束下指导云端调用、云端引导集成及请求优先级排序。在CARLA中的实验表明，SIGMA在静态与动态障碍物场景中减少了不必要的云端交互，同时提升了规划效率与导航成功率。与固定周期协作相比，SIGMA在动态场景中减少了50\%的不必要云端交互，导航成功率提升超过6\%，完成时间最多缩短26.2\%。

Authors: Jiayi Chen, Shuai Wang, Guangxu Zhu, Derrick Wing Kwan Ng, Chengzhong Xu, Kaibin Huang

TERRA: Learning Transportable Latent Actions through Temporal Effect Representation and Relational Alignment VLA

latent actions temporal effect representation relational alignment transportable actions robot manipulation

简要说明：TERRA 提出了一种利用时间效应表示和关系对齐的潜在动作学习方法，提高了机器人操作任务中的动作预测和可迁移性，在 LIBERO 基准上取得了更高的成功率。

TLDR: TERRA introduces a novel latent action learning method using temporal effect representations and relational alignment to improve action prediction and transportability across robot manipulation tasks, achieving higher success rates on LIBERO benchmarks.

Abstract: Latent actions supervise robot policies with action-like codes inferred from visual transitions, and their usefulness hinges on two questions: what a code keeps from a transition, and whether it still means the same thing when reused in a different initial state. The first is a tension in time: an endpoint difference discards how motion unfolds, while the full sequence admits nuisance variation. The second is left open by reconstruction, which only ever observes a latent together with the state it came from. We argue that both questions can be answered in the same place. TERRA (Temporal Effect Representation and Relational Alignment) describes a transition by a compact temporal effect, its net feature change together with a low-order within-window dynamics component, and learns a continuous latent from this effect. The same effect space then serves as the reference for reuse: Effect-Anchored Transport (EAT) decodes a latent in other initial states and anchors the resulting effect to the one observed at its source, so that the latent is shaped by what it does across contexts rather than only by the transition it came from. With frozen linear readers, TERRA predicts actions more accurately than UniVLA and a LAPA-style baseline, degrades more slowly under visual distractors, and keeps transported transitions faithful to the donor action as the recipient context moves farther away; a same-budget control shows that these gains come largely from EAT. At matched pretraining scale, the complete system reaches 93.4% average success on LIBERO, compared with 91.8% for UniVLA.

摘要（中文）：潜在动作通过从视觉转换中推断出的类动作编码来监督机器人策略，其有效性取决于两个问题：编码从一次转换中保留了哪些信息，以及当它在不同的初始状态下被复用时是否仍具有相同的含义。第一个问题涉及时间上的张力：端点差异忽略了动作展开的过程，而完整序列则引入了无关的变异。第二个问题在重建过程中未被解决，因为重建只观察到潜在变量与其来源状态的组合。我们认为这两个问题可以在同一框架内得到解答。TERRA（时间效应表示与关系对齐）通过紧凑的时间效应来描述一次转换，即净特征变化与低阶窗口内动态分量的组合，并从此效应中学习连续潜在变量。同一效应空间随后作为复用的参考：效应锚定传输（EAT）在其他初始状态下解码潜在变量，并将由此产生的效应锚定到其来源处观察到的效应上，从而使潜在变量由其跨情境的行为塑造，而不仅仅由其来源的转换决定。在冻结线性读取器的情况下，TERRA 在动作预测上比 UniVLA 和 LAPA 风格的基线更为准确，在视觉干扰下退化更慢，并且当接收者情境距离更远时，能保持传输后的转换忠实于供体动作；同一预算的对照实验表明，这些提升主要来自 EAT。在匹配的预训练规模下，完整系统在 LIBERO 上达到 93.4% 的平均成功率，而 UniVLA 为 91.8%。

Authors: Tianxingjian Ding, Mubarak Shah, Yu Tian

Sparse Feature Policy Unlearning Mitigates State Hallucination in Vision-Language-Action Models VLA

VLA state hallucination sparse autoencoders policy unlearning manipulation

简要说明：本文研究VLA模型中的状态幻觉问题，并提出SOUL方法，通过稀疏特征选择性地遗忘幻觉相关行为，同时保留成功的操作能力，在仿真和真实环境中验证了其有效性。

TLDR: This paper investigates state hallucination in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, where policies act as if an unrealized state was achieved, and proposes SOUL, a sparse feature unlearning method that selectively removes hallucination-associated behaviors while preserving successful manipulation capabilities, validated across simulated and real-world environments.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong generalization in robotic manipulation by leveraging rich representations from pretrained vision-language models. However, their deployment in real-world environments remains limited by recurring unreliable behaviors. In this work, we study state hallucination, a recurring failure pattern in which a VLA continues acting as if an unrealized robot-object state had been achieved. Our analyses find that state hallucination coincides with weakened attention to task-relevant visual regions, and a mechanistic interpretation via sparse autoencoders reveals that hallucination-associated sparse features are activated when these failures occur. Based on this analysis, we propose SOUL (Sparse feature pOlicy UnLearning), which selectively unlearns policy knowledge associated with state hallucination behaviors, where sparse features identified from hallucination failures and successful behaviors serve as explicit forgetting and retention targets, respectively. Experiments across VLA architectures in simulated and real-world environments show that our method substantially reduces hallucinated failures and improves task success without substantially compromising the existing manipulation capabilities. These results suggest that interpretable feature analysis provides a practical basis for selectively modifying undesirable knowledge in robot policies.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过利用预训练视觉-语言模型的丰富表征，在机器人操作任务中展现出强大的泛化能力。然而，其在实际环境中的部署仍受到反复出现的不可靠行为所限制。本研究聚焦于状态幻觉（state hallucination）这一反复出现的失效模式，即VLA在未实际达成机器人-物体目标状态时，仍持续执行动作仿佛该状态已实现。分析发现，状态幻觉与模型对任务相关视觉区域的注意力减弱同步发生，且通过稀疏自编码器的机制性解释表明，与幻觉相关的稀疏特征在这些失效发生时被激活。基于上述分析，我们提出SOUL（Sparse feature pOlicy UnLearning）方法，该方法选择性地消除与状态幻觉行为相关的策略知识，其中从幻觉失效和成功行为中识别出的稀疏特征分别作为明确的遗忘目标和保留目标。在模拟及真实环境中的多种VLA架构上进行的实验表明，所提方法能显著减少幻觉性失效并提升任务成功率，同时不会明显削弱已有的操作能力。上述结果表明，可解释的特征分析为选择性修正机器人策略中的不良知识提供了切实可行的基础。

Authors: Jiho Lee, Jeongeun Park, Heayoun Choi, Taekyung Kim, Eunwoo Kim

Precise SE(3) End-Effector Tracking in Whole-Body Humanoid Control HumanoidEmbodied

residual reinforcement learning geometric admittance control whole-body humanoid control end-effector pose tracking Unitree G1

简要说明：ResGAC 将几何导纳控制与残差强化学习相结合，在人形全身控制中实现精确的SE(3)末端执行器跟踪，并在真实 Unitree G1 人形机器人上验证优于基线。

TLDR: ResGAC combines geometric admittance control with residual reinforcement learning to achieve precise SE(3) end-effector tracking in whole-body humanoid control, validated on a real Unitree G1 humanoid with superior performance over baselines.

Abstract: Precise end-effector tracking during humanoid whole-body motion is challenging due to floating-base oscillations, gravity, dynamic coupling, and locomotion-induced disturbances. We propose ResGAC, a whole-body humanoid controller for precise end-effector pose tracking that combines geometric admittance control (GAC) with residual reinforcement learning. GAC provides structured $\SE$ task-space feedback and generates nominal arm joint-position targets, while residual RL compensates for unmodeled dynamics and coordinates locomotion and balance in the shared joint-position action space. The left-invariant geometric formulation allows the same GAC law to be used across manipulation reference frames. This enables the use of a ground-attached heading frame that preserves planar locomotion while removing pelvis roll, pitch, and heave from the manipulation reference, thereby reducing reference-induced end-effector motion during locomotion. ResGAC is validated on a real Unitree G1 humanoid. Across four standing end-effector tracking benchmarks, ResGAC consistently outperforms representative baselines, including SONIC, achieving lower translational and rotational errors. Real-world experiments further demonstrate reduced propagation of pelvis motion to the desired end-effector pose using the proposed ground-attached heading frame. ResGAC achieves $90\%$ success in a standing peg-in-hole task compared with $50\%$ for SONIC, and accurate world-frame $\SE$ end-effector pose tracking during lower-body motion. Experimental videos are included in the supplementary material and are also available on the project website: https://resgac.github.io/ResGAC-website/.

摘要（中文）：人形机器人全身运动过程中的精确末端执行器跟踪，因浮动基座振荡、重力、动力学耦合及行走诱发扰动而极具挑战性。我们提出 ResGAC，一种用于精确末端执行器位姿跟踪的全身人形控制器，它将几何导纳控制（GAC）与残差强化学习相结合。GAC 提供结构化的 $\SE$ 任务空间反馈，并生成标称的手臂关节位置目标，而残差强化学习则补偿未建模动力学，并在共享的关节位置动作空间中协调运动与平衡。左不变几何公式使同一 GAC 法则可适用于不同操作参考坐标系，从而能够使用地面附着的航向坐标系，该坐标系在保留平面运动的同时，从操作参考中去除骨盆的侧倾、俯仰和升降，进而减少运动过程中参考系所诱发的末端执行器运动。ResGAC 在实际 Unitree G1 人形机器人上得到验证。在四项站立末端执行器跟踪基准测试中，ResGAC 始终优于代表性基线方法（包括 SONIC），实现了更低的平移和旋转误差。真实世界实验进一步表明，使用所提出的地面附着航向坐标系，能够减少骨盆运动向期望末端执行器位姿的传播。在站立插孔任务中，ResGAC 的成功率达到 $90\%$，而 SONIC 仅为 $50\%$；同时在下肢运动期间实现了精确的世界坐标系 $\SE$ 末端执行器位姿跟踪。实验视频包含在补充材料中，也可在项目网站上获取：https://resgac.github.io/ResGAC-website/。

Authors: Joohwan Seo, Xiaofeng Guo, Jinkun Cao, Roberto Horowitz, Rocky Duan, Guanya Shi, Koushil Sreenath

TMT: Runtime Backdoor Detection for Vision-Language-Action Policies on Unseen Tasks VLA

backdoor detection vision-language-action policies runtime detection latent transition modeling self-distillation

简要说明：TMT提出了一种针对视觉-语言-动作策略的运行时后门检测方法，利用令牌流形和潜在转移建模在未见过的任务上检测恶意触发器，并引入了一种无需干净参考策略的基于自蒸馏的策略净化方法。

TLDR: TMT proposes a runtime backdoor detection method for Vision-Language-Action policies, leveraging token manifold and latent transition modeling to detect malicious triggers on unseen tasks, and introduces a self-distillation-based policy purification approach without needing a clean reference policy.

Abstract: Backdoored vision-language-action (VLA) policies can preserve benign task performance while producing malicious actions when a trigger appears. Detecting such activation is difficult because malicious behavior can comprise individually plausible actions, while unfamiliar tasks introduce legitimate changes in observations and behavior. We introduce TMT, a runtime backdoor detector based on Token Manifold and latent Transition modeling. Trained on benign rollouts, its two branches assess input-token structure and prediction errors in adjacent-layer latent dynamics. A suspicious rollout identified by the token manifold branch, once confirmed through latent deviations, guides transition selection for subsequent monitoring. We further explore policy purification through self-distillation: a frozen copy of the backdoored policy provides benign-input actions to supervise a student on paired benign and triggered observations, without requiring a separate clean reference policy. For evaluation, we adapt traditional backdoor detectors and repurpose anomaly and failure detection methods as VLA backdoor detectors. In a post-hoc comparison with ten baselines, TMT achieves state-of-the-art backdoor detection performance on unseen tasks across three VLA backdoor attacks. Our project page is available at https://zzr42.github.io/tmt/.

摘要（中文）：带后门的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略在保持良性任务性能的同时，一旦触发条件出现便会生成恶意动作。检测此类激活十分困难，因为恶意行为可能由单个看似合理的动作组成，而不熟悉的任务则会在观测和行为中引入合理的变化。我们提出了TMT，一种基于Token流形和潜在转移建模的运行时后门检测器。该检测器在良性轨迹上训练，其两个分支分别评估输入令牌结构以及相邻层潜在动态中的预测误差。由令牌流形分支识别出的可疑轨迹，在通过潜在偏差确认后，将指导后续监控的转移选择。我们进一步探索了通过自蒸馏实现策略净化的方法：将带后门策略的冻结副本作为良性输入动作的监督信号，指导学生在成对的良性和触发观测上进行学习，而无需单独的干净参考策略。在评估方面，我们改编了传统的后门检测器，并将异常检测和故障检测方法重新用于VLA后门检测。在与十个基线的后验比较中，TMT在三种VLA后门攻击下的未见任务上达到了最先进的后门检测性能。我们的项目页面可在https://zzr42.github.io/tmt/访问。

Authors: Zirun Zhou, Jingfeng Zhang, HaoChuan Xu, Xizhe Zhang, Elliott Wen, Jing Sun, Hong Jia

RLHND: Video Foundation Models as Physically Grounded Hand Trackers for Robot Learning Manipulation

hand pose estimation tactile estimation video foundation model robot learning egocentric video

简要说明：RLHND将Cosmos视频扩散模型改造为具有物理接地的手部追踪器，从人类第一人称视频中联合估计解剖学合理的手部姿态和密集接触力，并通过重定向和真实机器人实验展示了其在机器人策略学习中的实用性。

TLDR: RLHND adapts the Cosmos video diffusion model into a physically grounded hand tracker that jointly estimates anatomically plausible hand pose and dense contact/force from human egocentric videos, and demonstrates its utility for robot policy learning via retargeting and real-robot experiments.

Abstract: Recently, approaches that leverage human video datasets for robot policy training have become increasingly prevalent. However, most existing hand trackers regress pose from cropped frames with limited priors on hand motion and object interaction, resulting in inaccurate and physically inconsistent estimates. Moreover, the lack of physical cues, e.g., contact and force, limits the use of human videos for robot policy training. To this end, we propose RLHND, a video foundation model-based hand tracking model that jointly estimates hand pose and realistic tactile information from monocular egocentric videos. RLHND turns the pre-trained Cosmos 3 video diffusion backbone into a deterministic clip-level feature extractor via clean-latent conditioning, carrying its learned priors on hand motion and hand-object interaction into tracking. For pose estimation, RLHND (i) predicts hand poses with anatomically plausible joint angles and (ii) enables optional conditioning on the shape parameter to maintain consistent hand shape within the same video and even across videos recorded by the same actor. For tactile estimation, a separate tactile expert stream, trained with the pose stream frozen, predicts dense contact and force over the hand surface. We further adopt LBS-based feature spreading to enable vertex-wise feature extraction without costly per-vertex attention. RLHND achieves state-of-the-art performance across various benchmark datasets for pose estimation, while also achieving state-of-the-art performance in contact and force estimation. Moreover, we demonstrate the utility of RLHND for robot learning through retargeting results and real-world robot experiments. The code will be publicly available at https://seungjun-moon.github.io/rlhnd/.

摘要（中文）：近年来，利用人类视频数据集进行机器人策略训练的方法日益普及。然而，现有的大多数手部跟踪器仅从裁剪后的帧中回归姿态，对手部运动和物体交互的先验信息利用有限，导致估计结果不准确且在物理上不一致。此外，缺乏物理线索（如接触力和作用力）限制了人类视频在机器人策略训练中的应用。为此，我们提出了RLHND，一种基于视频基础模型的手部跟踪模型，能够从单目第一人称视角视频中联合估计手部姿态和真实的触觉信息。RLHND通过干净潜变量条件化，将预训练的Cosmos 3视频扩散骨干网络转化为确定性的片段级特征提取器，将其在手部运动和手-物交互方面的先验知识引入跟踪过程。在姿态估计方面，RLHND（i）预测具有解剖学合理关节角度的姿态，并（ii）支持以形状参数为可选条件，以保持同一视频内甚至同一操作者录制的不同视频中手部形状的一致性。在触觉估计方面，一个独立的触觉专家流在姿态流冻结的状态下进行训练，预测手部表面的密集接触和作用力分布。我们进一步采用基于LBS的特征扩展方法，实现逐顶点的特征提取，而无需昂贵的逐顶点注意力计算。RLHND在多个基准数据集的姿态估计任务中达到了最先进的性能，同时在接触力和作用力估计中也取得了最先进的成果。此外，我们通过重定向结果和真实机器人实验展示了RLHND在机器人学习中的实用性。代码将在https://seungjun-moon.github.io/rlhnd/ 公开提供。

Authors: Seungjun Moon, Subin Jeon, Sangwoo Kim, Hanbyul Joo, Jinwoo Shin

RobotAPO: Adversarial Physics Preference Optimization for Robotic Manipulation Video Generation VLA

physical preference optimization flow-matching denoising video generation robot execution AgiBot-PhysPref

简要说明：RobotAPO 提出了一种对抗性物理偏好优化框架，用于机器人操作视频生成，通过精心策划的偏好数据集纠正物理违规，并提高下游机器人执行成功率。

TLDR: RobotAPO introduces an adversarial physics preference optimization framework for robotic manipulation video generation, using a curated preference dataset to correct physics violations and improve downstream robot execution success.

Abstract: Robotic manipulation videos are increasingly used as visual plans for embodied agents, but optimizing purely for visual plausibility often fails to capture the fragile physical manifold of real-world interactions. Even minor physics-violating errors at the interaction boundary, such as interpenetration or premature object motion, can completely invalidate the inferred timing and pose needed for downstream execution. Because standard supervised fine-tuning lacks the direct pressure to penalize these localized failures, we introduce AgiBot-PhysPref. This rigorously curated 10,000-sample preference dataset isolates condition-matched physics violations, turning the generator's own failure distribution into a foundational signal for physical consistency. Building upon this, we propose RobotAPO, an adversarial physics preference optimization framework operating in the continuous flow-matching denoising space. To prevent the policy from merely memorizing static curated failures, RobotAPO employs a lightweight adversarial counterfactual proposer that learns a condition-dependent, physical-failure-biased direction in denoising space. This encourages the model to explore and better respect the physical interaction boundary, all while maintaining a pure prompt-and-reference inference interface without requiring external structural conditioning. Comprehensive evaluations demonstrate that explicitly correcting these localized physics violations improves downstream robot execution from generated videos. On held-out AgiBot conditions, RobotAPO outperforms the strongest controlled internal baseline in physical consistency by 6.8% hard score and 10.0% soft score. Crucially, in real-robot replay, it translates these physical-consistency gains into a 37.4% relative improvement in task success over the strongest controlled internal baseline.

摘要（中文）：机器人操作视频越来越广泛地被用作具身智能体的视觉规划，但仅仅优化视觉合理性往往难以捕捉真实世界交互中脆弱的物理流形。即使在交互边界处出现细微的违反物理规律的错误，例如相互穿透或物体过早运动，也可能完全破坏下游执行所需的时序和姿态推断。由于标准的监督微调缺乏直接压力来惩罚这些局部失败，我们引入了AgiBot-PhysPref。这个经过严格筛选的包含10，000个样本的偏好数据集，聚焦于条件匹配的物理违规，将生成器自身的失败分布转化为物理一致性的基础信号。在此基础上，我们提出了RobotAPO，一种在连续流匹配去噪空间中运行的对抗性物理偏好优化框架。为了防止策略仅仅记住静态筛选的失败案例，RobotAPO采用了一个轻量级的对抗性反事实提议器，该提议器在去噪空间中学习一个条件依赖、偏向物理失败的方向。这促使模型探索并更好地尊重物理交互边界，同时保持纯提示-参考的推理接口，无需外部结构条件。综合评估表明，明确修正这些局部物理违规能够提升从生成视频到下游机器人执行的性能。在保留的AgiBot条件下，RobotAPO在物理一致性方面相比最强受控内部基线，硬分数提升6.8%，软分数提升10.0%。关键在于，在真实机器人回放中，这些物理一致性的提升转化为任务成功率相比最强受控内部基线相对提升37.4%。

Authors: Kerui Li, Zhe Jing, Chenyi Huang, Xiaofeng Wang, Zheng Zhu, Haoming Cui, Huaibo Huang

TempoBridge: Language-Guided Tempo Control for Vision-Language-Action Policies VLA

tempo control vision-language-action language-guided modulation frozen VLA representations causal phase router

简要说明：TempoBridge是一个轻量级框架，根据语言指定的节奏提示在每个任务阶段调制VLA策略的动作，在LIBERO基准上提高了节奏成功率，并在无需节奏条件演示或微调的情况下展示了真实世界机器人操作。

TLDR: TempoBridge is a lightweight framework that modulates VLA policy actions according to language-specified tempo cues at each task phase, improving tempo success rate on LIBERO benchmarks and demonstrating real-world robot manipulation without requiring tempo-conditioned demonstrations or fine-tuning.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are effective at understanding what task to perform, but provide limited control over how it should be executed, such as moving quickly or slowly. We introduce TempoBridge, a lightweight framework that uses frozen VLA representations to modulate actions according to tempo cues in the instruction at each task phase, without additional tempo-conditioned robot demonstrations or tempo-specific base-policy fine-tuning. TempoBridge extracts tempo cues from contextual VLM representations, aligns them with task progress through a causal phase router, and modulates nominal motion commands during execution. Across LIBERO tasks, TempoBridge improves Tempo Success Rate from 52.6% to 89.7% under canonical tempo instructions while retaining high task success. It also preserves near-baseline performance when no tempo cue is present and generalizes to unseen tempo expressions without additional training. Experiments on a physical robot further demonstrate language-conditioned tempo modulation in real-world manipulation.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型能有效理解需要执行何种任务，但在如何执行方面所提供的控制却十分有限，例如动作的快慢。我们提出了TempoBridge，这是一种轻量级框架，利用冻结的VLA表示，根据指令中每个任务阶段的节奏提示来调节动作，无需额外的节奏条件机器人演示或针对特定节奏的基础策略微调。TempoBridge从上下文视觉语言模型表示中提取节奏提示，通过因果阶段路由器将其与任务进度对齐，并在执行过程中调制标称运动指令。在LIBERO任务集合中，TempoBridge在标准节奏指令下将节奏成功率从52.6%提升至89.7%，同时保持了较高的任务成功率。在没有节奏提示时，TempoBridge的性能仍接近基线水平，并且无需额外训练即可泛化至未见过的节奏表达。在实体机器人上的实验进一步验证了语言条件节奏调制在真实世界操作中的可行性。

Authors: Yeonseo Lee, Hyosup Shin, Guebin Hwang, Sungho Jo

Event-Aligned Visual Action Reasoning for World Action Models WorldModel

World Action Models event-aligned visual reasoning action generation execution validity head manipulation

简要说明：本文提出了一种事件对齐的视觉动作推理框架，用于世界动作模型，通过围绕任务关键事件组织视觉预测来改善动作生成，并引入执行有效性头来过滤冗余动作，在操作基准上取得了显著的成功率提升。

TLDR: The paper proposes an event-aligned visual action reasoning framework for World Action Models, organizing visual prediction around task-critical events to improve action generation, and introduces an execution validity head to filter redundant actions, achieving significant success rate improvements on manipulation benchmarks.

Abstract: World-Action Models (WAMs) utilize future visual prediction as an intermediate reasoning process to guide action generation. However, existing WAMs typically structure visual imagination according to predefined temporal intervals, without explicitly accounting for the different roles of task-critical interactions and connecting transitions. We argue that effective visual foresight should align directly with task-relevant interactions and their corresponding reasoning demands. To this end, we introduce an event-aligned visual action reasoning framework that organizes visual-action prediction around interaction events. Through event-aligned visual-action supervision, WAM learns to generate event-aligned visual context in each imagined rollout, placing greater emphasis on critical state changes that inform action generation. This shapes the visual reasoning granularity according to the underlying interaction dynamics, with detailed reasoning around task-critical events and coarser progression through connecting transitions. Furthermore, we introduce an execution validity head that identifies the valid portion of each predicted action sequence, avoiding redundant actions during chunked inference. Experiments demonstrate a 10.26 percentage point improvement in DOMINO success rate over baseline and competitive performance on RoboTwin 2.0. It also transfers from DOMINO Level 1 to Levels 2 and 3 without target-level adaptation.

摘要（中文）：世界-行动模型（WAMs）利用未来视觉预测作为中间推理过程来引导行动生成。然而，现有的WAMs通常根据预定义的时间间隔构建视觉想象，未明确考虑任务关键交互与衔接转换的不同作用。我们认为，有效的视觉前瞻应直接与任务相关的交互及其对应的推理需求对齐。为此，我们提出了一种事件对齐的视觉行动推理框架，围绕交互事件组织视觉-行动预测。通过事件对齐的视觉-行动监督，WAM学习在每个想象推演中生成事件对齐的视觉情境，更加注重影响行动生成的关键状态变化。这根据底层交互动态塑造了视觉推理的粒度，即在任务关键事件周围进行细致推理，在衔接转换中采用较粗略的推进。此外，我们引入了一个执行有效性头，用于识别每个预测行动序列中的有效部分，避免在分块推理过程中产生冗余行动。实验表明，在DOMINO成功率上相较于基线提升了10.26个百分点，并在RoboTwin 2.0上取得了具有竞争力的表现。该方法还能从DOMINO第1级迁移至第2级和第3级，无需目标级别的适配。

Authors: Xiaomeng Yang, Yushu Wu, Yi Gao, Yuhao Lei, Xuan Zhang, Pu Zhao, Yanzhi Wang

Immiscible Diffusion Policy: Preserving Multimodal Robot Actions through Label-Free Noise Assignment Manipulation

diffusion policy multimodal action distribution noise assignment humanoid manipulation label-free

简要说明：本文发现扩散策略在机器人动作生成中存在模态坍缩问题，并提出一种无需标签的训练时噪声分配方法以保持动作多模态性，在仿真和真实人形操作任务中验证了效果。

TLDR: The paper identifies modality collapse in diffusion policies for robot action generation and proposes a label-free training-time noise-assignment method to preserve multimodal action distributions, validated on simulated and real-world humanoid manipulation tasks.

Abstract: When diffusion policies were first introduced, they were expected to recover multi-modal action distributions. However, we find this expectation does not always hold, as diffusion policies often collapse to a single modality even when we guarantee the balance of dataset modalities and exact within-batch symmetry. Our analysis indicates that independent action-noise pairing contributes to this failure by increasing mixing and crossing among diffusion paths, which can produce averaged denoising responses and suppress modality-specific behavior. This issue is especially severe in robot planning, where action spaces are dense and low-dimensional, significantly increasing such mixing and crossing. To alleviate this problem, we propose Immiscible Diffusion Policy, a label-free training-time add-on to diffusion policy that uses action-noise assignment to preserve relatively distinct noise-to-action routes without modifying the policy architecture or inference procedure. Across five simulated and two real-world humanoid manipulation tasks spanning state, RGB, and point-cloud observations, our method significantly improves the policy's preservation of action modalities while maintaining strong task performance. It increases the proportion of the non-dominant modality by 6.0x-14.6x across three two-modality tasks and recovers demonstrated modalities that are entirely absent from vanilla policy rollouts on both four-modality tasks. These results demonstrate that Immiscible Diffusion Policy provides a simple yet robust approach to preserving action multi-modality in general robot learning tasks.

摘要（中文）：当扩散策略首次被提出时，研究者期望其能够恢复多模态动作分布。然而，我们发现这一期望并不总是成立——即使我们保证了数据集模态的平衡以及批内精确的对称性，扩散策略仍常常坍缩到单一模态。我们的分析表明，独立的动作-噪声配对通过增加扩散路径之间的混合与交叉，导致这一问题，进而可能产生平均化的去噪响应，并抑制模态特有的行为。这一问题在机器人规划中尤为严重，因为动作空间密集且维度较低，显著加剧了此类混合与交叉。为缓解该问题，我们提出了不混溶扩散策略（Immiscible Diffusion Policy），这是一种无需标签的训练时附加机制，通过动作-噪声分配保留相对清晰的噪声到动作的映射路径，而无需修改策略架构或推理流程。在涵盖状态、RGB和点云观测的五项仿真任务及两项真实世界人形操控任务中，我们的方法显著提升了策略对动作模态的保持能力，同时维持了强劲的任务表现。在三个双模态任务中，该方法将非主导模态的比例提升了6.0倍至14.6倍，并在两个四模态任务中恢复了原始策略回放中完全缺失的示范模态。这些结果表明，不混溶扩散策略为一般机器人学习任务中保持动作多模态提供了一种简单而稳健的方法。

Authors: Xiao Zhang, Yuxin Chen, Zhixuan Liang, Guojian Zhan, Chenran Li, Chenfeng Xu, Masayoshi Tomizuka, Yiheng Li

Predicted Futures Are Not Enough: Learning Executable Goals for Robot Manipulation Manipulation

world model goal readout SE(3) goal closed-loop control manipulation

简要说明：本文提出了实体级目标读取方法，一种将3D轨迹世界模型预测转换为可执行的SE(3)目标的接口，用于闭环机器人操作，在仿真和真实机器人任务中取得了高成功率。

TLDR: This paper introduces Entity-Level Goal Readout, a learned interface that converts 3D trace world model predictions into executable SE(3) goals for closed-loop robot manipulation, achieving high success rates on simulated and real robot tasks.

Abstract: Generative world models provide rich predictions of how manipulation scenes may evolve toward task objectives, yet those futures do not directly expose the compact task variables required by control. When training supervises future prediction alone, terminal goal accuracy is not an explicit learning objective, even when geometric recovery is available. We present Entity-Level Goal Readout, a learned prediction-to-execution interface that makes the executable terminal goal an explicit output of a 3D trace world model. It combines object-centric pose prediction with translation grounded in observed depth to produce a compact goal in SE(3). A shared Pose-Native Executor consumes this fixed goal with online object-pose feedback for closed-loop control without rerunning the world model. Across five manipulation tasks, the pipeline achieves a mean success rate of 79.69%. Goal diagnostics directly measure terminal goal accuracy, while controlled translation perturbations characterize how execution degrades under goal error. Zero-shot deployment on a Franka arm achieves 73.33% success on nominal StackCube, 66.67% with distractors, and 75.00% on PickPlate with a target unseen during policy training. These results support treating the prediction-to-execution interface as an explicit learned component of world-model planning rather than incidental post-processing in the control pipeline itself. Project page: https://claire0730.github.io/executable-goals/

摘要（中文）：生成式世界模型能够对操作场景如何朝着任务目标演化提供丰富的预测，然而这些未来状态并不直接暴露控制所需的紧凑任务变量。当训练仅监督未来预测时，终端目标的准确性并非显式学习目标，即使在几何恢复可用的情况下也是如此。我们提出实体级目标读取（Entity-Level Goal Readout），这是一种学习得到的预测到执行接口，使可执行的终端目标成为3D轨迹世界模型的显式输出。该方法将以对象为中心的位姿预测与基于观测深度进行 grounding 的平移相结合，在SE(3)中生成紧凑目标。共享的位姿原生执行器（Pose-Native Executor）利用该固定目标并结合在线对象位姿反馈进行闭环控制，而无需重新运行世界模型。在五项操作任务中，该流程实现了79.69%的平均成功率。目标诊断直接度量终端目标精度，而受控平移扰动则刻画了在目标误差下执行性能的退化情况。在Franka机械臂上的零样本部署中，标称StackCube任务达到73.33%的成功率，加入干扰物时为66.67%，PickPlate任务在策略训练中未见的目标上达到75.00%。这些结果支持将预测到执行接口视为世界模型规划中一个显式学习的组成部分，而非控制流程中偶然的后处理环节。项目页面：https://claire0730.github.io/executable-goals/

Authors: Tzu-Yu Chuang, Ching-Hsiang Chang, Yi-Hsiu Lee, Yi-Ting Chen, Min Sun, YuanFu Yang

RoboRender: Robot-Oriented Video Generation for Visual Sim-to-Real Transfer Manipulation

video generation sim-to-real transfer robot policy learning depth-conditioned generation zero-shot deployment

简要说明：RoboRender 利用面向机器人的视频生成模型，将带有深度和掩码条件的仿真轨迹转换为逼真的 RGB 视频，从而实现操作任务的零样本仿真到真实策略迁移。

TLDR: RoboRender uses a robot-oriented video generation model to convert simulated trajectories with depth and mask conditions into photorealistic RGB videos, enabling zero-shot sim-to-real policy transfer for manipulation tasks.

Abstract: Simulation enables large-scale, low-cost robot data generation, but policies trained in simulation often fail to transfer to the real world due to the sim-to-real visual discrepancies. Existing approaches often rely on intermediate representations, which can discard rich semantic information or require additional perception modules at deployment. We address this visual sim-to-real gap with RoboRender, a framework that converts simulated trajectories into photorealistic RGB videos for policy learning. RoboRender trains a robot-oriented video generation model conditioned on simulated depth videos, language instructions, and robot RGB mask videos, preserving simulator geometry, robot motion, and action labels while synthesizing realistic textures, backgrounds, and distractors. The generated RGB videos are paired with simulator-provided states and actions to train policies for zero-shot real-world deployment. On robot video test sets, our video model outperforms depth-conditioned video generation baselines in generation quality. In real-world experiments across pick-and-place, articulated-object manipulation, and mobile manipulation tasks, policies trained on RoboRender-generated data achieve a 71% average success rate, outperforming raw simulation renderings and conventional visual domain randomization by approximately 7.1x and 3.6x, respectively. We further show that policy performance improves with more generated videos per simulation trajectory, increasing opening-task success by 65 percentage points. These results demonstrate that generative video rendering mitigates the visual sim-to-real gap for zero-shot policy transfer. Project website: https://robo-render.github.io/.

摘要（中文）：仿真技术能够大规模、低成本地生成机器人数据，但基于仿真训练的策略往往因仿真到现实的视觉差异而难以迁移至真实世界。现有方法通常依赖中间表示，这可能会丢失丰富的语义信息，或在部署时需要额外的感知模块。我们通过RoboRender框架解决这一视觉仿真到现实差距问题，该框架将仿真轨迹转换为逼真的RGB视频，用于策略学习。RoboRender训练一个面向机器人的视频生成模型，该模型以仿真深度视频、语言指令和机器人RGB掩码视频为条件输入，在保留仿真器几何结构、机器人运动及动作标签的同时，合成逼真的纹理、背景和干扰物。生成的RGB视频与仿真器提供的状态和动作配对，用于训练策略，实现零样本真实世界部署。在机器人视频测试集上，我们的视频模型在生成质量上优于基于深度条件的视频生成基线。在抓取放置、铰接物体操作和移动操作任务的真实世界实验中，基于RoboRender生成数据训练的策略实现了71%的平均成功率，分别比原始仿真渲染和传统视觉域随机化方法高出约7.1倍和3.6倍。我们进一步表明，每条仿真轨迹生成更多视频可提升策略性能，使开启任务的成功率提高65个百分点。这些结果表明，生成式视频渲染有效缩小了零样本策略迁移中的视觉仿真到现实差距。项目网站：https://robo-render.github.io/。

Authors: Huang Huang, Wensi Ai, Ziyu Chen, Youhui Wang, Zijian Du, Yang Liu, Jiaolong Yang, Li Fei-Fei, Jiajun Wu

Teaching a Robot Dog New Tricks: Diverse Quadruped Skills via Combined Reinforcement and Imitation Learning with Adversarial Task Selection Locomotion

multi-task RL imitation learning adversarial task selection quadruped locomotion real-world deployment

简要说明：本文提出了一种结合强化学习与模仿学习并采用对抗性任务选择的三阶段训练方法，训练出一个能够执行22种不同技能的四足机器人单一策略，并在Unitree B1上进行了真实世界部署。

TLDR: This paper introduces a three-stage training method combining reinforcement learning and imitation learning with adversarial task selection to train a single quadruped robot policy capable of 22 diverse skills, demonstrating real-world deployment on a Unitree B1.

Abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has enabled legged robots to perform a range of skills in single-task settings. However, applications such as farm robotics or space exploration require diverse skills such as locomotion, digging, or close-range surveying. Training an end-to-end policy to address this problem remains difficult due to challenges such as sample inefficiency and gradient conflict between tasks in multi-task learning. We propose a three-stage method that trains a single policy to perform distinct tasks such as walking, digging, and hopping, and compose them into novel behaviors such as crawling. First, multiple teacher policies are trained using RL on narrowly defined tasks. Then, two additional stages train a student policy with a multi-teacher distillation setup that uses a combined RL and Imitation Learning (IL) objective under an adversarial task selection process that focuses training on the worst-performing task. With this method, we train a student policy that performs 22 tasks using 8 teachers. Evaluations show our method preserves motion quality and tracks commands more accurately than PPO and distill-then-finetune baselines, and in some cases generalizes to new tasks without explicit training. Finally, we demonstrate real-world robustness by deploying the resulting policy on a Unitree B1 quadruped. Video: https://youtu.be/V9yX04EBcFA

摘要（中文）：强化学习（RL）使得腿式机器人能够在单一任务环境中执行一系列技能。然而，诸如农业机器人或太空探索等应用场景则需要多样化的技能，例如移动、挖掘或近距离勘测。训练一个端到端策略来解决这一问题仍面临诸多困难，原因包括样本效率低下以及多任务学习中各任务之间的梯度冲突。我们提出了一种三阶段方法，用于训练单一策略以执行行走、挖掘和跳跃等不同任务，并将其组合成诸如爬行等新颖行为。首先，使用强化学习在定义明确的任务上训练多个教师策略。随后，通过两个额外阶段，在对抗性任务选择过程下，利用结合强化学习与模仿学习（IL）目标的多人教师蒸馏框架来训练学生策略，该过程聚焦于表现最差的任务进行训练。采用此方法，我们使用8个教师策略训练了一个能够执行22项任务的学生策略。评估结果表明，与PPO及先蒸馏后微调的基线方法相比，我们的方法保留了动作质量并更准确地跟踪命令，在某些情况下甚至无需显式训练即可泛化到新任务。最后，我们通过在宇树B1四足机器人上部署所得策略，展示了其在现实世界中的鲁棒性。视频链接：https://youtu.be/V9yX04EBcFA

Authors: Lemon Foxmere, Anthony Furman, Yizheng Du, Oliver Chang, Leilani Gilpin, Steve McGuire

CAP: Codebook-Aligned Prediction for Tokenized Robot Policies VLA

action tokenization codebook alignment tokenized robot policies discrete action policy VLA

简要说明：本文提出码本对齐预测（CAP），将动作分词器的码向量直接用作策略类原型，在不改变分词器或重构质量的情况下，提高了机器人策略在多个基准和真实机器人上的成功率。

TLDR: This paper proposes Codebook-Aligned Prediction (CAP), which reuses action tokenizer code vectors as policy class prototypes, improving robot policy performance across benchmarks and real robots without changing the tokenizer or reconstruction quality.

Abstract: Action tokenization converts continuous robot actions into discrete symbols that can be modeled autoregressively. However, existing tokenizer-based policies typically ignore the tokenizer's learned latent code structure: after tokenization, the policy treats tokens as unrelated class indices and learns a new classifier from scratch. We show that this discarded structure is valuable. We introduce Codebook-Aligned Prediction (CAP), a method that directly reuses the tokenizer's code vectors as policy class prototypes while leaving the tokenizer and policy backbone otherwise unchanged. Across four quantizer families, three simulation benchmarks, and two real-robot tasks, CAP consistently improves task success over standard token classification heads while holding the tokenizer (and therefore its reconstruction quality) fixed. Our analysis further shows that these gains are not explained by higher token accuracy or changes in the policy head alone. Instead, reusing the tokenizer codebook provides the policy with valuable information about the tokenizer's learned latent structure across tokens, making token prediction errors more benign in action space and improving the representations learned by the policy backbone. These results suggest that action tokenizers learn useful action-aware latent structure beyond discrete targets that should be preserved when training downstream policies.

摘要（中文）：动作分词将连续的机器人动作转换为离散符号，从而可以通过自回归方式进行建模。然而，现有的基于分词器的策略通常忽略分词器学习到的潜在码本结构：分词后，策略将词元视为无关的类别索引，并从零开始训练新的分类器。我们表明，这种被丢弃的结构具有重要价值。我们提出了码本对齐预测（CAP）方法，该方法直接复用分词器的码本向量作为策略类别原型，同时保持分词器和策略主干网络不变。在四种量化器家族、三个模拟基准测试以及两个真实机器人任务中，CAP consistently 相较于标准词元分类头提升了任务成功率，同时保持分词器（及其重建质量）固定不变。我们的进一步分析表明，这些提升并不能仅由更高的词元准确率或策略头的变化来解释。相反，复用分词器的码本为策略提供了关于分词器在词元间学习到的潜在结构的有价值信息，从而使词元预测误差在动作空间中更具良性，并改善了策略主干网络学习到的表示。这些结果表明，动作分词器学习到了超越离散目标的有用的动作感知潜在结构，这些结构在训练下游策略时应予以保留。

Authors: Haoran Chen, Jingtian Ji, Samuel Wheeler, Kaylene Caswell Stocking, Matthew Walter

Beyond Reconstruction: What Matters in Action Tokenization for Robot Policies? VLA

action tokenization vision-language-action models tokenizer training robot policies predictability

简要说明：本文提出了 ProAct，一种在重建目标基础上增强可预测性和鲁棒性的 tokenizer 训练方法，在多个基准和真实机器人操作中提升了策略成功率。

TLDR: This paper introduces ProAct, a tokenizer training method that augments reconstruction with predictability and robustness objectives, improving downstream robot policy success across multiple benchmarks and real-world manipulation.

Abstract: Autoregressive action-token policies such as vision-language-action models require action tokenizers to translate discrete token sequences into precise control actions in continuous space. Many action tokenizers learn the mapping between tokens and actions via a reconstruction objective. However, as we show through extensive analysis, sufficiently accurate action reconstruction is only one part of what makes a downstream robot policy successful. It is also critical that the policy is able to predict the right tokens for new observations, and that unseen policy token predictions still decode into reasonable actions. These properties are downstream of tokenizer training and are not directly incentivized by a reconstruction objective alone. In this work, we introduce Predictable and Robust Action Tokenization (ProAct), a tokenizer training method that strategically augments reconstruction with the goal of improving downstream predictability and robustness. ProAct is policy-agnostic and uses only action datasets for training. Across the Robomimic, LIBERO, and RoboTwin benchmarks and a diverse set of tokenizer architectures, ProAct improves rollout success by an average of 11.3 percentage points. These improvements also translate to vision-language-action policies and real-world robotic manipulation, yielding average gains of 21.8 and 36.7 percentage points, respectively. These results suggest that effective action tokenization should be designed as a policy interface that balances fidelity, predictability, and robustness, rather than as a reconstruction problem alone.

摘要（中文）：自回归动作令牌策略，如视觉-语言-动作模型，需要动作分词器将离散令牌序列转换为连续空间中的精确控制动作。许多动作分词器通过重构目标来学习令牌与动作之间的映射。然而，正如我们通过广泛分析所示，足够精确的动作重构仅是使下游机器人策略成功的因素之一。同样关键的是，策略能够针对新的观测预测正确的令牌，并且未见过的策略令牌预测仍能解码为合理的动作。这些性质源于分词器的训练过程，仅靠重构目标并不能直接激励这些特性。在本工作中，我们引入了可预测且鲁棒的动作分词（ProAct），这是一种分词器训练方法，策略性地增强重构过程，旨在提升下游可预测性和鲁棒性。ProAct与策略无关，仅使用动作数据集进行训练。在Robomimic、LIBERO和RoboTwin基准测试以及多种分词器架构中，ProAct将部署成功率平均提高了11.3个百分点。这些改进同样适用于视觉-语言-动作策略和真实世界机器人操作，分别平均提升了21.8和36.7个百分点。这些结果表明，有效的动作分词应设计为一种策略接口，平衡保真度、可预测性和鲁棒性，而非仅仅作为重构问题来处理。

Authors: Haoran Chen, Jingtian Ji, Samuel Wheeler, Kaylene Caswell Stocking, Matthew Walter

World Models Dream of Success: Diagnosing and Repairing Failure Insensitivity in Robot World Models WorldModel

failure counterfactuals world model fine-tuning success-failure discrimination robot manipulation LIBERO

简要说明：本文提出了CureWM，一种通过从成功演示中构造经执行验证的反事实失败样本来微调机器人世界模型的方法，从而减少其过度乐观的预测并提高成败区分能力。

TLDR: The paper introduces CureWM, a method that constructs execution-verified counterfactual failures from successful demonstrations to fine-tune robot world models, reducing their over-optimistic predictions and improving success-failure discrimination.

Abstract: Robot world models support policy evaluation, planning, and synthetic data generation, but these applications require predictions that distinguish successful actions from failures. Across four released checkpoints from two architecture families, we observe weak sensitivity to action changes and success-like predictions on verified failures. Although recent work incorporates failures into model training, which data can repair released checkpoints without changing their architecture or training objective still remains underexplored. To this end, we introduce CureWM, which constructs alternative actions from successful demonstrations across a severity grid, verifies their outcomes through execution in simulation or on hardware, and fine-tunes released models on the resulting failures and surviving successes alongside nominal demonstrations. This construction provides controlled action contrasts from shared starting contexts. On 484 held-out LIBERO failure counterfactuals, optimism falls from 80\% after fine-tuning on the official data to 30--43\% across four independently fine-tuned CureWM models (38\% mean). In two separate evaluations on a physical robot arm, failure predictions scored as success-like by a latent-distance diagnostic decrease from 90\% after fine-tuning on successful demonstrations alone to 33\% with CureWM. With failure counts per task, successful replay data, and training budget matched, counterfactual failures yield a success--failure value gap of 0.124, compared with 0.014 for freshly collected on-policy failures. These findings support execution-verified counterfactual replay for post-hoc repair and show why reduced optimism must be evaluated alongside success--failure discrimination. Code is available at https://github.com/jiuyixu25/CureWM.

摘要（中文）：摘要：机器人世界模型支持策略评估、规划及合成数据生成，但这些应用要求预测能够区分成功动作与失败动作。在来自两个架构家族的四个已发布检查点上，我们观察到模型对动作变化的敏感性较弱，且对已验证失败案例产生类似成功的预测。尽管近期工作将失败样本纳入模型训练，但究竟哪些数据能够在保持架构和训练目标不变的情况下修复已发布的检查点，仍鲜有探索。为此，我们提出CureWM，该方法从成功示范中构建跨严重程度网格的替代动作，通过在仿真或实体硬件上执行来验证其结果，并在由此产生的失败样本及存活的成功样本基础上，结合常规示范对已发布模型进行微调。这种构建方式从共享起始情境出发，提供了受控的动作对比。在484个保留的LIBERO失败反事实样本上，乐观度从官方数据微调后的80%降至四个独立微调的CureWM模型的30%至43%（均值38%）。在物理机器人臂上的两项独立评估中，由潜在距离诊断判定为类似成功的失败预测，从仅基于成功示范微调后的90%降至CureWM下的33%。在每任务失败次数、成功回放数据和训练预算均匹配的条件下，反事实失败产生的成功—失败价值差距为0.124，而新采集的在线策略失败样本仅为0.014。这些发现支持将执行验证的反事实回放用于事后修复，并表明在评估乐观度降低的同时，必须一并考察成功—失败判别能力。代码见https://github.com/jiuyixu25/CureWM。

Authors: Jiuyi Xu, Xiao Hu, Meida Chen, Peng Gao, Yang Ye, Yangming Shi

FlashNeRD: Performance-First Contact-Rich Neural Robot Dynamics RLRobot

neural dynamics contact-rich manipulation parallel streaming architecture model predictive control policy learning

简要说明：FlashNeRD 提出了一种并行流式架构，用于学习神经机器人动力学，相较于先前的 NeRD 更快更准，可接受任意接触点，并实现与分析物体模拟器的双向耦合，在多个机器人上展示了动力学预测、策略学习和 MPC 规划的速度提升。

TLDR: FlashNeRD presents a parallel streaming architecture for learned neural robot dynamics that is faster and more accurate than prior NeRD, accepts arbitrary contacts, and enables two-way coupling with analytical object simulators, demonstrating speedups in dynamics prediction, policy learning, and MPC planning across multiple robots.

Abstract: Compared with analytical physics, learned dynamics models promise robot simulation that is faster, inherently differentiable, and easily adaptable to real data. Neural Robot Dynamics (NeRD) pursues this by keeping collision detection analytical and replacing a simulator's numerical dynamics for the robot with a learned model. Three limitations remain. NeRD offers little speedup over the simulator it learned from, accepts contact only at predefined points, and has no two-way coupling with objects it manipulates. FlashNeRD removes all three with a parallel streaming architecture that makes each prediction faster and more accurate, an encoder that accepts contacts wherever they occur, and two-way coupling with objects simulated by analytical solvers. Experiments across five robots show faster and more accurate dynamics, faster policy learning, and faster inference-time planning. Across three robots, FlashNeRD's dynamics model is up to $55\times$ faster than an optimized NeRD and more accurate over long rollouts. This speedup extends to policy learning, where PPO trains an ANYmal locomotion policy in 34 seconds, $3.8\times$ faster than the analytical simulator and $2.7\times$ faster than an optimized NeRD. With DIAL-MPC, a sampling-based MPC method, the robot climbs all six test platforms where fixed-contact NeRD manages one, at approximately half the analytical simulator's planning time. Cube-reorientation policies trained with FlashNeRD complete within 2% of the simulator-trained policy's target count.

摘要（中文）：与解析物理学相比，学习型动力学模型有望实现更快、天然可微且易于适应真实数据的机器人仿真。神经机器人动力学（NeRD）通过保持碰撞检测的解析性，并用学习模型替代仿真器中针对机器人的数值动力学来实现这一目标。然而，仍存在三个局限：NeRD相对于其所学习的仿真器加速效果有限，仅在预定义接触点接受接触，且与其操作的对象之间缺乏双向耦合。FlashNeRD通过并行流式架构消除了这三项局限，该架构使每次预测更快更精确，同时引入能接受任意位置接触的编码器，并与解析求解器模拟的对象实现双向耦合。在五个机器人上的实验表明，其动力学预测更快更准确，策略学习更快，推理时规划也更快。在三个机器人上，FlashNeRD的动力学模型相比优化的NeRD快了高达55倍，且在长时程推演中准确性更高。这一加速效果延续到策略学习中，PPO在34秒内训练出ANYmal运动策略，比解析仿真器快3.8倍，比优化的NeRD快2.7倍。结合基于采样的MPC方法DIAL-MPC，机器人成功攀爬所有六个测试平台，而固定接触的NeRD仅能完成一个，且规划时间约为解析仿真器的一半。使用FlashNeRD训练的立方体重定向策略完成度在仿真器训练策略目标次数的2%以内。

Authors: Mohammadmehdi Ataei, Mohammad Amin Nabian, Jie Xu, Miles Macklin, Yashraj Narang, Eric Heiden, Octi Zhang, Yunrong Guo, Ruben D'Sa, Oliver Hennigh, Gavriel State, Sanjay Choudhry

Workhorse: Learning Robust Whole-Body Humanoid Loco-Manipulation from Human Data HumanoidEmbodied

humanoid loco-manipulation visual planner whole-body tracking reinforcement learning human demonstrations

简要说明：Workhorse 通过从无机器人的人类演示中分别训练视觉规划器和强化学习全身跟踪器，并利用数据增强模拟对方误差，使真实的 Unitree G1 能够在干扰下完成分拣箱子、接住箱子、攀爬等全身操作任务。

TLDR: Workhorse learns robust whole-body humanoid loco-manipulation from robot-free human demonstrations by training a visual planner and a reinforcement-learning whole-body tracker separately, with augmented data to imitate each other's errors, enabling a real Unitree G1 to sort boxes, catch, and climb despite disturbances.

Abstract: Humanoid robots still struggle to plan contact-rich whole-body manipulation from egocentric RGB and proprioception. Workhorse learns such manipulation from robot-free human demonstrations. A visual planner predicts five-link targets: the poses of the torso, both wrists, and both feet. A reinforcement-learning whole-body tracker follows them on the robot. Both policies train separately on the same recorded human poses, without retargeting. We augment the training data of each policy to imitate the errors that the other makes at deployment. On a real Unitree G1, Workhorse sorts boxes with its hands and a kick, catches a thrown box, and topples and climbs a suitcase. During box sorting, we show recoveries after a person pushes the robot or takes the box away. In a simulated copy of the demonstration room, the system completes box sorting in 77% of episodes, and in 64% under 40 N.s pushes. With both policies retrained from the same demonstrations, a simulated second humanoid completes box sorting in 83% of episodes without pushes.

摘要（中文）：类人机器人在仅依赖第一视角RGB图像与本体感觉进行接触丰富的全身操作规划时仍面临挑战。Workhorse系统通过从无机器人的人类示范中学习此类操作。其视觉规划器预测五个链式目标：躯干、双腕及双足的位姿。强化学习全身跟踪器则在机器人上执行这些目标。两个策略分别在相同的人类姿态记录上独立训练，无需重新定向。我们通过扩充各策略的训练数据，模拟对方在部署时可能产生的误差。在真实Unitree G1机器人上，Workhorse成功完成用手和踢腿分拣箱子、接住抛来的箱子，以及推倒并攀爬行李箱等任务。在分拣箱子过程中，系统展示了在有人推搡机器人或取走箱子后的恢复能力。在演示房间的模拟副本中，该系统在77%的试验中完成箱子分拣，在40 N·s推力干扰下成功率为64%。当两个策略基于相同示范重新训练后，模拟的第二个人形机器人在无推力情况下完成箱子分拣的成功率可达83%。

Authors: Songbo Hu, Qiayuan Liao, Yufeng Chi, Kevin Zakka, Yakun Sophia Shao, Pieter Abbeel, Koushil Sreenath

PhysEvo: Astra Can Act, Let It VLA

recursive self-improvement frozen model manipulation RoboDojo real robot

简要说明：PhysEvo 是一个围绕冻结的 VLA 模型进行物理递归自我改进的框架，通过元代理诊断失败并修改工具和技能，从而在仿真和真实机器人上提升操作性能。

TLDR: PhysEvo is a framework for physical recursive self-improvement around a frozen VLA model, where a meta-agent diagnoses failures and revises tools and skills to improve manipulation performance in simulation and on a real robot.

Abstract: Astra can act, yet reliable manipulation depends on the system through which it observes and controls the world. We introduce PhysEvo, a framework for physical recursive self-improvement (RSI) around a single frozen model. A task agent executes robot tasks; a meta-agent uses the resulting trajectories to diagnose failures, revise tools and skills, and test corrections. The meta-agent can also improve its own diagnostic tools, so retained revisions support both later action and later self-improvement. This process develops joint-level control, evidence-seeking observation, and reusable manipulation skills without model-weight updates or a separately trained action policy. Across 42 RoboDojo tasks, held-out-layout evaluation of retained task-specific deployment versions yields a five-dimension average score of 68.14/100 and 62.00% success, compared with 47.17% for RoboDawn's one-shot Astra agent, the strongest published reference in our comparison. On eight manipulation tasks challenging direct Astra, PhysEvo achieves 55.00% success, compared with 1.25% for the direct-Astra reference. Deploying the simulation-evolved harness on AgileX PiPER and continuing skill revision yields 90.60/100 average score and 84.00% success across 25 trials on five real-world tasks. PhysEvo turns the consequences of action into persistent, testable changes to how a frozen model acts and improves.

摘要（中文）：Astra能够执行操作，然而可靠的操纵能力取决于其观察和控制世界所依托的系统。我们提出PhysEvo，一个围绕单一冻结模型的物理递归自我改进（RSI）框架。任务智能体执行机器人任务；元智能体利用由此产生的轨迹来诊断失败、修正工具与技能，并测试修正效果。元智能体还能够改进自身的诊断工具，因此保留的修正既能支持后续行动，也能支持后续的自我改进。该过程实现了关节级控制、基于证据的观察以及可复用的操作技能，而无需更新模型权重或单独训练行动策略。在42项RoboDojo任务中，对保留的任务特定部署版本进行留出布局评估，五维平均得分为68.14/100，成功率为62.00%，相比之下，RoboDawn的单次Astra智能体（我们对比中最强的已发表参考）成功率为47.17%。在八项对直接Astra具有挑战性的操作任务中，PhysEvo实现了55.00%的成功率，而直接Astra参考的成功率仅为1.25%。将仿真演化出的控制框架部署到AgileX PiPER上并持续进行技能修正，在五项真实世界任务的25次试验中，平均得分为90.60/100，成功率为84.00%。PhysEvo将行动的后果转化为对冻结模型行动与改进方式的持久且可测试的改变。

Authors: Wenqing Tian, Zeyu Zhang, Zhaocheng Liu, Fengwei Liu, Qiang Liu, Liang Wang

HULK: Learning Whole-Body Forceful Loco-Manipulation for Humanoids HumanoidEmbodied

whole-body control loco-manipulation model predictive control reinforcement learning control barrier function

简要说明：HULK 提出了一种用于人形机器人负重全身移动操作的控制框架，利用 MPC 引导强化学习并引入捕获点控制障碍函数以提升平衡性，最终将两个教师策略蒸馏为单一策略并在仿真和 Unitree G1 上验证。

TLDR: HULK introduces a whole-body control framework for humanoid loco-manipulation of heavy objects, using MPC-guided reinforcement learning with a capture-point control barrier function to improve balance, and distills two teachers into a single policy evaluated in simulation and on the Unitree G1.

Abstract: Humanoid loco-manipulation of large, heavy objects demands forceful interaction across the entire body. However, such payloads shift a humanoid's center of mass and impose sustained loads across the upper body, challenging balance and command tracking. We present HULK, a whole-body control framework for forceful loco-manipulation. Using model predictive control (MPC) to guide reinforcement learning with predictions of the loaded dynamics, we train two teachers: one tracks arm motions under wrist forces, and the other locomotes while holding large objects against the body. A capture-point control barrier function augments the wrist-force teacher during training to improve balance under load. We distill both teachers into a single policy. Evaluation spans simulation and the Unitree G1. In simulation, the teacher with the barrier function achieves the lowest forward and lateral velocity tracking errors at 10 kg per arm among evaluated controllers and reduces aggregate divergent component of motion (DCM) excursion magnitude by 35.7% relative to MPC-guided reinforcement learning alone. Our wrist-force teacher withstands torso push disturbances of up to 130 N.

摘要（中文）：类人机器人对大型、重型物体的全身操控需要在全身范围内产生强力交互。然而，此类负载会改变类人机器人的质心位置，并在上半身施加持续载荷，对平衡维持与指令跟踪构成挑战。我们提出了HULK，一种用于强力全身操控的全身控制框架。通过使用模型预测控制（MPC）引导强化学习，并引入负载动力学预测，我们训练了两个教师策略：一个在腕部受力条件下跟踪手臂运动，另一个在怀抱大型物体时执行移动任务。在训练过程中，一种基于捕获点的控制障碍函数增强了腕部受力教师策略，以提升负载条件下的平衡能力。我们将两个教师策略蒸馏为单一策略。评估覆盖仿真环境及Unitree G1实体机器人。在仿真中，带有障碍函数的教师策略在双臂各承载10 kg负载时，相较于其他被评估控制器，实现了最低的前向及侧向速度跟踪误差，并将发散分量（DCM）的总偏移幅度相对于纯MPC引导的强化学习降低了35.7%。我们的腕部受力教师策略能够承受高达130 N的躯干推挤扰动。

Authors: An Dang, Arturo Flores Alvarez, Yu-Ming Chen, Conor Mc Gartoll, Helen Sun, Aaron Ames, Nima Fazeli, Manikantan Nambi

EmbodiedRSI: Active Continual Robot Learning Through Hypothesis-Guided Co-Evolution VLA

active continual learning hypothesis-guided co-evolution agentic harness robot foundation models visuomotor control

简要说明：EmbodiedRSI 提出了一种自进化代理框架，通过快慢双系统架构主动选择物理实验，协同进化代码和技能，在操作基准上提升机器人基础模型性能，并零样本迁移至真实机器人。

TLDR: EmbodiedRSI introduces a self-evolving agentic harness with a Fast-Slow Dual-System Architecture that actively selects physical experiments to co-evolve code and skills, improving robot foundation model performance on manipulation benchmarks and transferring zero-shot to real robots.

Abstract: Robot foundation models provide strong visuomotor control, yet their performance can degrade when object positions or task instructions change. Further improvements often require post-training on substantial robot data, which can be costly to collect through methods such as teleoperation. Agentic harnesses can adapt around the model, but current self-evolving harnesses use robot trials inefficiently when deciding which code and skill changes to pursue. We introduce EmbodiedRSI, a self-evolving agentic harness that autonomously decides where to explore next and turns the resulting physical interaction into improved code and skills. EmbodiedRSI realizes this through a Fast-Slow Dual-System Architecture, in which competing code and skill hypotheses are maintained in a Hypothesis Graph. Value-of-Information Experiment Selection chooses physical experiments that can distinguish these hypotheses. Their outcomes guide Code-Skill Co-Evolution. The Slow System builds Hierarchical Memory, and Reward-Grounded Memory Learning selects effective memory according to their value for later Fast-System improvement. On RoboCasa365, EmbodiedRSI reaches 77.0% overall success and 71.3% on Composite-Unseen, compared with 40.1% for the best baseline. EmbodiedRSI also reaches 86.8% overall success on LIBERO-Pro. Beyond benchmark performance, EmbodiedRSI transfers zero-shot to real-world robot, achieving 71.3% overall success across multiple challenging tasks.

摘要（中文）：机器人基础模型提供了强大的视觉运动控制能力，但当物体位置或任务指令发生变化时，其性能可能会下降。进一步的改进通常需要对大量机器人数据进行后训练，而通过遥操作等方法收集这些数据成本高昂。智能体框架可以在模型周围进行自适应调整，但当前的自进化框架在决定应尝试哪些代码和技能修改时，对机器人试验数据的利用效率较低。我们提出了EmbodiedRSI，一种自进化的智能体框架，能够自主决定下一步探索的方向，并将由此产生的物理交互转化为改进后的代码和技能。EmbodiedRSI通过一种快慢双系统架构实现这一目标，在该架构中，相互竞争的代码和技能假设被维护在一个假设图中。信息价值实验选择机制会选择能够区分这些假设的物理实验，其实验结果指导代码-技能协同进化。慢系统构建分层记忆，而奖励驱动的记忆学习则根据记忆对后续快系统改进的价值来选择有效记忆。在RoboCasa365上，EmbodiedRSI实现了77.0%的总体成功率和71.3%的复合未见任务成功率，而最优基线的成绩为40.1%。EmbodiedRSI在LIBERO-Pro上也达到了86.8%的总体成功率。除基准性能外，EmbodiedRSI还能零样本迁移至真实世界机器人，在多个具有挑战性的任务中实现了71.3%的总体成功率。

Authors: Python Song, Zhixuan Liang, Kelsey Fu, Mengdi Wang, Junfeng Yang, Shilong Liu

DIVA: Dual-Space Intent-Aware Visual Attenuation for Vision-Language-Action Policies VLA

visual attenuation intent-aware vision-language-action OpenVLA LIBERO

简要说明：DIVA 提出了一种用于VLA策略的双空间视觉衰减模块，利用任务意图重新加权视觉令牌，在LIBERO和真实机器人上提高了成功率并增强了鲁棒性。

TLDR: DIVA introduces a dual-space visual attenuation module for VLA policies that uses task intent to reweight visual tokens, improving success rates on LIBERO and real robots under visual perturbations.

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies typically feed dense visual patch tokens into a language-action backbone, preserving scene context but offering no explicit mechanism to regulate how strongly different visual tokens influence policy computation. We introduce DIVA, a Dual-Space Intent-Aware Visual Attenuation module with an anchor-then-attenuate design. DIVA combines high-level task intent with low-level visual evidence to estimate patch-wise relevance anchors, then applies them in two complementary spaces: it reweights projected visual tokens before backbone entry and persistently attenuates low-relevance visual states within the backbone. DIVA preserves the full visual token sequence and requires no external grounding supervision. On LIBERO, DIVA improves OpenVLA-OFT from 96.6% to 98.0% average success and raises its zero-shot LIBERO-Plus score from 69.6 to 72.6. Real-world experiments further show consistent gains under task-irrelevant visual perturbations, supporting the robustness of intent-aware visual attenuation beyond simulation.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略通常将密集的视觉补丁令牌输入到语言-动作骨干网络中，从而保留场景上下文，但缺乏明确的机制来调控不同视觉令牌对策略计算的影响强度。我们提出了DIVA，一种具有“先锚定后衰减”设计的双空间意图感知视觉衰减模块。DIVA结合高层任务意图与低层视觉证据，估计逐补丁的相关性锚点，并在两个互补空间中施加作用：在骨干网络入口之前对投影后的视觉令牌进行重新加权，并在骨干网络内部持续衰减低相关性的视觉状态。DIVA保留完整的视觉令牌序列，且无需外部基础标注监督。在LIBERO基准上，DIVA将OpenVLA-OFT的平均成功率从96.6%提升至98.0%，并将其零样本LIBERO-Plus得分从69.6提升至72.6。真实世界实验进一步表明，在与任务无关的视觉扰动下，DIVA能够持续带来性能增益，验证了意图感知视觉衰减在仿真之外具备稳健性。

Authors: Kaixi Feng, Guoheng Sun, Ziyao Wang, Yexiao He, Zheyu Shen, Ang Li

Explicit Geometric Chain-of-Thought for Vision-Language-Action in Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

chain-of-thought VLA 3D priors planning-oriented grounding trajectory generation

简要说明：GeoCoTDrive 提出了一种用于基于 VLA 的自动驾驶的显式几何思维链框架，通过定位 2D 关键区域并检索局部 3D 先验来提升轨迹生成与规划安全性。

TLDR: GeoCoTDrive introduces an explicit geometric chain-of-thought framework for VLA-based autonomous driving, grounding 2D decision-critical regions and retrieving localized 3D priors to improve trajectory generation and planning safety.

Abstract: Vision-language-action~(VLA) models have emerged as a promising paradigm for autonomous driving. However, existing VLA models still suffer from a fundamental mismatch: driving actions require precise 3D geometric cues, while visual-language understanding and reasoning are largely conducted in a 2D semantic space. In this paper, we propose GeoCoTDrive, an explicit geometric chain-of-thought framework that grounds geometry in a planning-oriented manner. GeoCoTDrive follows a think with 2D first, drive with dedicated 3D priors paradigm. It first grounds 2D regions corresponding to decision-critical cues, and then retrieves localized 3D priors by sampling features from a geometric foundation model within the grounded regions. These localized geometric features are interleaved into the autoregressive context to support the trajectory generation. To supervise this process, we introduce planning-relevant grounding, a new region-level grounding task that focuses on local spatial cues directly affecting ego planning decisions, and construct the PlanningGrounding dataset to endow VLAs with planning-oriented grounding capability. Experiments across multiple end-to-end autonomous driving benchmarks show that GeoCoTDrive consistently improves safety-critical planning performance, demonstrating the effectiveness of the explicit geometric chain-of-thought process for VLA-based planning.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型已成为自动驾驶领域一种前景广阔的研究范式。然而，现有VLA模型仍存在一个根本性的不匹配问题：驾驶动作需要精确的三维几何线索，而视觉-语言理解与推理主要在二维语义空间中开展。本文提出GeoCoTDrive，一种以规划为导向的显式几何思维链框架，将几何信息嵌入推理过程。GeoCoTDrive遵循“先以二维信息进行思考，再借助专用三维先验进行驾驶”的范式。该框架首先定位与决策关键线索对应的二维区域，然后在几何基础模型中对这些已定位区域进行特征采样，从而检索局部三维先验。这些局部几何特征被交错插入自回归上下文，以支持轨迹生成。为监督这一过程，我们引入了“规划相关定位”——一种新的区域级定位任务，聚焦于直接影响自车规划决策的局部空间线索，并构建了PlanningGrounding数据集，赋予VLA模型以规划为导向的定位能力。在多个端到端自动驾驶基准上的实验表明，GeoCoTDrive持续提升了安全关键的规划性能，验证了显式几何思维链过程对基于VLA的规划任务的有效性。

Authors: Xingtai Gui, Yucheng Zhou, Dongqian Guo, Jiahao Gong, Feiyang Tan, Jianbing Shen

TouchScale: 500 Hours of Human Vision and Touch for Visual-Tactile Learning Manipulation

visual-tactile learning egocentric human interaction data contact-rich manipulation robot policy pretraining tactile sensor

简要说明：该论文介绍了 TouchScale，一个使用统一可穿戴设备收集的 500 小时自我中心视觉-触觉数据集，并展示了在零样本触觉预测、动作识别和真实机器人操作成功率方面的改进。

TLDR: This paper introduces TouchScale, a large-scale 500-hour dataset of egocentric human visual-tactile data collected with a unified wearable setup, demonstrating improvements in zero-shot tactile prediction, action recognition, and real-world robot manipulation success rates.

Abstract: Large-scale egocentric human interaction data is becoming an important source of physical supervision for embodied learning, yet video alone leaves the contact and pressure that characterize physical interaction unrecorded. Recent visual-tactile datasets provide this missing supervision, but their synchronized tactile data remain far smaller in volume than human video. Moreover, the largest resources often merge recordings from different sensors or annotation procedures, which makes the effect of data scale difficult to isolate. We therefore introduce TouchScale, a 500-hour dataset of contact-rich human interaction recorded with a single unified wearable setup. Its approximately 2K predefined task descriptions span everyday activities and structured manipulation, and each recording temporally aligns egocentric RGB-D video with wrist RGB video and dense full-hand bimanual tactile measurements. Compared with prior tactile data, training on the full TouchScale raises zero-shot contact IoU on data from an unseen tactile sensor from 0.134 to 0.383. Pretraining a visual encoder on TouchScale also yields the highest action recognition accuracy on three benchmarks among the compared visual-tactile datasets. Used for visual-tactile mid-training of a robot policy, TouchScale improves the average real-world success rate across four contact-rich manipulation tasks from 22.5% to 57.5%. With the sensor and collection protocol held fixed, both zero-shot tactile prediction and robot success show an overall upward trend as more TouchScale data is used. These results suggest that human visual-tactile data collected at scale with consistent sensing benefits both perception and robot manipulation. We will publicly release TouchScale, including all synchronized visual-tactile recordings and reconstructed object models, to support future research on scalable visual-tactile learning.

摘要（中文）：大规模的第一人称视角人际交互数据正逐渐成为具身学习物理监督的重要来源，然而仅凭视频无法记录物理交互中的接触与压力信息。近年来的视觉-触觉数据集提供了这一缺失的监督信号，但其同步触觉数据的规模仍远小于人类视频数据。此外，最大规模的数据集往往融合了来自不同传感器或标注流程的录制数据，这使得数据规模效应难以被单独评估。为此，我们提出了TouchScale，一个包含500小时接触丰富人际交互数据的数据集，所有数据均通过单一统一的可穿戴设备录制。其约2000条预定义任务描述涵盖了日常活动与结构化操作，每条录制数据在时间上对齐了第一人称RGB-D视频、腕部RGB视频以及密集的全手双手触觉测量。与先前的触觉数据相比，在完整TouchScale上训练后，针对未见触觉传感器的零样本接触IoU从0.134提升至0.383。在TouchScale上预训练视觉编码器，在三个基准测试中相比其他视觉-触觉数据集取得了最高的动作识别准确率。将TouchScale用于机器人策略的视觉-触觉中训练后，在四个接触丰富的操作任务中，平均真实世界成功率从22.5%提升至57.5%。在传感器与采集协议保持固定的条件下，随着TouchScale数据使用量的增加，零样本触觉预测与机器人成功率整体均呈上升趋势。这些结果表明，以一致传感方式大规模采集的人类视觉-触觉数据对感知和机器人操作均具有显著益处。我们将公开发布TouchScale，包括所有同步的视觉-触觉录制数据及重建的物体模型，以支持未来可扩展视觉-触觉学习的研究。

Authors: Dayou Li, Hao Wang, Qianqian Yang, Zihao Zhu, Haoquan Fang, Ziyao Zeng, Yan Han, Zihan Wang, Yan Wang, Baoru Huang, Dilin Wang, Kenji Shimada, Yiyue Luo, Manling Li, Teresa Lv, Mustafa Mukadam, Rakesh Ranjan, Ruohan Zhang, Qi He, Changliu Liu, Xu Chen, Marco Pavone, Bangya Liu, Jiachen Li, Masayoshi Tomizuka, Zhiwen Fan

LighTROcc: Lightweight 4D Occupancy Forecasting via Instance-Centric 3D Gaussians AutonomousDriving

4D occupancy forecasting instance-centric 3D Gaussians learned queries surround-view cameras

简要说明：LighTROcc提出了一种轻量级、以实例为中心的4D占用预测框架，利用3D高斯和可学习查询，在保持实例一致性的同时实现未来占用预测的高精度与高效率。

TLDR: LighTROcc proposes a lightweight instance-centric 4D occupancy forecasting framework using 3D Gaussians and learned queries for camera-based autonomous driving, achieving accurate and efficient predictions of future occupancy while maintaining instance consistency.

Abstract: Forecasting future 3D occupancy from surround-view cameras is essential for autonomous driving, yet existing approaches rely on dense voxel or bird's-eye-view representations whose cost grows rapidly with spatial resolution and prediction horizon. Because these representations do not explicitly maintain object identities, they also struggle to preserve instance consistency over time. We present LighTROcc, a lightweight instance-centric framework that represents movable objects with a compact set of learned queries and predicts present and future occupancy in a single forward pass. LighTROcc localizes each query through attention-guided forward lifting, combining image-space cross-attention, query-specific depth, and camera geometry to estimate its 3D center. Each instance is modeled as a mixture of anisotropic 3D Gaussians and propagated across future steps using predicted displacements, producing continuous, temporally consistent occupancy forecasts. Experiments on nuScenes and supplemented nuScenes-Occupancy show that LighTROcc outperforms the evaluated dense and instance-wise baselines in instance-level forecasting accuracy while maintaining strong voxel-level occupancy quality. Across different model configurations, LighTROcc achieves a favorable balance between forecasting accuracy and computational efficiency, demonstrating the potential of compact instance-centric modeling for camera-based 4D occupancy forecasting.

摘要（中文）：预测环视摄像头下的未来3D占据情况对自动驾驶至关重要，然而现有方法依赖于稠密体素或鸟瞰图表示，其计算成本随空间分辨率和预测时域的增加而迅速增长。由于这些表示未显式维护物体身份，它们也难以在时间上保持实例一致性。我们提出了LighTROcc，一种轻量级以实例为中心的框架，利用一组紧凑的学习查询来表示可移动物体，并通过单次前向传播同时预测当前及未来的占据情况。LighTROcc通过注意力引导的前向提升实现每个查询的定位，结合图像空间交叉注意力、查询特定深度和相机几何信息来估计其3D中心。每个实例被建模为各向异性3D高斯混合体，并利用预测位移在未来的时间步中传播，从而生成连续且时间一致的占据预测。在nuScenes及补充的nuScenes-Occupancy数据集上的实验表明，LighTROcc在实例级预测精度上优于所评估的稠密基线和实例级基线方法，同时保持较强的体素级占据质量。在不同模型配置下，LighTROcc在预测精度与计算效率之间实现了良好平衡，展示了紧凑的以实例为中心的建模在基于摄像头的4D占据预测中的潜力。

Authors: Hwanhee Jung, SeungHyeon Kim, Inkyu Koo, Qixing Huang, Sang Ho Yoon, Sangpil Kim

TopoCurve: Geometry-Aware Topology Reasoning via Bézier Curves in Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

Bézier curves topology reasoning 3D lane detection traffic elements deformable attention

简要说明：TopoCurve 将3D车道建模为端点固定的三次贝塞尔曲线，实现自动驾驶中的几何感知拓扑推理，在OpenLane-V2上达到最先进性能。

TLDR: TopoCurve models 3D lanes as endpoint-fixed cubic Bézier curves for geometry-aware topology reasoning in autonomous driving, achieving state-of-the-art OpenLane-V2 performance.

Abstract: Topology reasoning jointly detects 3D lanes and traffic elements from multi-view images and infers their structural connectivity. Current methods model lanes as discrete polylines, lacking smoothness, analytical tangent directions, and global spatial support for attention, while providing sparse topology supervision. We propose TopoCurve, a geometry-driven architecture for 3D topology reasoning grounded in a structured parametric lane representation. Lanes are modeled as endpoint-fixed cubic Bézier curves, enabling continuous geometry with exact endpoints and analytically defined directionality. We exploit this shared curve geometry across the entire pipeline. Endpoint distance and tangent alignment are encoded with multi-scale Fourier features and injected into the topology head. Sampled curve points serve as geometry-aligned references for deformable cross-attention spanning the full lane. Parallel curve-anchored attention branches provide diverse predictions for one-to-many topology supervision. These components form a tightly coupled cascade where representation enables geometric reasoning, guides feature aggregation, and supports denser supervision. TopoCurve achieves 50.6 OLS on the OpenLane-V2 benchmark without any post-processing, establishing a new state-of-the-art among end-to-end camera-only methods, and outperforms all existing approaches on endpoint detection (56.8 vs. 52.6 on DET_p).

摘要（中文）：拓扑推理从多视角图像中联合检测3D车道与交通元素，并推断它们之间的结构连接关系。现有方法将车道建模为离散折线，缺乏平滑性、解析切线方向以及用于注意力机制的全局空间支撑，同时仅提供稀疏的拓扑监督信号。我们提出TopoCurve，一种以几何驱动的架构，基于结构化的参数化车道表示进行3D拓扑推理。车道被建模为端点固定的三次贝塞尔曲线，从而实现了具有精确端点和解析定义方向性的连续几何。我们在整个流程中充分利用这种共享的曲线几何特性。端点距离和切线对齐通过多尺度傅里叶特征进行编码，并注入拓扑头。采样曲线点作为几何对齐的参考点，用于覆盖整个车道的可变形交叉注意力。并行的曲线锚定注意力分支为多对一的拓扑监督提供多样化的预测。这些组件构成了一个紧密耦合的级联结构，其中表示方式实现了几何推理、引导特征聚合，并支持更密集的监督。TopoCurve在OpenLane-V2基准上无需任何后处理即可达到50.6的OLS分数，在端到端纯相机方法中确立了新的最先进水平，并在端点检测上超越了所有现有方法（DET_p指标56.8对52.6）。

Authors: Mihai Bogdan Deaconu, Laura Dioşan

Never Look Back: Understanding Persistence in 3D Object Memory from Egocentric Videos Perception3D

3D object memory egocentric video spatial reasoning persistent memory embodied assistant

简要说明：本文提出了Ledger，一种用于具身助手的持久3D物体记忆系统，它从自我中心视频中构建长期空间记忆，在HD-EPIC、UCS-Bench和Ego4D基准上提升了空间问答性能。

TLDR: This paper introduces Ledger, a persistent 3D object memory for embodied assistants that builds long-term spatial memory from egocentric videos, improving spatial question answering in HD-EPIC, UCS-Bench, and Ego4D benchmarks.

Abstract: As we move through the world and carry out everyday tasks, we encounter objects that may become relevant only later. We are capable of recalling where we left something or what was inside a container, even without knowing we would need it later. Here, we study how an embodied assistant can build a similar memory from egocentric videos, by observing a person's day-to-day activities. We present Ledger, a persistent 3D object memory that combines object locations, their histories, and contextual descriptions. It associates observations across the recording and retains objects after they leave the view, including those the person never touches. It clusters each object's observations by resting locations and records a move only after repeated evidence, reducing the effect of localization noise. Short descriptions preserve details such as an object's contents or supporting surface. It saves these records to later answer spatial questions without having to access the original images or video. Our memory raises HD-EPIC accuracy from 29.7% to 42.6%, UCS-Bench accuracy from 33.8% to 38.5% and localizes Ego4D objects with a 0.99 m median error on returned predictions. Our analyses identify complementary roles for temporal persistence, contextual descriptions, and retrieval. Our study on 100 stitched streams of multiple scenes each further exposes failures in both retrieval and construction. Per-scene construction partially recovers the performance lost across scene changes compared to that of single scene streams.

摘要（中文）：当我们在世界中穿行并执行日常任务时，会遇到许多可能日后才变得相关的物体。我们能够回忆起把某物放在哪里，或者某个容器里有什么，即使当时并不知道日后会需要它。在此，我们研究一个具身助手如何通过观察一个人的日常活动，从第一人称视频中构建类似的记忆。我们提出了Ledger——一种持久的三维物体记忆，它结合了物体位置、历史轨迹和情境化描述。该记忆系统将记录过程中的观察关联起来，并在物体离开视野后仍保留它们，包括那些人们从未触碰过的物体。它通过静止位置对每个物体的观察进行聚类，并仅在获得重复证据后记录移动，从而减少定位噪声的影响。简短的描述保留了诸如物体内容或支撑表面等细节。系统保存这些记录以便日后回答空间问题，而无需访问原始图像或视频。我们的记忆方法将HD-EPIC的准确率从29.7%提升至42.6%，UCS-Bench的准确率从33.8%提升至38.5%，并在返回的预测结果上实现了Ego4D物体的中位误差为0.99米。我们的分析揭示了时间持久性、情境化描述和检索之间的互补作用。我们对每条包含多个场景的100条拼接视频流的研究，进一步揭示了检索和构建两方面失败。与单场景视频流相比，逐场景构建部分恢复跨场景变化所导致的性能损失。
