Authors: Shravan Chaudhari, William Paul, Suchi Saria, Rama Chellappa, Homanga Bharadhwaj

Robotic Boomerang Throwing via Model-Based Release Design Manipulation

model-based design release state 6-DoF manipulator boomerang throwing flight dynamics

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于模型的机器人回旋镖投掷框架，为6自由度机械臂设计释放状态和投掷动作，实现了首次机器人成功投掷回旋镖并返回。

TLDR: This paper presents a model-based framework for robotic boomerang throwing, designing release states and throwing motions for a 6-DoF manipulator to achieve a returning flight, demonstrating the first successful robotic boomerang throw.

Abstract: Throwing objects that generate aerodynamic lift can greatly extend robot throwing beyond ballistic flight. A returning boomerang is a challenging example because its flight depends strongly on the release velocity, attitude, and spin, while robotic manipulators cannot readily reproduce the rapid motions used in human throwing. We present a model-based framework for robotic boomerang throwing centered on the release state. We identify the boomerang flight dynamics in stages to predict how flight changes across design variations. To systematically design the robot throwing motion, we screen candidate parameters according to how strongly and consistently they control release spin under uncertain contact conditions. These models are then used to design the throwing motion and boomerang for a 6-DoF manipulator with limited joint speeds. To our knowledge, this is the first robotic manipulator to generate a returning boomerang flight. In the demonstrated returning trial, the boomerang is released at 51 rad/s (8.1 rev/s), reaches 2.03 m from the robot base, and returns to touch down 0.31 m from the base. The successful release differs significantly from the measured human throws, showing that a robot need not imitate human throwing motion to achieve a returning flight. The project page is available at https://robot-boomerang.github.io

摘要（中文）：产生空气动力的抛掷物体能够极大地扩展机器人抛掷的飞行范围，使其超越弹道飞行。回旋镖的返回飞行是一个具有挑战性的例子，因为其飞行过程强烈依赖于释放速度、姿态和旋转，而机器人操作器难以复现人类抛掷中使用的快速动作。我们提出了一种基于模型的机器人回旋镖抛掷框架，其核心在于释放状态。我们分阶段识别回旋镖的飞行动力学，以预测设计变化对飞行的影响。为系统性地设计机器人抛掷动作，我们根据候选参数在不确定接触条件下对释放旋转的控制强度和一致性进行筛选。这些模型随后被用于设计一个具有有限关节速度的六自由度操作器的抛掷动作和回旋镖。据我们所知，这是首个能够产生返回式回旋镖飞行的机器人操作器。在演示的返回试验中，回旋镖以51 rad/s（8.1转/秒）的角速度释放，到达距机器人底座2.03米处，并返回至距底座0.31米处着陆。这次成功的释放与测得的人类抛掷数据存在显著差异，表明机器人无需模仿人类抛掷动作即可实现返回飞行。项目页面见 https://robot-boomerang.github.io

Authors: Yang Liu, Colin Jones, Aude Billard

CMP-IRRT*: A Perception-Assisted Height-Adaptive Planner for Quadruped Robots Locomotion

quadruped robot height-adaptive planning informed RRT* perception-guided planning traversability

简要说明：本文提出了CMP-IRRT*，一种用于四足机器人的感知辅助高度自适应规划器，利用Channel Mamba PointNet引导采样和高度条件碰撞检查，使机器人能够穿越低矮障碍物并在可穿越场景中缩短路径长度。

TLDR: This paper proposes CMP-IRRT*, a perception-assisted height-adaptive planner for quadruped robots that uses a Channel Mamba PointNet to guide sampling and height-conditioned collision checking, enabling traversal of low obstacles and reducing path length in traversability-aware scenarios.

Abstract: Quadruped robots can traverse low obstacles, but many 2D planning pipelines still model obstacles as binary occupied regions and rely on sampling-based search that can be inefficient under a limited budget. We propose a perception-assisted height-adaptive planning framework based on CMP-IRRT*, a Channel Mamba PointNet-guided Informed RRT* planner. Given a calibrated top-view RGB observation, the perception module estimates obstacle regions and converts depth predictions into a ground-relative height map. The planner then performs height-conditioned collision checking, treating high obstacles as blocked while allowing low obstacles to be traversed, and uses the CMP guide to bias sampling toward promising regions while retaining standard free-space and informed sampling fallbacks. Experiments on 2D planning benchmarks show that CMP-IRRT* reduces explored nodes and iterations compared with classical and neural-guided baselines, and a controlled ablation supports the contribution of the Mamba-based guide. In constructed traversability-aware scenarios, the proposed planner reduces path length by up to 16.3% when low obstacles are traversable, and a Unitree Go2 demonstration further shows executable bypassing and traversal behaviors. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/MingfanZhao/height-adaptive-planner.

摘要（中文）：四足机器人能够跨越低矮障碍物，但许多二维规划流程仍将障碍物建模为二值占据区域，并依赖基于采样的搜索方法，在计算预算有限的情况下效率较低。我们提出了一种基于CMP-IRRT*的感知辅助高度自适应规划框架，其中CMP-IRRT*是一种基于通道Mamba PointNet引导的Informed RRT*规划器。给定一幅已标定的俯视RGB图像，感知模块估计障碍物区域，并将深度预测转换为相对于地面的高度图。随后，规划器执行基于高度条件的碰撞检测，将高障碍物视为阻挡，而允许低障碍物穿越，并利用CMP引导将采样偏向有前景的区域，同时保留标准的自由空间与informed采样回退机制。在二维规划基准上的实验表明，与经典方法和神经引导基线相比，CMP-IRRT*减少了探索节点数和迭代次数，且受控消融实验验证了基于Mamba的引导模块的贡献。在构建的可穿越性感知场景中，当低障碍物可穿越时，所提规划器将路径长度最多缩短16.3%；Unitree Go2实物演示进一步展示了可执行的绕行与穿越行为。我们的代码公开于 https://github.com/MingfanZhao/height-adaptive-planner。

Authors: Mingfan Zhao, Wendong Mao, Zhongfeng Wang

RobotWorld: Benchmarking Multimodal Agents for Robot Use Across Diverse Tasks and Embodiments Manipulation

robot use benchmark multimodal agents task execution embodied evaluation simulation testbed

简要说明：RobotWorld 是一个包含84个任务的仿真基准，涵盖操作、移动操作、运动、驾驶和空中控制，用于评估通用多模态智能体在物理机器人使用中的表现，揭示了感知与控制工作流与可靠任务完成之间的能力差距。

TLDR: RobotWorld is a simulation benchmark with 84 tasks across manipulation, mobile manipulation, locomotion, driving, and aerial control, used to evaluate how well general-purpose multimodal agents can perform physical robot use, revealing capability gaps between perception/control workflows and reliable task completion.

Abstract: General-purpose agents increasingly write code, use tools, and complete complex digital tasks, raising the question of how far these capabilities carry into the physical world. To investigate this, we introduce RobotWorld, a challenging simulation testbed for robot use: turning instructions and observations into physical task execution through robot interfaces. Its 84 tasks span manipulation, mobile manipulation, locomotion, driving, and aerial control, with explicit interaction budgets and executable success checks. By analysing task outcomes alongside execution traces, we identify both the capabilities that transfer and the gaps that prevent reliable completion. Furthermore, we find that current agents can construct sophisticated perception and control workflows, including image segmentation, camera calibration, spatial estimation, and dynamics-based computation. These capabilities, however, do not consistently compose into successful behaviour: agents lose task-relevant object states despite reaching commanded poses, fail to correct ineffective actions, recover too late, or mistake unfinished tasks for completion. This uneven transfer also differs across models: Astra succeeds more often on spatial and constrained-contact goals, whereas Opus 5.5 succeeds more often on continuous-balance and timed-interaction goals. By linking these outcomes to execution behaviour, RobotWorld provides both a rigorous proving ground and an empirical account of the remaining capability gaps, thereby establishing concrete targets for training and designing more reliable physical-world agents.

摘要（中文）：通用型智能体日益频繁地编写代码、使用工具并完成复杂的数字任务，这引发了一个问题：这些能力在多大程度上能够延伸至物理世界。为探究这一问题，我们提出了RobotWorld——一个具有挑战性的机器人使用仿真测试平台：通过机器人接口将指令与观测转化为物理任务执行。该平台涵盖84项任务，涉及操作、移动操作、运动控制、驾驶及空中控制，并配有明确的操作预算和可执行的成功判定标准。通过将任务结果与执行轨迹相结合进行分析，我们识别出可迁移的能力以及阻碍可靠完成任务的缺口。此外，我们发现当前智能体能够构建复杂的感知与控制工作流，包括图像分割、相机标定、空间估计及基于动力学的计算。然而，这些能力并不能稳定地组合为成功行为：智能体在到达指定姿态后仍会丢失任务相关的对象状态，无法纠正无效动作，恢复过迟，或将未完成任务误判为已完成。这种不均衡的迁移在不同模型间也存在差异：Astra在空间目标和受限接触类任务上成功率更高，而Opus 5.5在连续平衡和定时交互类任务上表现更优。通过将任务结果与执行行为相关联，RobotWorld既提供了严格的验证场地，也提供了对现存能力缺口的实证分析，从而为训练和设计更可靠的物理世界智能体确立了具体目标。

Authors: Zhiqin Yang, Chenxin Li, Xiaomeng Hu, Yibin Liu, Weidong Huang, Jiankai Sun, Haitao Li, Zijian Wu, Yuzhi Huang, Fanding Huang, Hanwen Sun, Jiashun Liu, Jingqi Tong, Mingxin Huang, Shaoli Hu, Shijue Huang, Tianyi Bai, Xinyuan Wang, Yunlong Lin, Zhengyang Tang, Zhexin Zhang, Zhuo Chen, Xierui Song, Juntao Dai, Boyuan Chen, Jiaming Ji, Fangneng Zhan, Mengkang Hu, Wei Xue, Yonggang Zhang, Han Hu, Tsung-Yi Ho, Yike Guo

Masked Generative Motion Planning with Geometry-Guided Token Search Manipulation

masked generative transformer motion planning geometry-guided search trajectory repair robot manipulation

简要说明：本文提出掩码生成运动规划（MGMP）与几何引导令牌搜索（GGTS），将掩码生成变压器从轨迹生成扩展到结构修复，在仿真和真实机器人任务上取得高成功率。

TLDR: This paper introduces Masked Generative Motion Planning (MGMP) with Geometry-Guided Token Search (GGTS), a method that extends masked generative transformers for trajectory planning from generation to structural repair, achieving high success rates on simulated and real robot tasks.

Abstract: Generative motion planners typically use learned trajectory priors for initial generation, while leaving test-time repair to local continuous refinement. We introduce Masked Generative Motion Planning (MGMP), which extends the learned prior from efficient parallel generation to structural repair. A masked generative transformer generates discrete trajectory candidates in parallel, and Geometry-Guided Token Search (GGTS) uses scene geometry to target where to edit and which prior-supported alternatives to evaluate. This turns refinement into an efficient search over discrete motion alternatives, enabling route-level restructuring beyond local trajectory deformation. MGMP achieves 96% success on Ring Maze and 82% repair success on Controlled Route Invalidation on Kuka, exceeding the strongest external baselines by 23 and 25 percentage points, respectively. It further generalizes to unseen layouts, additional obstacles, unseen geometries, single- and dual-arm planning, and real-world Baxter tasks.

摘要（中文）：生成式运动规划器通常使用学习到的轨迹先验进行初始生成，而将测试时的修复留给局部连续优化。我们提出掩码生成运动规划（MGMP），将学习到的先验从高效并行生成扩展到结构修复。掩码生成Transformer并行生成离散轨迹候选，几何引导的令牌搜索（GGTS）利用场景几何确定编辑目标并评估受先验支持的替代方案。这将修复转变为对离散运动替代方案的高效搜索，使得能够实现超越局部轨迹变形的路线级重构。MGMP在Ring Maze上达到96%的成功率，在Kuka的Controlled Route Invalidation上达到82%的修复成功率，分别超过最强外部基线23和25个百分点。此外，它还能泛化到未见过的布局、额外障碍物、未见过的几何形状、单臂和双臂规划，以及真实世界的Baxter任务。

Authors: Lipeng Zhuang, Yingdong Ru, Shiyu Fan, Edmond S. L. Ho, Gerardo Aragon Camarasa, Paul Henderson

Benchmarking Behavioral Steerability in Behavior Foundation Models HumanoidEmbodied

Behavior Foundation Models behavioral steerability multimodal motion corpus benchmark humanoid behavior generation

简要说明：本文提出了RoboSteer，这是首个用于评估行为基础模型（BFM）中行为可控性的基准，将其组织为三级层次结构，并对9个现有BFM进行了大规模实证研究。

TLDR: This paper introduces RoboSteer, the first benchmark for evaluating behavioral steerability in Behavior Foundation Models (BFMs), organizing it into a three-level hierarchy and conducting a large-scale empirical study across 9 existing BFMs.

Abstract: Behavior Foundation Models (BFMs) are emerging as a paradigm for translating human intentions into executable humanoid behaviors. As these models evolve beyond behavior generation toward general-purpose behavioral systems, a fundamental question arises: can they be reliably steered according to user intentions? In this paper, we introduce the concept of behavioral steerability, defined as the ability of BFMs to faithfully generate behaviors that satisfy user-specified intentions. To study this capability, we present RoboSteer, the first benchmark for behavioral steerability in BFMs. RoboSteer organizes behavioral steerability into a three-level hierarchy-Conditional Steering, Constraint Steering, and Compositional Steering-and establishes a unified evaluation framework supported by a large-scale multimodal motion corpus. Using RoboSteer, we conduct the first large-scale empirical study of behavioral steerability across 9 existing BFMs. We view behavioral steerability as more than a capability for controlling motion: it concerns how embodied systems translate human intentions into purposeful actions. We hope RoboSteer will advance research on intention realization as a foundation for general-purpose embodied intelligence.

摘要（中文）：行为基础模型（BFMs）正逐渐成为将人类意图转化为可执行的人形行为的一种范式。随着这些模型从行为生成向通用行为系统演进，一个根本性问题随之浮现：它们能否根据用户意图被可靠地引导？在本文中，我们引入了行为可引导性的概念，将其定义为BFMs忠实生成满足用户指定意图的行为的能力。为研究这一能力，我们提出了RoboSteer，这是首个面向BFMs行为可引导性的基准测试。RoboSteer将行为可引导性组织为三个层级——条件引导、约束引导和组合引导——并建立了一个由大规模多模态运动语料库支持的统一评估框架。借助RoboSteer，我们对9个现有BFMs的行为可引导性进行了首次大规模实证研究。我们将行为可引导性不仅视为一种运动控制能力，更关注具身系统如何将人类意图转化为有目的的行动。我们希望RoboSteer能够推动意图实现研究的发展，为通用具身智能奠定基础。

Authors: Minghe Gao, Zhanxi Yan, Jiahui Liu, Wendong Bu, Xiaoting Chen, Qizhou Wang, Yi Su, Siliang Tang, Jun Xiao, Yueting Zhuang, Tat-Seng Chua, Juncheng Li

TacHair: Tactile Contact-Distribution Guided Online Correction for Robotic Hair Stroking and Perception Manipulation

tactile sensing contact distribution online correction hair stroking visuotactile policy

简要说明：TacHair 提出了一种基于触觉接触分布引导的在线修正框架，用于机器人梳发任务，在真实机器人实验中提高了接触维持和任务成功率。

TLDR: TacHair introduces a tactile contact-distribution guided online correction framework for robotic hair stroking, improving contact maintenance and task success in real-robot trials.

Abstract: Hair stroking is common in daily grooming and personal care, and is also widely used in hair-product evaluation, motivating robots with similar physical interaction capabilities. Existing robotic hair-care and surface-following methods mainly rely on trajectory planning, compliance, force regulation, or tactile-conditioned policies, but deformable hair can remain in contact while gradually drifting across the end-effector, making local interaction difficult to regulate. We propose TacHair, a tactile contact-distribution guided online correction framework that represents high-resolution tactile observations as a spatial hair-contact distribution. A visuotactile imitation policy generates the nominal stroking motion, while a separately trained residual module corrects local contact deviations, separating task progression from contact recovery. We evaluate TacHair in 525 real-robot trials across five head geometries and three hair conditions. A successful stroke requires both sufficient task progression and contact maintenance; our method improves success from 42.9% to 62.3% and contact maintenance from 59.4% to 88.0% over the same visuotactile policy without correction. These results demonstrate spatial tactile contact distributions as an effective feedback representation for contact-preserving interaction with deformable and visually occluded surfaces. Demos, code, and datasets are available at https://tachair.github.io.

摘要（中文）：抚摸头发在日常生活梳理和个人护理中十分常见，同时也被广泛用于护发产品评估，这促使机器人具备类似的物理交互能力。现有的机器人护发及表面跟随方法主要依赖于轨迹规划、柔顺控制、力调节或基于触觉条件的策略，然而可变形头发在交互过程中可能持续接触，却同时在末端执行器表面逐渐滑移，使得局部交互难以调控。我们提出TacHair，一种基于触觉接触分布引导的在线校正框架，将高分辨率触觉观测表示为空间上的头发接触分布。视觉-触觉模仿策略生成名义上的抚摸动作，而一个单独训练的残差模块则校正局部接触偏差，从而将任务推进与接触恢复分离开来。我们在五种头部几何形状和三种头发状态条件下进行了525次真实机器人试验，对TacHair进行了评估。一次成功的抚摸既需要足够的任务推进，也需要持续的接触保持；与未校正的相同视觉-触觉策略相比，我们的方法将成功率从42.9%提升至62.3%，接触保持率从59.4%提升至88.0%。这些结果表明，空间触觉接触分布是一种有效的反馈表征，适用于与可变形且视觉遮挡表面的保接触交互。演示视频、代码和数据集可在 https://tachair.github.io 获取。

Authors: Ruiyi Hu, Yongqiang Zhao, Daniel Bak, Yupeng Wang, Xuyang Zhang, Shan Luo

Lifelong small-object navigation in changing object layouts: a benchmark and method VLN

lifelong navigation small-object navigation object relocation viewpoint-anchored memory benchmark

简要说明：该论文提出了一个小型物体终身导航基准LiSoNav-Eval，并提出了IVAM-Nav方法，通过视角锚定记忆来处理小型物体感知和记忆更新。

TLDR: The paper introduces LiSoNav-Eval, a benchmark for lifelong small-object navigation with changing object layouts, and proposes IVAM-Nav, a visual navigation method that uses viewpoint-anchored memory to handle small-object perception and memory updates.

Abstract: Household robots need to continually navigate to different objects in the same environment, many of which are small and portable, such as tools and toys. Their small visual footprint and frequent occlusion make reliable observation difficult, and they may be moved by people without the robot observing the changes. We formulate this challenging task as Lifelong Small-object Navigation in Changing Object Layouts (LiSoNav-COL). Agents must seek suitable viewpoints for reliable observation, accumulate and reuse scene knowledge to efficiently locate subsequent targets, and update outdated memory after object relocation. To eliminate the need for prior scene scanning, we also require agents to start navigation with empty scene memory. Although practical, this task still lacks benchmarks designed around its defining assumptions. To bridge this gap, we introduce LiSoNav-Eval, a dedicated benchmark spanning 28 indoor scenes with 45 small-object categories. Its lifelong navigation sequences include both unchanged and relocated targets to evaluate memory reuse and adaptation to object relocation. To address this challenging task, we propose a navigation method based on multi-view Inspection with Viewpoint-Anchored Memory, dubbed IVAM-Nav. IVAM-Nav actively observes supporting surfaces from complementary viewpoints for reliable small-object perception and anchors the resulting memory to their observation viewpoints, supporting relational memory reuse and revalidation under similar viewing conditions. Extensive experiments on LiSoNav-Eval demonstrate favorable performance of IVAM-Nav against representative methods. Benchmark analyses also show that smaller objects, larger environments, and longer relocation distances pose greater challenges. The dataset and code are available here.

摘要（中文）：家用机器人需要持续在同一环境中导航至不同的物体，其中许多物体体积小且可移动，例如工具和玩具。由于其视觉足迹小且频繁被遮挡，可靠的观测变得困难，并且这些物体可能被人在机器人未察觉的情况下移动。我们将这一具有挑战性的任务定义为“变化物体布局中的终身小物体导航”（LiSoNav-COL）。智能体必须寻找合适的视角进行可靠观测，积累并重用场景知识以高效定位后续目标，并在物体重新布置后更新过时的记忆。为消除对预先场景扫描的需求，我们还要求智能体在场景记忆为空的情况下开始导航。尽管该任务具有实用性，但当前仍缺乏围绕其核心假设设计的基准。为弥补这一空白，我们引入了LiSoNav-Eval，一个专用基准，涵盖28个室内场景和45个小物体类别。其终身导航序列既包含未移动的目标，也包含被重新布置的目标，以评估记忆重用和对物体重新布置的适应能力。针对这一挑战性任务，我们提出了一种基于多视角观察与视角锚定记忆的导航方法，称为IVAM-Nav。IVAM-Nav从互补视角主动观察支撑表面，以实现可靠的小物体感知，并将所得记忆锚定至其观察视角，支持在相似观察条件下进行关联性记忆重用与重新验证。在LiSoNav-Eval上的广泛实验表明，IVAM-Nav相较于代表性方法表现出优越性能。基准分析还显示，更小的物体、更大的环境以及更长的重新布置距离带来更大的挑战。数据集和代码可在以下链接获取。

Authors: Jiagan Huang, Zikun Zhou, Zijian Ni, Hongpeng Wang, Guangming Lu, Jun Yu, Wenjie Pei

Tactile Reconstruction of Contact Task Frames and Forces for Hybrid Force/Motion Control Manipulation

tactile sensing force estimation task frame estimation hybrid force/motion control extended Kalman filter

简要说明：本文提出了一种仅使用软体光学触觉传感在线估计接触力和时变任务坐标系的方法，用于混合力/运动控制，通过自标注数据采集和扩展卡尔曼滤波实现，并在UR10机械臂上进行了验证。

TLDR: This paper presents a method for online estimation of contact force and a time-varying task frame for hybrid force/motion control using only soft optical tactile sensing, with self-labeling data acquisition and an Extended Kalman Filter, demonstrated on a UR10 manipulator.

Abstract: Hybrid force/motion control requires knowledge of the interaction force and of a task frame defining the force- and motion-controlled directions. These quantities are usually obtained from force/torque sensing or model-based residuals, often assuming also a nominal environment model. This work addresses the online estimation of the contact force and a possibly time-varying task frame using only soft optical tactile sensing, under the assumption of locally planar contact with a negligible contact moment. The proposed method maps a single image of the deformed elastomer of a soft optical tactile sensor to observable contact variables: indentation depth, two surface-to-sensor tilt angles, and 3D contact force, each with a per-sample uncertainty estimate. The mapping is learned through a self-labeling acquisition procedure, in which a manipulator imposes controlled contacts while an auxiliary Force/Torque sensor is used offline to provide ground-truth labels. The tactile measurement is then fused with robot proprioceptive data in an Extended Kalman Filter, producing a continuously updated estimate of the contact task frame and of the interaction force. Control experiments with a DigiTac sensor mounted on a UR10 manipulator demonstrate closed-loop contact force regulation against a flat rigid board in linear and angular motion by a human operator, with touch as the only exteroceptive feedback.

摘要（中文）：混合力/运动控制需要了解接触力以及定义力和运动控制方向的任务坐标系。这些量通常通过力/力矩传感或基于模型的残差获得，且往往假设存在名义上的环境模型。本研究针对接触力矩可忽略的局部平面接触场景，提出仅利用软体光学触觉传感实现接触力及可能时变任务坐标系的在线估计方法。所提方法将软体光学触觉传感器变形弹性体的单幅图像映射为可观测接触变量：压痕深度、两个表面-传感器倾斜角以及三维接触力，并为每个样本提供不确定性估计。该映射通过自标记采集流程学习，在采集过程中，机械臂施加受控接触，同时使用辅助力/力矩传感器离线提供真实标签。随后，触觉测量值与机器人本体感觉数据在扩展卡尔曼滤波器中融合，生成接触任务坐标系和接触力的连续更新估计。在搭载DigiTac传感器的UR10机械臂上进行的控制实验表明，在仅以触觉作为外部反馈的条件下，系统能够对操作人员施加的线性及角向运动中的平面刚性板实现闭环接触力调节。

Authors: Antonio Rapuano, Simone Orelli, Barbara Bazzana, Antonio Franchi, Alessandro De Luca

A Scoping Review and Experimental Study on Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback for Human-Robot Collaboration HumanoidEmbodied

RLHF Human-robot collaboration feedback timing safety metrics VR experiment

简要说明：本文对人机协作中的RLHF进行了范围综述，并通过VR实验证明用户主动反馈比系统主动反馈更能捕捉感知安全性。

TLDR: This paper presents a scoping review of RLHF in Human-Robot Collaboration and an empirical VR experiment showing that user-initiated feedback better captures perceived safety than system-initiated feedback for robot proxemic behavior.

Abstract: Human-Robot Collaboration (HRC) can facilitate mass customisation in Industry 4.0, with Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) representing a promising approach for developing safe AI-based robots. Practical challenges remain regarding safety during AI development, human feedback quality, and bidirectional human-robot adaptation. We conducted a scoping review of RLHF in HRC systems, mapping methods that address these challenges. Following PRISMA guidelines, we screened 199 records and included 20 peer-reviewed publications (2020-2025) spanning multiple HRC domains. To our knowledge, this is the first review focused on the bidirectional, closed-loop design of RLHF. Our review found multiple feedback modalities enabling data collection in various feedback formats. Collected data can be integrated at different stages of AI training, resulting in a multi-step development process. Pilot experiments are commonly used to evaluate HRC systems based on both human and robot metrics. To empirically test a key gap identified in the review, we conducted a between-subjects VR experiment comparing system- and user-initiated feedback on robot proxemic behaviour for safe navigation. Using Bayesian models, we analysed the relation between the collected feedback and safety metrics: psychological safety (post-experiment questionnaire) and physical safety (inverse time-to-collision). Results show that user-initiated feedback captures perceived safety better than system-initiated feedback, indicating that feedback timing directly affects feedback quality. Our review and experiment findings show that RLHF relies on appropriate feedback methods to ensure AI safety in HRC, and future RLHF research should prioritise realistic HRC experiments evaluating the effects of feedback collection methods on relevant human and robot metrics.

摘要（中文）：人机协作（HRC）可促进工业4.0中的大规模定制，其中基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）是开发安全的人工智能机器人的一种有前景的方法。然而，在人工智能开发过程中的安全性、人类反馈质量以及人机双向适应方面仍存在实际挑战。我们对HRC系统中的RLHF进行了范围综述，梳理了应对这些挑战的方法。遵循PRISMA指南，我们筛选了199条记录，并纳入了20篇跨越多个HRC领域的同行评审出版物（2020-2025年）。据我们所知，这是首个聚焦RLHF双向闭环设计的综述。我们的综述发现，多种反馈模态支持以不同反馈格式收集数据。收集的数据可在人工智能训练的不同阶段整合，从而形成多步骤的开发流程。试点实验通常用于基于人类和机器人双重指标评估HRC系统。为实证检验综述中识别的一个关键空白，我们开展了一项受试者间虚拟现实（VR）实验，比较了系统发起和用户发起的反馈对机器人避让行为（proxemic behaviour）安全导航的影响。利用贝叶斯模型，我们分析了所收集反馈与安全性指标之间的关系：心理安全性（实验后问卷）和物理安全性（逆碰撞时间）。结果表明，用户发起的反馈比系统发起的反馈能更好地捕捉感知安全性，表明反馈时机直接影响反馈质量。我们的综述和实验发现表明，RLHF依赖于适当的反馈方法来确保HRC中的人工智能安全，未来RLHF研究应优先开展真实场景下的HRC实验，评估反馈收集方法对相关人类和机器人指标的影响。

Authors: Alexandra Coroiu, Andrea Vogt, Viktor Werbilo, Andreas Poppele, Johann Christensen, Sven Hallerbach

Towards Accurate End-Effector Localization for UMI-Style Robotic Manipulation Teaching Manipulation

end-effector localization visual-inertial odometry fiducial markers demonstration learning manipulation dataset

简要说明：本文提出了MILD基准数据集，用于评估UMI式机器人操作教学中的末端执行器定位，并提出了AprilVINS系统，通过融合鱼眼视觉惯性里程计与AprilTag几何，在遮挡下实现毫米级精度。

TLDR: This paper introduces MILD, a benchmark dataset for evaluating end-effector localization in UMI-style robotic manipulation teaching, and AprilVINS, a visual-inertial system that fuses fisheye VIO with AprilTag geometry to achieve millimeter-level accuracy under occlusions.

Abstract: Robot demonstration learning requires accurate and temporally complete end-effector localization during close-range manipulation and camera occlusion. Existing SLAM benchmarks emphasize navigation motions, whereas manipulation datasets prioritize policy learning over localization evaluation. We introduce MILD, a Manipulation-Interface Localization Dataset with real-world and simulation sequences. The real-world subset provides 86 sensor sequences from Insta360 X5 and Insight9 across 15 repeated tabletop tasks, calibration assets, and a per-execution robot end-effector reference trajectory. The simulation subset, MILD-Sim, extends task coverage in Isaac Sim for controlled manipulation-replay studies. Benchmarking visual-inertial and fiducial-aided systems on instrumented real-world recordings reveals large differences in both TCP-relative trajectory error and temporal coverage, even under the same nominal task. To support marker-augmented teaching workspaces without a pre-surveyed fiducial map, we present AprilVINS, which combines fisheye visual-inertial estimation with sequence-local AprilTag geometry and separates prior admission from guarded export of the jointly optimized state. On Insta360 AprilTag4 recordings, AprilVINS(full) under a unified protocol with sequence-specific profiles reaches millimeter-level SE(3)-aligned TCP-relative APE RMSE with high time completion and lower reported error than the tested routes under their respective protocols, whereas fisheye VIO without tag factors remains at centimeter scale. Ablations separate accuracy from exportability, and a MILD-Sim replay study provides task-specific tolerance references for interpreting those error magnitudes. Together, MILD and AprilVINS provide a diagnostic benchmarking framework for UMI-style demonstration collection. Code, datasets, and evaluation manifests will be released upon acceptance.

摘要（中文）：机器人示教学习要求在手部近距离操作及相机遮挡条件下，实现精确且时间完整的目标端执行器定位。现有SLAM基准测试侧重于导航运动，而操作数据集则优先考虑策略学习而非定位评估。我们提出了MILD，一个包含真实世界与仿真序列的操作接口定位数据集。真实世界子集提供了来自Insta360 X5和Insight9的86组传感器序列，覆盖15项重复性桌面任务，并包含标定资产及每次执行时机器人末端执行器的参考轨迹。仿真子集MILD-Sim在Isaac Sim中扩展了任务覆盖范围，用于受控的操作回放研究。在仪器化的真实世界录制数据上对视觉-惯性系统及标识辅助系统进行基准测试，结果显示，即使在相同的名义任务下，TCP相对轨迹误差和时间覆盖率均存在显著差异。为支持无需预先测量的标识地图即可工作的标识增强型教学工作空间，我们提出了AprilVINS，该方法将鱼眼视觉-惯性估计与序列局部AprilTag几何相结合，并将先验信息的引入与联合优化状态的受保护导出相分离。在Insta360 AprilTag4录制数据上，采用统一协议及序列特定配置的AprilVINS(full)在SE(3)对齐的TCP相对APE RMSE上达到毫米级精度，且时间完成度高，所报误差低于各测试路线在各自协议下的结果；而未加入标识因子的鱼眼VIO则仍停留在厘米级。消融实验将精度与可导出性分离开来，MILD-Sim回放研究则为解释上述误差量级提供了任务特定的容差参考。MILD与AprilVINS共同为UMI式示教数据采集提供了一套诊断性基准测试框架。代码、数据集及评估清单将在论文被接收后发布。

Authors: Junjie Zhang, Deteng Zhang, Zhisong Xu, Bo Sun, Liuyang Li, Yihong Tian, Jie Yin

Enhancing Robotic Perception and Adaptability through Sensor Fusion and Origami-Inspired Designs Perception3D

sensor fusion origami-inspired wheels LiDAR depth fusion RTAB-Map mobile robot perception

简要说明：本文提出一种采用折纸灵感轮式结构的紧凑型移动机器人，通过底盘俯仰主动控制LiDAR视角，并将2D LiDAR与RGB-D深度融合，以在变化光照和纹理下提升场景几何恢复能力。

TLDR: This paper presents a compact mobile robot with origami-inspired wheels that actively controls LiDAR viewpoint via chassis pitch, and fuses 2D LiDAR with RGB-D depth to improve scene geometry recovery under varying lighting and texture.

Abstract: Compact mobile robots must recover scene geometry under changing lighting and surface texture while working within tight payload and cost limits. We present a compact mobile robot that uses origami-inspired wheels for locomotion and active control of its sensing geometry. As the wheels move between terrain-adaptive configurations, the changing chassis pitch sweeps a 2D LiDAR through intermediate elevations; held wheel positions provide a chosen viewing angle. An IMU accounts for chassis attitude, and a fusion node projects LiDAR returns into the RGB-D depth stream supplied to RTAB-Map. The arrangement uses the wheel actuation already present on a sub-300 USD, sub-2 kg prototype to extend the scanner's viewing geometry. We assess depth fusion in a textureless indoor corridor and an outdoor sunlit area, with three runs per sensor configuration in each setting. Mean full-frame invalid-depth fractions fell from 21% to 11% indoors and from 48% to 18% outdoors. The prototype combines improved depth coverage with a continuously adjustable LiDAR viewpoint using the same actuation that reconfigures its wheels.

摘要（中文）：紧凑型移动机器人必须在严苛的载荷与成本限制下，于光照变化和表面纹理复杂的环境中恢复场景几何信息。我们提出了一种采用折纸启发式车轮实现运动并主动控制其感知几何结构的紧凑型移动机器人。当车轮在不同地形自适应构型之间切换时，底盘俯仰角的变化会使二维激光雷达在中间高度进行扫描；固定车轮位置则可提供选定的观测角度。惯性测量单元用于补偿底盘姿态，融合节点将激光雷达回波投影至提供给RTAB-Map的RGB-D深度流中。该布置利用一个成本低于300美元、重量低于2千克的样机上已有的车轮驱动机构，扩展了扫描仪的观测几何范围。我们在无纹理的室内走廊和阳光照射的室外区域评估了深度融合效果，每个环境中每种传感器配置进行了三次实验。全帧无效深度比例的平均值在室内从21%降至11%，在室外从48%降至18%。该样机在利用同一套用于车轮重构的驱动机构实现连续可调激光雷达视角的同时，提升了深度覆盖率。

Authors: Namai Chandra, Jaison Jose, Kavi Arya, Shivaram Kalyanakrishnan

UltraWorld: Learning Interactive Ultrasound World Models from Untracked Clinical Videos with Acoustic Sampling Map WorldModel

world model ultrasound self-distillation action following acoustic sampling map

简要说明：UltraWorld 提出了一种自蒸馏方法，从未追踪的临床视频中学习交互式超声世界模型，利用合成动作-视频对和声学采样图来提高预测保真度和动作跟随能力，用于自主超声扫描。

TLDR: UltraWorld introduces a self-distillation approach to learn interactive ultrasound world models from untracked clinical videos, using synthetic action-video pairs and an Acoustic Sampling Map to improve prediction fidelity and action following for autonomous ultrasound scanning.

Abstract: World models can enable autonomous ultrasound scanning by predicting the outcomes of probe motions from local observations. Learning this action--observation relationship typically relies on synchronized video--pose pairs, which are costly to collect at scale and largely unavailable in routine clinical recordings. Reliable action following further requires modeling ultrasound's cross-sectional sampling geometry. We present UltraWorld, a self-distillation recipe that transfers priors from clinical ultrasound videos into interactive world models without real action annotations. Starting from clinical videos, we adapt a video foundation model into an ultrasound generator conditioned on reference images and anatomical masks. Anatomical masks sampled along programmable trajectories through 3D anatomy provide spatial guidance for synthesizing action--video pairs. We then use these synthetic pairs to self-distill the generator into a world model that predicts future observations from local observations and actions, without requiring anatomical masks or other 3D assets at inference time. To further improve action following, we introduce the Acoustic Sampling Map (AsMap), which represents probe poses and imaging settings as pixel-wise 3D sampling positions, beam directions, and depths. Experiments demonstrate improved prediction fidelity and action following. Across nine simulated closed-loop local planning episodes, UltraWorld reduces the mean final distance to the goal and orientation error by 29\% and 38\%, respectively, compared with visual servoing. Project Page: https://ultraworld-project.github.io/.

摘要（中文）：世界模型可以通过局部观测预测探头运动的结果，从而实现自主超声扫描。学习这种动作-观测关系通常依赖于同步的视频-姿态对，这类数据在大规模采集时成本高昂，且在常规临床记录中基本不可获得。可靠的动作跟随还需要对超声的横截面采样几何进行建模。我们提出了UltraWorld，一种自蒸馏方法，可从临床超声视频中迁移先验知识到交互式世界模型，而无需真实动作标注。从临床视频出发，我们将视频基础模型改编为以参考图像和解剖掩膜为条件的超声生成器。沿着可编程轨迹在三维解剖结构上采样的解剖掩膜，为合成动作-视频对提供空间指导。随后，我们利用这些合成对将生成器自蒸馏为一个世界模型，该模型能够从局部观测和动作预测未来观测，且在推理时无需解剖掩膜或其他三维资产。为了进一步提升动作跟随能力，我们引入了声学采样图（AsMap），它以像素级三维采样位置、波束方向和深度表示探头姿态及成像设置。实验表明，预测保真度和动作跟随能力均得到提升。在九次模拟闭环局部规划任务中，与视觉伺服相比，UltraWorld将到目标的平均最终距离和方向误差分别降低了29%和38%。项目页面：https://ultraworld-project.github.io/。

Authors: Keke Yang, Erqi Wang, Sainan Guan, Hongliang Ren

On-Demand Robotic Assembly via Differentiable Geometric Part Repair Manipulation

generative design differentiable repair robotic assembly graph attention network hardware-specific optimization

简要说明：本文提出了一种端到端流水线，利用生成式AI代理将自然语言提示转换为3D木质装配设计，并通过可微修复阶段优化组件几何形状以提高机器人可装配性，实验表明螺丝驱动成功率和双UR5e机器人物理装配均有提升。

TLDR: This paper presents an end-to-end pipeline that uses a generative AI agent to convert natural language prompts into 3D wooden assembly designs, followed by a differentiable repair stage that optimizes component geometries for robotic assemblability, demonstrating improved screwdriving success and physical assembly with two UR5e robots.

Abstract: Transitioning from a digital design to a robotic assembly process currently requires months of expert manual tuning to reconcile part geometries with robotic constraints. This paper presents an end-to-end, autonomous pipeline for the design and physical construction of bespoke wooden assemblies. A generative AI agent translates user prompts into initial 3D geometries, balancing the visual fidelity of the design with select physical constraints. The assemblability of the design is further improved by a gradient-based repair stage that backpropagates through a graph attention network surrogate to adjust component geometries. In addition to correcting for disjointed and overlapping components, we demonstrate hardware-specific corrections, differentiably optimizing the geometry of components to enable robot screwdriving for 86.7% of 60 novel natural language inputs, significantly outperforming prior work by a factor of ten. For ten of the structures, we physically demonstrate assemblability with two UR5e robots. This work marks a meaningful step toward on-demand robotic manufacturing, enabling the rapid production of customized, low-volume goods.

摘要（中文）：从数字设计过渡到机器人装配过程，目前需要数月的人工精细调试，以协调零件几何形状与机器人约束条件。本文提出了一种端到端的自主流水线，用于定制木制组件的设计与物理构建。一个生成式AI代理将用户提示转化为初始三维几何形状，在设计的视觉保真度与若干物理约束之间取得平衡。设计的可装配性进一步通过基于梯度的修复阶段得以提升，该阶段通过图注意力网络代理进行反向传播，以调整组件几何形状。除了修正脱节和重叠的组件外，我们还展示了针对硬件特定修正，通过差分优化组件几何形状，使机器人螺丝驱动在60个新颖自然语言输入中的86.7%上得以实现，显著优于先前工作达十倍。对于其中十个结构，我们使用两台UR5e机器人实际验证了可装配性。这项工作标志着向按需机器人制造迈出了有意义的一步，能够实现定制化、小批量商品的快速生产。

Authors: Millicent Schlafly, Fabio Schaub, Diogo Costa Pais, Luca Lelli, Janne Dvorak, Claire Colmont, Sven Marti, Mark D. Fuge

RoboPace: Contact-Aware Time-Optimal Retiming for Action-Chunk Policies Manipulation

contact-aware retiming action-chunk policies time-optimal control dual-arm manipulation VLA policies

简要说明：RoboPace 提出了一种接触感知的在线重定时层，调整动作块策略的执行速度以适应机器人运动学和动力学约束，在不重新训练的情况下提升接触丰富的双臂操作的成功率和速度。

TLDR: RoboPace introduces a contact-aware online retiming layer that adjusts the execution speed of action-chunk policies to respect robot kinematic and dynamic limits, improving success and speed in contact-rich dual-arm manipulation without retraining.

Abstract: Robot manipulation data collection has been shifting from teleoperation toward robot-free demonstrations, through interfaces such as the Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) or directly from human hands. Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies trained on such data inherit the demonstrator's timing. Yet human timing does not directly transfer to robots: compliant hands tolerate fast contact, whereas robots may overshoot due to actuator and tracking limitations; conversely, robots can move faster in free space. This motivates a unified approach that reconciles execution speed with contact safety. We present RoboPace, an online retiming layer that preserves the policy's geometric path while adapting its timing, respecting the target robot's kinematic and dynamic constraints. It adapts execution speed based on predicted contact, jointly accounting for contact-dependent speed limits and the robot's motion constraints. The method requires no policy retraining and operates in real time. Across three contact-rich tasks on a dual-arm robot, faster uniform execution and physical-limit-only retiming largely fail. RoboPace instead achieves higher overall success than slow uniform execution while completing four of five commands in approximately half the time, retaining the reliability of slow execution without its time cost.

摘要（中文）：机器人操作数据的采集正从遥操作转向无机器人示范，这一过程通过通用操作接口（UMI）等界面或直接由人类手部完成。基于此类数据训练的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略继承了示范者的时序特征。然而，人类的时序并不能直接迁移至机器人：柔顺的手部能够耐受快速接触，而机器人可能因执行器及跟踪限制而出现超调；反之，机器人可在自由空间中更快运动。这促使我们提出一种统一方法，以协调执行速度与接触安全性。我们提出了RoboPace，一种在线重定时层，它在保持策略几何路径的同时调整其时序，并兼顾目标机器人的运动学与动力学约束。该方法基于预测接触调整执行速度，联合考虑与接触相关的速度限制及机器人运动约束。该方法无需重新训练策略，且能够实时运行。在双臂机器人的三项接触密集任务中，更快的均匀执行及仅基于物理极限的重定时方法大多失效。相比之下，RoboPace在整体成功率上优于慢速均匀执行，同时在大约一半的时间内完成五分之四的指令，既保留了慢速执行的高可靠性，又避免了其时间开销。

Authors: Mimo Shirasaka, Takehiko Ohkawa, Takuya Okubo, Nicola Scianca, Tatsuya Matsushima, Kei Ota

Design optimization of tendon-driven robots considering tendon wrapping and shortcut Manipulation

tendon-driven arms multi-objective optimization NSGA-II tendon routing compact high-torque arms

简要说明：本文提出了一种腱驱动手臂设计的多目标优化方法，通过腱缠绕和捷径效应平衡关节扭矩与手臂厚度，使用NSGA-II算法生成帕累托最优设计。

TLDR: This paper proposes a multi-objective optimization method for tendon-driven arm design, balancing joint torque and arm thickness via tendon wrapping and shortcut effects, solved with NSGA-II to generate Pareto-optimal designs.

Abstract: This study proposes a multi-objective optimization method for tendon-driven arm design, addressing the inherent trade-off between joint torque and arm thickness through tendon wrapping and shortcut effects. We formulate the problem to simultaneously maximize torque and minimize thickness, solved using NSGA-II. The algorithm optimizes tendon routing, pulley configurations, and attachment points. Results reveal Pareto-optimal designs with effective moment arm expansion via strategic shortcuts, providing practical guidelines for compact high-torque arms. The optimized configurations demonstrate non-trivial patterns beyond conventional design intuition, offering new insights for engineering efficient robotic systems.

摘要（中文）：本研究提出了一种针对腱驱动机械臂的多目标优化方法，通过肌腱缠绕与捷径效应解决了关节力矩与机械臂粗细之间的固有矛盾。我们将问题建模为同时最大化力矩并最小化厚度，采用NSGA-II算法进行求解。该算法对肌腱路径、滑轮配置及附着点进行优化。结果表明，帕累托最优设计能够通过策略性捷径实现有效的力臂扩展，为紧凑型高力矩机械臂提供了实用设计指南。优化后的配置呈现出超越传统设计直觉的非平凡模式，为高效机器人系统的工程设计提供了新见解。

Abstract: Teach-and-repeat navigation systems employing advanced visual place recognition techniques for localization exhibit key attributes for long-term mobile robot navigation, such as the ability to operate in unstructured and dynamic environments. However, existing solutions based on deep-learning techniques are computationally demanding, limiting their applicability. This work introduces a novel and efficient teach-and-repeat system built on the modern visual place recognition method MixVPR. Real-world testing demonstrated its ability to operate both indoors and outdoors, achieving robustness and navigation precision comparable to other state-of-the-art systems. In addition, its lower hardware requirements make it suitable for a wide range of robotic platforms and practical applications.

摘要（中文）：采用先进视觉位置识别技术进行定位的“教导-重复”导航系统，在长期移动机器人导航中展现出关键特性，例如能够在非结构化和动态环境中运行。然而，现有基于深度学习技术的解决方案计算需求高，限制了其应用范围。本研究提出了一种基于现代视觉位置识别方法MixVPR的新型高效“教导-重复”系统。实际测试表明，该系统能够在室内外环境中运行，其鲁棒性和导航精度与其他先进系统相当。此外，其较低的硬件需求使其适用于多种机器人平台和实际应用场景。

Authors: Václav Truhlařík, Tomáš Pivoňka, Libor Přeučil

MagCilia: A Compact Magnetociliary Tactile Sensor with 3D Force Sensing for Robotic Contact Perception and Grasping Feedback Manipulation

tactile sensor 3D force sensing magnetociliary grasping feedback surface recognition

简要说明：MagCilia提出了一种基于磁性纤毛和霍尔传感器的紧凑型触觉传感器，实现三维力感知，并通过因果历史融合回归模型支持机器人抓取反馈和表面识别。

TLDR: MagCilia presents a compact tactile sensor using magnetic cilia and a Hall sensor for 3D force sensing, enabling robotic grasping feedback and surface recognition through a causal history fusion regression model.

Abstract: Robotic grasping and surface exploration benefit from simultaneous measurement of normal and tangential forces and from surface information obtained through contact. Here, we present a compact magnetociliary tactile sensor (MagCilia) that combines a flexible magnetic-cilia structure with a Hall sensor for 3D force sensing. Quasi-static finite element analysis is used to investigate structural deformation and magnetic responses under multidirectional loading. To reconstruct forces from the coupled magnetic channels, we propose causal history fusion regression (CHFR), which combines current magnetic-field measurements with their recent changes. Five-fold cross-validation grouped by calibration record yields root-mean-square errors of 0.40, 0.57, and 0.69 N for Fx, Fy, and Fz, respectively, with corresponding coefficients of determination of 0.93, 0.90, and 0.92. Robotic experiments demonstrate tangential-force-guided gripper adjustment and multi-axis load monitoring under external perturbations. Frequency-domain features of the reconstructed forces distinguish six surface categories with 99.39% accuracy in three-fold cross-validation grouped by acquisition session. An online robotic demonstration additionally identifies all six tested surfaces. These results demonstrate 3D force reconstruction, grasping feedback, and surface recognition using a single compact tactile unit.

摘要（中文）：机器人抓取与表面探测受益于法向力和切向力的同步测量，以及通过接触获取的表面信息。本文提出了一种紧凑型磁纤毛触觉传感器（MagCilia），将柔性磁纤毛结构与霍尔传感器相结合，实现三维力传感。采用准静态有限元分析研究多向载荷下的结构变形与磁响应。为从耦合磁通道中重构出力信息，我们提出了因果历史融合回归（CHFR）方法，将当前磁场测量值与其近期变化相结合。按标定记录分组的五折交叉验证结果显示，Fx、Fy和Fz的均方根误差分别为0.40 N、0.57 N和0.69 N，对应的决定系数分别为0.93、0.90和0.92。机器人实验展示了切向力引导的夹爪调整以及外部扰动下的多轴载荷监测。重构力的频域特征在按采集会话分组的三折交叉验证中，对六种表面类别的识别准确率达99.39%。在线机器人演示进一步成功识别了全部六种测试表面。上述结果表明，仅通过单一紧凑型触觉单元即可实现三维力重构、抓取反馈和表面识别。

Authors: Yu Feng, Hao Wu, Haotian Guo, Haoming Liu, William Su, Jingxiang Guo, Jiankun Li, Masayoshi Tomizuka, Wen Jung Li, Jianshu Zhou

SiGNgapore - An Interactive Dataset for Sign-based Visual Navigation VLN

visual navigation dataset sign-based navigation sequential decision-making multimodal sensor data

简要说明：本文介绍了SiGNgapore，一个用于公共空间基于标志视觉导航的基准数据集，包含456个场景、56个长时程导航任务的多模态传感器数据，以支持机器人利用标志线索进行顺序决策。

TLDR: This paper introduces SiGNgapore, a benchmark dataset for sign-based visual navigation in public spaces, containing multimodal sensor data from 456 scenarios across 56 long-horizon navigation missions to support sign-guided sequential decision-making in robots.

Abstract: The future of autonomous robots in human-oriented environments depends on their ability to leverage existing navigational aids embedded in these environments, such as navigational signs, to navigate unfamiliar spaces without prior maps. Yet robots rarely exploit these cues, relying instead on pre-built maps for navigation. To advance sign- based visual navigation, we introduce a unique dataset, SiGNgapore, for benchmarking sign-based decision-making for navigation, collected across diverse public spaces in Singapore commonly encountered in daily life, including hospitals, public transport hubs, and shopping malls. SiGNgapore comprises 456 scenarios, each capturing a navigational sign and its surrounding environment, which collectively underpin 56 long-horizon navigation missions designed to evaluate sequential decision-making. Each scenario includes RGB, depth, IMU, and odometry data collected using a handheld device. We additionally provide venue maps and GPS-aligned scene graphs of the test environments. Beyond benchmarking sign-guided sequential decision-making, SiGNgapore supports research into visual understanding of navigational signs and into navigation approaches that integrate signage cues with prior maps.

摘要（中文）：自主机器人在面向人类的环境中能否发挥作用，取决于其利用环境中已有的导航辅助设施（如导航标识）在无预设地图的情况下导航至陌生空间的能力。然而，机器人很少利用这些线索，而是依赖预先构建的地图进行导航。为推进基于标识的视觉导航研究，我们引入了一个独特的数据集——SiGNgapore，用于对基于标识的导航决策进行基准测试。该数据集在新加坡日常常见的各类公共场所（包括医院、公共交通枢纽和购物中心）中采集而成。SiGNgapore包含456个场景，每个场景均捕捉了一个导航标识及其周围环境，共同支撑起56项旨在评估序列决策的长时程导航任务。每个场景均包含使用手持设备采集的RGB、深度、惯性测量单元（IMU）和里程计数据。此外，我们还提供了测试环境的场地地图以及与GPS对齐的场景图。除了对标识引导的序列决策进行基准测试外，SiGNgapore还支持导航标识的视觉理解研究，以及将标识线索与先验地图相结合的导航方法研究。

Authors: Nicky Zimmerman, Joel Loo, Zishuo Wang, David Hsu

MCFR: A Mask-Guided Coarse-to-Fine Regression Framework for Robust Multi-Variant Board-to-Board Connector Assembly Manipulation

mask-guided regression connector assembly coarse-to-fine photometric refinement industrial robotics

简要说明：MCFR 是一种掩码引导的从粗到细回归框架，旨在提高自动板对板连接器装配中的视觉对准精度和鲁棒性，实现了较高的实际插入成功率。

TLDR: MCFR is a mask-guided coarse-to-fine regression framework designed to improve visual alignment and robustness in automated board-to-board connector assembly, achieving high real-world insertion success rates.

Abstract: Automated insertion of board-to-board (BTB) connectors in 3C manufacturing requires both high visual accuracy and strong deployment robustness. This problem remains challenging because multi-variant connectors exhibit significant morphological and appearance variations, making stable cross-variant generalization difficult, while the mismatch between training and deployment under fixed-view inspection settings induces background spurious correlation and degrades real-world performance. To address these issues, this paper proposes MCFR, a Mask-Guided Coarse-to-Fine Regression framework for multi-variant BTB connector assembly. By introducing an object-aware mask prior and explicit photometric refinement, the proposed method suppresses background interference and improves alignment accuracy and robustness in practical deployment. Experiments on a self-constructed multi-variant dataset, a BTB batch insertion testbed, and a real smartphone assembly task show that MCFR consistently outperforms representative baselines and achieves an average real-world insertion success rate of 99.25%. These results demonstrate the effectiveness and practical potential of MCFR for automated assembly of multi-variant BTB connectors.

摘要（中文）：在3C制造中，板对板（BTB）连接器的自动化插装既需要高视觉精度，又需要强部署鲁棒性。由于多型号连接器在形态与外观上差异显著，实现稳定的跨型号泛化较为困难，同时，固定视角检测设置下训练与部署环境的不匹配会引入背景伪相关，进而降低实际部署性能，因此该问题仍具挑战性。针对上述问题，本文提出MCFR——一种用于多型号BTB连接器装配的掩码引导由粗到精回归框架。通过引入目标感知掩码先验及显式光度精修，该方法有效抑制背景干扰，并提升实际部署中的对准精度与鲁棒性。在自建多型号数据集、BTB批量插装测试平台及真实智能手机装配任务上的实验表明，MCFR持续优于代表性基线方法，并实现了99.25%的平均实际插装成功率。上述结果验证了MCFR在多型号BTB连接器自动化装配中的有效性与实际应用潜力。

Abstract: This paper presents an open-sourced MATLAB simulation and analysis platform dedicated to legged climbing robots. This simulator enables the design of any limbed robotic system as an articulated multi-body with a floating base and simulates it walking and climbing in an arbitrary environment. The main variable environmental parameters are inclination, gravity, and ground stiffness, and any point cloud can be installed as the terrain map. Furthermore, the simulator employs a rigid body dynamics engine. This paper first describes the simulator structure, and the computational flow and next presents the representative simulation examples where quadrupedal robots assumed gripping on the wall or climbing on the steep slope.

摘要（中文）：本文介绍了一个专用于腿式攀爬机器人的开源MATLAB仿真与分析平台。该仿真器能够将任何带肢机器人系统设计为具有浮动底座的多体铰接结构，并模拟其在任意环境中行走和攀爬。主要的环境变量参数包括倾斜度、重力和地面刚度，且任何点云数据均可作为地形图加载。此外，该仿真器采用了刚体动力学引擎。本文首先描述了仿真器的结构及计算流程，随后展示了代表性的仿真案例，其中四足机器人被设定为在墙壁上抓附或在陡坡上攀爬。

Authors: Kentaro Uno, Warley F. R. Ribeiro, Yusuke Koizumi, Keigo Haji, Koki Kurihara, William Jones, Kazuya Yoshida

Adaptive Risk-Certified Event-Triggered Replanning for Dynamic Navigation Other

conformal prediction event-triggered replanning control barrier functions dynamic navigation risk certification

简要说明：CERT-Replan 提出了一种用于动态环境安全导航的保形事件触发重规划框架，利用校准的屏障风险触发模式级重规划，相比仅使用安全过滤器基线减少83.3%的碰撞。

TLDR: CERT-Replan introduces a conformal event-triggered replanning framework for safe navigation in dynamic environments, using calibrated barrier risk to trigger mode-level replanning and reduce collisions by 83.3% over safety-filter-only baselines.

Abstract: Safe navigation in dynamic environments requires robots to plan under obstacle predictions whose errors are uncertain, non-stationary, and can induce rare but safety-critical failures. Existing control-barrier-function safety filters can reject immediately unsafe controls, but they provide little guidance on when the current finite-horizon planning mode itself is becoming unsafe as prediction uncertainty evolves. We propose Conformal Event-Triggered Risk-Certified Replanning (\emph{CERT-Replan}), a framework that uses calibrated barrier risk as an early-warning signal for replanning. CERT-Replan calibrates horizon-indexed obstacle-prediction residuals online and uses the resulting uncertainty radii to evaluate dynamic-obstacle safety margins. A one-step safety filter protects the next applied control, while a horizon-level risk monitor evaluates the upper-tail CVaR of predicted barrier-violation losses along the current MPC rollout. When this risk exceeds an allocated budget, CERT-Replan rejects the current planning mode and selects a lower-risk alternative, such as a different speed profile, corridor, or homotopy class, rather than repeatedly correcting the same nominal plan. In a non-stationary benchmark, CERT-Replan achieves an \(83.3\%\) collision reduction relative to the safety-filter-only baseline \textcolor{black}{and a \(77.8\%\) reduction relative to simple replanning triggers}, while reducing average safety-filter intervention by \(32.4\%\). \textcolor{black}{With Trajectron++, CERT-Replan achieves \(96\%\) collision-free operation. Hardware experiments and onboard runtime profiling demonstrate computational feasibility.}

摘要（中文）：安全导航在动态环境中要求机器人在障碍物预测下进行规划，而这些预测的误差具有不确定性、非平稳性，并可能引发罕见但危及安全的事故。现有的基于控制障碍函数的安全滤波器能够拒绝即时不安全的控制指令，但当预测不确定性演化导致当前有限时域规划模式本身变得不安全时，它们提供的指导十分有限。我们提出了一种共形事件触发风险认证重规划框架（\emph{CERT-Replan}），该框架利用校准后的障碍风险作为重规划的早期预警信号。CERT-Replan在线校准按视界索引的障碍物预测残差，并利用所得的不确定半径评估动态障碍物的安全裕度。一步安全滤波器保护下一个执行的控制指令，而视界级风险监测器则沿当前MPC滚动轨迹评估预测障碍违反损失的上尾条件风险值（CVaR）。当该风险超过分配的预算时，CERT-Replan拒绝当前规划模式，并选择风险较低的替代方案，例如不同的速度剖面、走廊或同伦类别，而非反复修正同一名义规划。在非平稳基准测试中，CERT-Replan相较于仅使用安全滤波器的基线方法实现了\(83.3\%\)的碰撞率降低，相较于简单重规划触发机制实现了\(77.8\%\)的碰撞率降低，同时将平均安全滤波器干预次数减少了\(32.4\%\)。结合Trajectron++，CERT-Replan实现了\(96\%\)的无碰撞运行。硬件实验与机载运行时分析证明了其计算可行性。

Authors: Richie R. Suganda, Bin Hu

Co${}^{2}$Skill: Whole-Body Control via Skill Composition for Long-Horizon Human-Environment Interaction HumanoidEmbodied

whole-body control skill composition loco-manipulation curriculum cross-task curriculum human-environment interaction

简要说明：Co2Skill 通过统一的策略框架，结合任务和阶段相关的观察掩码、目标条件的位置操作课程以及跨任务课程，将全身场景交互和灵巧操作整合起来，实现在人-环境交互中的顺序任务执行和技能组合。

TLDR: Co2Skill integrates whole-body scene interaction and dexterous manipulation into a unified policy using task and phase dependent observation masks, a goal-conditioned loco-manipulation curriculum, and a cross-task curriculum, enabling sequential task execution and skill composition in human-environment interaction.

Abstract: Achieving human-level dexterity in complex, unstructured environments requires the seamless integration of whole-body scene interaction and dexterous object manipulation skills. While existing physics-based controllers generate physically plausible behaviors in each domain, they largely address these two capabilities independently. In this paper, we present Co${}^{2}$Skill that integrates scene interaction and dexterous manipulation through a unified policy formulation. Built on a pretrained motion prior, the policy uses task and phase dependent observation masks to select information relevant to the current interaction goals. We introduce a goal-conditioned loco-manipulation curriculum that combines partial reference guidance for precision with exploration from varied initial states while allowing goal-directed execution beyond the demonstrated trajectories. We further introduce a cross-task curriculum that jointly trains individual skills and selected task sequences, preserving physical states across task boundaries and maintaining grasps during subsequent scene interactions. Together, these support sequential task execution and simultaneous scene interaction with object manipulation. We evaluate sitting, standing, climbing, stair traversal, and goal-directed manipulation, together with sequential execution and with random different conditions. Additionally, we demonstrate skill compositions in indoor environments, illustrating their integration within the same control formulation.

摘要（中文）：实现人类水平灵巧性于复杂非结构化环境中，需无缝整合全身场景交互与灵巧物体操控技能。尽管现有的基于物理的控制器能在各自领域生成物理上合理的行为，但这些控制器大多将两种能力独立处理。本文提出Co${}^{2}$Skill，通过统一策略框架整合场景交互与灵巧操控。基于预训练的运动先验，策略采用任务和阶段相关的观测掩码，筛选与当前交互目标相关的信息。我们引入目标条件化移动-操控课程，结合精确性导向的部分参考引导与多样化初始状态的探索，并支持超出示范轨迹的目标导向执行。进一步引入跨任务课程，联合训练个体技能及选定任务序列，在任务边界处保持物理状态，并在后续场景交互中维持抓取。上述机制共同支持序列任务执行及场景交互与物体操控的同时进行。我们评估了坐、站、攀爬、楼梯穿越和目标导向操控，以及序列执行和随机不同条件下的表现。此外，在室内环境中展示了技能组合，说明其在同一控制框架内的集成。

Authors: Jeonghwan Kim, Hyeonwoo Kim, Hanbyul Joo

LACE-CRAFT: Robot Co-Design with Actor Inheritance and Blackboard Collaboration Locomotion

robot co-design morphology search policy adaptation actor inheritance blackboard collaboration

简要说明：LACE-CRAFT 提出一种机器人协同设计框架，通过演员继承和黑板协作重用控制经验，在多个运动基准上优于 D2C，并展示了真实原型。

TLDR: LACE-CRAFT introduces a robot co-design framework that reuses control experience via actor inheritance and blackboard-based collaboration, achieving higher locomotion scores than D2C and demonstrating a real prototype.

Abstract: Robot co-design couples morphology search with policy learning, yet training every new design from scratch discards acquired control experience. We present LACE-CRAFT, which compares continued learning on the current robot with policy adaptation to new morphology-reward pairs. LACE resumes the incumbent's full learning state and initializes compatible challengers with its actor parameters and observation statistics. A fixed task metric selects among both branches and the frozen incumbent. CRAFT coordinates Feedback, Morphology, Reward, and Integration roles through shared experimental records and behavioral replays to generate and cross-review paired proposals. A generative extension converts generated meshes into editable articulated models with configured joints, actuator interfaces, and consistently updated simulation assets. Across five locomotion benchmarks, mean scores over three evaluation seeds are 6.4-91.9% higher than D2C. Both methods train 30 new morphology-reward pairs over five rounds; LACE additionally uses four continuation training units. Five-task ablations examine policy inheritance and replay-derived feedback. A fabricated prototype demonstrates indoor walking and illustrates the geometry-to-hardware workflow.

摘要（中文）：机器人协同设计将形态搜索与策略学习相结合，然而从头训练每一种新设计会丢弃已获得的控制经验。我们提出了LACE-CRAFT，该方法将当前机器人的持续学习与针对新形态-奖励对的策略适应进行了比较。LACE恢复现有模型的完整学习状态，并使用其演员参数和观测统计信息初始化具有竞争力的挑战者。一个固定的任务指标在两条分支和冻结的现有模型之间进行选择。CRAFT通过共享实验记录和行为重放，协调反馈、形态、奖励和集成四种角色，以生成并交叉审查成对提案。一种生成式扩展将生成的网格转换为可编辑的关节化模型，并配置关节、执行器接口以及持续更新的仿真资源。在五个运动基准测试中，三个评估种子的平均得分比D2C高出6.4%至91.9%。两种方法均在五轮中训练了30对新的形态-奖励对；LACE额外使用了四个持续训练单元。五个任务的消融实验检验了策略继承和重放驱动的反馈。一个制作的样机展示了室内行走，并演示了从几何到硬件的完整工作流程。

Authors: Yuhan Wen, Jiawei Wang, Qixuan Zhang, Calvin Zhang, Yusen Qin, Lan Xu

An Informational Curse of Horizon in Goal-Conditioned Policy Learning RLRobot

goal-conditioned policy learning goal relabeling horizon behavioral cloning reinforcement learning input Jacobians

简要说明：本文揭示了目标条件策略学习中的信息性地平线诅咒：较长的重标记地平线通过降低动作与目标之间的互信息而损害策略泛化，并提出将短地平线策略的雅可比矩阵蒸馏到长地平线策略中以缓解此问题。

TLDR: This paper identifies an informational curse of horizon in goal-conditioned policy learning, where longer relabeling horizons degrade policy generalization due to reduced mutual information between actions and goals, and proposes Jacobian distillation from short-horizon to long-horizon policies to mitigate this.

Abstract: The difficulty of learning goal-reaching policies is often attributed to a "curse of horizon" that manifests as bias accumulation in temporal-difference backups and noisy advantage estimates. In this work, we identify an additional informational curse of horizon in goal-conditioned policy learning, where increasing the goal relabeling horizon can significantly reduce policy generalization and performance. Through a series of controlled experiments with oracle planners, we decouple the goal horizons sampled during training from those that the policy is asked to reach at test time. Even when evaluated only on a sequence of nearby subgoals, goal-conditioned behavioral cloning (BC) policies suffer from severe, training horizon-dependent performance degradation that is mitigated by reinforcement learning (RL) objectives. We explain this phenomenon as a horizon-dependent decrease in the conditional mutual information between actions and hindsight-relabeled goals, and find empirically that both BC and RL policies trained on longer-horizon goals exhibit a shift in sensitivity from goal to state information, as measured by the policy's input Jacobians. Motivated by this observation, we find that distilling the input Jacobians of short-horizon policies into long-horizon policies yields significant performance gains, especially in combinatorial manipulation tasks. Taken together, our results highlight goal relabeling horizon as an important consideration when learning generalist policies from offline data.

摘要（中文）：学习目标达成策略的困难通常被归因于“视野诅咒”，其表现为时间差备份中的偏差累积以及噪声优势估计。在本研究中，我们识别出目标条件策略学习中存在另一种信息层面的视野诅咒，即增加目标重标注视野会显著降低策略的泛化能力和性能。通过一系列使用预言式规划器的受控实验，我们将训练期间采样的目标视野与测试时策略需要达成的目标视野进行解耦。即使在仅评估一系列邻近子目标的情况下，目标条件行为克隆策略也会遭受严重的、依赖于训练视野的性能退化，而这种退化可通过强化学习目标得到缓解。我们将这一现象解释为动作与事后重标注目标之间条件互信息随视野增加而减少，并在经验上发现，基于较长视野目标训练的BC和RL策略，其灵敏度从目标信息向状态信息转移，这一变化可通过策略输入雅可比矩阵进行度量。基于这一观察，我们发现将短视野策略的输入雅可比矩阵蒸馏至长视野策略中可带来显著的性能提升，尤其在组合操作任务中表现突出。综合来看，我们的研究结果强调了目标重标注视野是从离线数据学习通用型策略时的重要考量因素。

Authors: John L. Zhou, Yuxuan Dong, Jonathan C. Kao

Fast Planning for Multi-object Multi-target Throwing Manipulation

multi-object throwing motion planning anthropomorphic hand feasible set fast re-planning

简要说明：本文提出了一种多目标多目标投掷（MOMT）的两阶段规划框架，使用7自由度机械臂和多指手，在5毫秒内实现协调投掷，仿真中执行时间减少高达46%，实际实验中减少29%。

TLDR: This paper presents a two-stage planning framework for multi-object multi-target throwing (MOMT) using a 7-DoF manipulator with a multi-fingered hand, achieving coordinated throws in under 5 ms and reducing execution time by up to 46% in simulation and 29% in real-world tests.

Abstract: Robot throwing has emerged as a promising technique for improving efficiency in logistics and warehouse automation, by enlarging the workspace and speeding up the process. To significantly increase the throwing system's throughput, we develop strategies for throwing multiple objects in one swipe. Such multi-object multi-target throwing (MOMT) leverages the large degrees of freedom of anthropomorphic hands. The key is to quickly generate fast and feasible throwing motions, which involves a complex trade-off between short trajectory duration and short planning time. We solve this problem in two stages. Offline, we build a model of the feasible set by combining object's inverted flying dynamics and the robot's kinematics and dynamics. Online, we generate feasible throws through fast solution matching and filtering of object's valid detach state and robot's feasible state that can compose sequences of throws in less than 5 ms. We validate the framework on a 7-DoF manipulator equipped with a multi-fingered hand. In simulation, coordinated two-object throwing reduces execution time by up to 46% compared to independent single-object planning, and this improvement is maintained when scaling to three objects. Real-world experiments with two objects confirm a 29% reduction; the remaining gap to the theoretical 50% is attributed to inter-throw transition overhead. When target positions are randomly changed mid-execution, the system re-plans and successfully reaches the new targets within 100 ms latency without stopping the robot. These results establish the first unified planning framework for MOMT throwing -- demonstrating scalability to multiple objects in simulation and real-world feasibility on two-object tasks -- advancing the frontier of high-throughput robotic manipulation. A video summarizing the method and the hardware experiments is available at https://liuyangdh.github.io/momt-video

摘要（中文）：机器人投掷作为一种提升物流与仓储自动化效率的新兴技术，通过扩大工作空间和加快流程来发挥作用。为显著提高投掷系统的吞吐量，我们开发了一次投掷中抛掷多个物体的策略。这种多物体多目标投掷（MOMT）利用了拟人手的自由度优势。关键在于快速生成快速且可行的投掷运动，这涉及短轨迹持续时间与短规划时间之间的复杂权衡。我们分两个阶段解决这一问题。离线阶段，我们结合物体的倒飞动力学与机器人的运动学和动力学，构建可行集合模型。在线阶段，我们通过快速解匹配与滤波，在不到5毫秒内生成可行投掷，筛选出物体的有效脱离状态和机器人的可行状态，从而组合成连续投掷序列。我们在配备多指手的七自由度机械臂上验证了该框架。仿真中，与独立单物体规划相比，协调双物体投掷将执行时间缩短了高达46%，且在三物体扩展时仍保持这一改进。真实世界双物体实验确认了29%的缩减；与理论50%的差距归因于投掷间的过渡开销。当执行过程中目标位置随机变化时，系统能在不停机的情况下于100毫秒延迟内重新规划并成功到达新目标。这些成果建立了首个面向MOMT投掷的统一规划框架——在仿真中展示了多物体的可扩展性，并在双物体任务中验证了实际可行性——推动了高吞吐量机器人操作的前沿。总结方法与硬件实验的视频可在 https://liuyangdh.github.io/momt-video 观看。

Authors: Zhengming Zhu, Yang Liu, Xiao Gao, Aude Billard

StableGrasp: Reconstructing Physically Stable Human Hand Grasps from Single Images Manipulation

differentiable simulation grasp stability hand pose reconstruction control optimization single RGB image

简要说明：StableGrasp 利用可微分仿真，从单张 RGB 图像联合优化手部几何和控制目标，在保持视觉一致性的同时生成物理上稳定的人手抓取。

TLDR: StableGrasp uses differentiable simulation to jointly optimize hand geometry and control targets from a single RGB image, producing physically stable human hand grasps while maintaining visual consistency.

Abstract: Reconstructing a physically stable human grasp from a single RGB image is challenging because physically modeling grasps is itself difficult, and the problem requires estimating not only a visually constrained hand pose but also a control target that stabilizes the grasp. Existing methods either model only visual hand geometry without considering physics, or rely on less plausible physical modeling, which limits the physical validity of the resulting grasps. In this paper, we present StableGrasp, a differentiable simulation-based optimization framework that explicitly separates the visual hand pose from the control target that determines the grasping forces. Our method jointly optimizes hand geometry and control by minimizing the kinetic energy of the grasp in a differentiable simulator, while regularizing the hand geometry to preserve visual consistency and geometric plausibility. The reconstructed grasps are substantially more stable under rigorous physical simulation, while remaining visually consistent with the input images and geometrically plausible. Experiments show that our approach produces far more stable grasps than alternative hand-control strategies, benefiting visual-only grasp reconstruction pipelines by turning their outputs into physically stable grasps.

摘要（中文）：从单张RGB图像重建物理稳定的人手抓取动作具有挑战性，因为抓取的物理建模本身就十分困难，且该问题不仅需要估计受视觉约束的手部姿态，还需要确定能够稳定抓取的控制目标。现有方法要么仅建模视觉手部几何而不考虑物理因素，要么依赖不够合理的物理建模，这限制了所得抓取结果的物理有效性。本文提出StableGrasp，一种基于可微分仿真的优化框架，明确地将视觉手部姿态与决定抓取力的控制目标相分离。该方法通过在可微分仿真器中最小化抓取的动能，联合优化手部几何与控制目标，同时对正则化手部几何以保持视觉一致性和几何合理性。在严格的物理仿真下，重建的抓取动作显著更加稳定，同时与输入图像保持视觉一致并具备几何合理性。实验表明，我们的方法比替代性手部控制策略产生远更稳定的抓取，能够将纯视觉抓取重建管线的输出转化为物理稳定的抓取，从而使其受益。

Authors: Han Jiang, Etienne Vouga, Qixing Huang, Georgios Pavlakos

GUARD: Geometric Uncertainty-Aware Point Cloud Denoising and Segmentation for Robotic Hard Disk Drive Disassembly Manipulation

geometric uncertainty point cloud denoising segmentation robotic disassembly Gaussian Process

简要说明：GUARD 提出了一种几何不确定性感知框架，在硬盘点云上联合进行点滤波和部件级分割，通过建模逐点几何可靠性来抑制伪影并提升分割精度，以支持机器人拆解。

TLDR: GUARD proposes a geometric uncertainty-aware framework that jointly performs point filtering and part-level segmentation on HDD point clouds, modeling per-point geometric reliability to suppress artifacts while improving segmentation accuracy for robotic disassembly.

Abstract: Reliable robotic disassembly requires part-level representations that distinguish genuine component geometry from scanning and reconstruction artifacts. In point clouds of hard disk drives (HDDs), structured ghost artifacts can resemble valid components locally while remaining inconsistent with the overall geometry, allowing erroneous measurements to receive plausible semantic labels. This creates an engineering information problem: semantic prediction confidence alone does not establish whether the underlying geometry is reliable. We propose \textbf{GUARD}, a geometric uncertainty-aware framework that performs point filtering and segmentation within a single forward pass by modeling the reliability of learned geometric representations. GUARD combines a multi-scale geometric transformer with a multi-bandwidth random Fourier feature Gaussian Process to estimate per-point geometric uncertainty, complemented by predictive entropy to suppress unreliable measurements while preserving informative structures. Evaluation on 2,745 real HDD point clouds shows that GUARD improves PointNet++ segmentation mean intersection over union from 0.7739 to 0.8318. Additional experiments on ShapeNetPart and ScanNet examine robustness across corruption types, point-cloud domains, and segmentation backbones. On manually annotated ScanNet samples, geometric uncertainty achieves a corrupted-point detection F1 score of 0.7931, compared with 0.2212 for predictive entropy. The results demonstrate the value of distinguishing geometric reliability from semantic confidence and reveal a tradeoff between artifact suppression and preservation of informative structures. GUARD contributes a reliability-aware approach to interpreting imperfect 3D measurements for component identification and subsequent robotic handling. Project website: https://001-wang.github.io/GUARD_Point_denoiser/.

摘要（中文）：可靠的机器人拆卸需要部件级别的表示，以区分真实组件几何与扫描及重建伪影。在硬盘驱动器（HDD）的点云中，结构化鬼影伪影在局部可能类似于有效部件，但整体几何上却存在不一致，从而使错误测量获得看似合理的语义标签。这构成了一个工程信息问题：仅凭语义预测置信度无法确定底层几何是否可靠。我们提出\textbf{GUARD}，一种几何不确定性感知框架，通过对学习到的几何表示的可信度进行建模，在单次前向传播中同时实现点过滤和分割。GUARD将多尺度几何变压器与多带宽随机傅里叶特征高斯过程相结合，以估计逐点几何不确定性，并辅以预测熵来抑制不可靠测量，同时保留信息丰富的结构。在2,745个真实HDD点云上的评估表明，GUARD将PointNet++分割的平均交并比从0.7739提升至0.8318。在ShapeNetPart和ScanNet上的进一步实验考察了其在损坏类型、点云领域和分割骨干网络上的鲁棒性。在手动标注的ScanNet样本上，几何不确定性实现了0.7931的损坏点检测F1分数，而预测熵仅为0.2212。结果证明了区分几何可靠性与语义置信度的价值，并揭示了伪影抑制与信息丰富结构保留之间的权衡。GUARD为不完美3D测量的解释提供了一种可靠性感知的方法，用于部件识别及后续的机器人操作。项目网站：https://001-wang.github.io/GUARD_Point_denoiser/。

Authors: Zuoxu Wang, Xiao Liang

MimicX: Policy-in-the-Loop Supervision Refinement for Video-Driven Humanoid Motion Tracking HumanoidEmbodied

policy-in-the-loop motion tracking humanoid learning reset curriculum retargeted motion

简要说明：MimicX利用策略执行反馈迭代优化视频驱动的人形运动跟踪的监督信号，提升跟踪精度和执行鲁棒性。

TLDR: MimicX uses policy execution feedback to iteratively refine supervision for video-driven humanoid motion tracking, improving tracking accuracy and execution robustness.

Abstract: Human videos provide rich motion targets for humanoid learning, yet visually plausible references can still produce persistent failures under physics-based execution. These failures reveal where training supervision should change. We present MimicX, a policy-in-the-loop framework that uses execution feedback to refine video-driven humanoid motion tracking. Starting from reconstructed and retargeted motion, MimicX localizes difficult transitions and affected body regions, then jointly adapts tracking objectives and the reset curriculum for policy continuation. Repeated rollout verification selects execution-priority improvements subject to tracking guards. Across four core video tasks, MimicX consistently improves tracking accuracy and Robust Execution Horizon relative to the Fixed Reference baseline. Task-averaged results show a 25.7% reduction in body-tracking error and a 255.6% increase in execution horizon. Additional video, motion-reference, and collision-scene studies evaluate the method beyond the core tasks, while MimicX-HLoop accelerates feedback through heterogeneous execution. Overall, MimicX turns policy failure into actionable supervision for deciding what to refine and which refinement to retain.

摘要（中文）：人类视频为类人机器人学习提供了丰富的运动目标，然而视觉上合理的参考轨迹在基于物理的执行过程中仍可能产生持续失败。这些失败揭示了训练监督需要调整之处。我们提出了MimicX，一种策略在环框架，利用执行反馈来优化视频驱动的类人运动跟踪。从重建并重定向的运动出发，MimicX定位困难转换及受影响的躯体区域，然后联合调整跟踪目标与重置课程以支持策略延续。重复的滚动验证在跟踪守护约束下选择执行优先的改进项。在四个核心视频任务中，MimicX相较于固定参考基线持续提升了跟踪精度与稳健执行时域。任务平均结果显示，躯体跟踪误差降低25.7%，执行时域提升255.6%。额外的视频、运动参考及碰撞场景研究在核心任务之外评估了该方法，而MimicX-HLoop通过异构执行加速反馈循环。总体而言，MimicX将策略失败转化为可操作的监督信号，用于决策改进内容以及保留哪些改进成果。

Authors: Shuaijun Liu, Chenglong Zhang, Xuhao Liu, Feiyang You, Yifan Liao, Shuyang Hao, Chaozhe Zhang, Chengyu Wu, Zhen Sun, Ningxin Su

Speaking the Navigator's Language: Trajectory-Grounded Instruction Translation for Frozen Aerial VLN Agents VLN

Vision-and-Language Navigation Instruction Translation Frozen Navigator Trajectory Grounding Zero-shot Transfer

简要说明：本文提出了TGIT，一种轨迹引导的指令翻译器，将用户的简短意图指令转换为冻结的空中VLN智能体可执行的指令，显著提高了成功率并零样本迁移到真实人类指令。

TLDR: This paper introduces TGIT, a trajectory-grounded instruction translator that converts short, intent-driven user commands into agent-executable instructions for frozen aerial VLN agents, significantly improving success rates and transferring zero-shot to real human instructions.

Abstract: Aerial vision-and-language navigation (VLN) agents are typically trained on detail-rich, trajectory-aligned commands, whereas users issue short, intent-driven instructions; on a frozen OpenFly navigator, this \emph{instruction gap} drops success rate (SR) from $31.03\%$ to $11.33\%$. To scale translator training, we prompt a language model with human-written style examples to convert original commands into paired, intent-centered Weak commands, which yield $15.27\%$ SR. We introduce the \textbf{Trajectory-Grounded Instruction Translator (TGIT)}, a front-end that keeps the navigator frozen and translates Weak inputs into agent-executable commands by learning from its trajectory outcomes. The resulting Weak-trained translator raises Weak-input SR to $37.93\%$ and transfers zero-shot to real human instructions ($11.33\%{\rightarrow}32.51\%$); it also improves held-out OpenFly ($4.95\%{\rightarrow}20.79\%$) and yields recovery on CityNav and AirVLN.

摘要（中文）：航空视觉-语言导航（VLN）智能体通常基于细节丰富、与轨迹对齐的指令进行训练，而用户实际提出的是简短、意图驱动的指令；在冻结的OpenFly导航器上，这一“指令鸿沟”使得成功率（SR）从$31.03\%$降至$11.33\%$。为扩展翻译器的训练规模，我们利用语言模型，以人工撰写的风格示例为提示，将原始指令转换为配对的、以意图为中心的弱指令，这些弱指令实现了$15.27\%$的成功率。我们引入了\textbf{轨迹接地指令翻译器（TGIT）}——一种前端模块，在保持导航器冻结的同时，通过从导航器的轨迹结果中学习，将弱输入翻译为智能体可执行的指令。由此训练的弱指令翻译器将弱输入的成功率提升至$37.93\%$，并可零样本迁移至真实人工指令（$11.33\%{\rightarrow}32.51\%$）；此外，它还提升了保留数据集OpenFly上的表现（$4.95\%{\rightarrow}20.79\%$），并在CityNav和AirVLN上实现了恢复性改进。

Authors: Xi Chen, Zhe Liu, Xiaogang Xu, Jiafei Xu, Chunyi Zhou, Yuan Su, Rui Zeng, Tianyu Du, Kelu Yao, Chao Li, Shouling Ji

SearchWorld: Spatial Value-Grounded Imagination for UAV Object Search via World Models WorldModel

world model UAV object search spatial value imagination BEV memory

简要说明：SearchWorld 提出了一种带有显式空间记忆和价值引导想象力的循环状态空间世界模型，用于城市环境中的无人机目标搜索，提高了成功率和鲁棒性。

TLDR: SearchWorld introduces a recurrent state-space world model with explicit spatial memory and value-guided imagination for UAV object search in urban environments, improving success rates and robustness over prior methods.

Abstract: Autonomous unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) object search involves a closed loop of perception, decision-making, and action under partial observability. Urban environments pose several challenges: large search areas and narrow egocentric views limit coverage, dense 3D geometry constrains safe motion, and open-world instructions require identifying a specific target among distractors. Many existing methods mitigate partial observability through explicit maps or memory representations, yet remain largely reactive, reasoning over past observations without explicitly predicting future states. World models enable prospective reasoning through imagined rollouts. However, image-generating world models can incur high inference latency, while spatially grounded planning remains challenging for latent world models. We propose SearchWorld, a recurrent state-space world model that connects explicit spatial memory with value-guided imagination. The model maintains BEV exploration and obstacle memory and decodes a task-aware spatial value layer to guide search. A cognition-action network uses this learned spatial value prior to improve the policy through imagined rollouts, without training a separate scalar critic. Training progresses from world-model learning to expert imitation and imagination-based exploration refinement. On UAV-ON, SearchWorld improves the success rate to 23.8% (19.5% for the strongest published agent) and raises oracle success to 35.5%, while remaining robust on unseen scenes (19.9% success rate). By grounding imagination in explicit spatial representations, SearchWorld enables UAV agents to plan prospectively rather than react.

摘要（中文）：自主无人机（UAV）目标搜索涉及在部分可观测条件下感知、决策与行动之间的闭环过程。城市环境带来多重挑战：大范围搜索区域与狭窄的第一人称视野限制了覆盖能力，密集的三维几何结构约束了安全运动，而开放世界指令要求在干扰物中识别特定目标。现有方法多通过显式地图或记忆表征缓解部分可观测性问题，但本质上仍属反应式推理，仅基于历史观测进行判断，未显式预测未来状态。世界模型通过想象推演实现前瞻性推理。然而，图像生成类世界模型推理延迟较高，而潜在空间世界模型在空间接地规划方面仍面临困难。本文提出SearchWorld，一种循环状态空间世界模型，将显式空间记忆与价值引导的想象相结合。该模型维护鸟瞰图（BEV）探索与障碍物记忆，并解码任务感知的空间价值层以引导搜索。认知-行动网络利用学习到的空间价值先验，通过想象推演改进策略，无需训练独立的标量评论网络。训练流程依次涵盖世界模型学习、专家模仿及基于想象的探索精化。在UAV-ON基准上，SearchWorld将成功率提升至23.8%（此前最强已发表智能体为19.5%），并将oracle成功率提高至35.5%，同时在未见场景中保持稳健表现（成功率为19.9%）。通过将想象锚定于显式空间表征，SearchWorld使无人机智能体能够进行前瞻性规划，而非被动反应。

Authors: Yatai Ji, Zhengqiu Zhu, Yong Zhao, Yue Hu, Fanglong Yao, Chen Gao, Pengfei Zhu, Quanjun Yin

RT-Safe: Benchmarking Agent Safety in Real-Time Embodied Environment VLN

embodied safety real-time constraints urban navigation VLM agents offline RL

简要说明：RT-Safe 提出了一个在实时约束下评估具身代理安全性的模拟城市基准，表明决策延迟显著增加碰撞，而离线RL可以减少碰撞。

TLDR: RT-Safe introduces a simulated urban benchmark for evaluating embodied agent safety under real-time constraints, showing that decision latency significantly increases collisions and that offline RL can reduce them.

Abstract: Rapid progress in AI agents has brought growing attention to agent safety, with extensive evaluation focused on digital environments. As agents move into the physical world, embodied safety becomes increasingly important: failures can cause human injury and costly hardware damage. Beyond selecting safe actions, embodied agents must also operate under real-time constraints: the physical world does not pause while an agent reasons. As pedestrians move and vehicles approach during inference, an action that appears safe at observation time may become unsafe before execution. Real-time embodied safety therefore depends on both decision quality and decision latency. We introduce RT-SAFE, a simulated urban benchmark for evaluating embodied-agent safety under real-time constraints. RT-SAFE combines navigation tasks with moving actors, environmental hazards, and traffic rules, while allowing the world to evolve throughout inference and action execution. Across eight VLMs, agents achieve high task completion yet almost never complete safely: in the hardest setting, only 0.7% of episodes finish without a safety event. More strikingly, matched static and real-time evaluations yield task completion rates of 91.3% and 94.1%, respectively, while real-time execution increases collisions by $12.3\times$. These results reveal that standard task success can mask substantial safety failures, and that decision latency itself can become a source of physical risk. Finally, we show that RT-SAFE can support offline RL training and substantially reduce collision rates while achieving strong task completion.

摘要（中文）：摘要：人工智能智能体的快速发展使智能体安全性受到越来越多的关注，相关评估工作主要集中于数字环境。随着智能体进入物理世界，具身安全性变得愈发重要：其失效可能导致人身伤害和高昂的硬件损失。除选择安全动作外，具身智能体还必须在实时约束条件下运行：物理世界不会在智能体推理期间暂停。当推理过程中行人移动、车辆接近时，某一在观测时刻看似安全的动作可能在执行前就已变得不安全。因此，实时具身安全同时取决于决策质量和决策延迟。我们提出了RT-SAFE，一个用于在实时约束下评估具身智能体安全性的模拟城市场景基准。RT-SAFE将导航任务与移动行人、环境危险和交通规则相结合，并允许世界在推理和动作执行过程中持续演化。在八种视觉语言模型（VLM）中，智能体实现了较高的任务完成率，但几乎无法在安全条件下完成任务：在最困难的设置下，仅有0.7%的场景在无安全事件的情况下完成。更引人注目的是，在匹配的静态与实时评估中，任务完成率分别达到91.3%和94.1%，而实时执行使碰撞次数增加了12.3倍。这些结果表明，标准任务成功可能掩盖大量安全失效，且决策延迟本身可能成为物理风险来源。最后，我们展示RT-SAFE能够支持离线强化学习训练，在显著降低碰撞率的同时保持较高的任务完成率。

Authors: Tianruo Rose Xu, Jiawei Ren, Yichi Yang, Zhaoxu Zheng, Lianhui Qin

A Probabilistic Perspective on Wasserstein-Based Evidential Uncertainty for Out-of-Distribution Segmentation AutonomousDriving

Evidential Deep Learning Out-of-Distribution Segmentation Wasserstein Distance Autonomous Driving Epistemic Uncertainty

简要说明：本文研究了基于Wasserstein距离的神经确定性深度学习在语义分割中的分布外（OOD）检测问题，特别针对自动驾驶等安全关键场景。结果表明，在卷积和Transformer架构上，高阶Wasserstein目标函数通过单次确定性前向传播提升了OOD检测性能，在SegmentMeIfYouCan基准上超越了可比基线。

TLDR: This paper investigates Wasserstein-based evidential deep learning for out-of-distribution (OOD) segmentation, specifically targeting safety-critical autonomous driving scenarios. It shows that higher-order Wasserstein objectives improve OOD detection on convolutional and transformer architectures using a single deterministic forward pass, outperforming comparable baselines on the SegmentMeIfYouCan benchmark.

Abstract: Semantic segmentation networks operate on a fixed set of classes and therefore fail when out-of-distribution (OOD) objects appear during deployment, a critical limitation for safety-critical applications such as autonomous driving. Reliably identifying OOD objects requires well-calibrated epistemic uncertainty, yet common softmax-based confidence scores remain overconfident, while Bayesian alternatives such as Monte Carlo dropout or deep ensembles require costly repeated forward passes. Evidential Deep Learning (EDL) offers an efficient alternative by modeling class probabilities as a Dirichlet distribution learned from a single deterministic forward pass. Existing EDL formulations rely on Euclidean objectives that push predictions towards the simplex vertices, encouraging overconfidence rather than preserving uncertainty for unfamiliar inputs. We instead employ Wasserstein-based objectives, which respect the geometry of the probability simplex, and study the influence of the Wasserstein order on segmentation accuracy and OOD detection within a unified evidential framework. We evaluate this framework on a convolutional (DeepLabV3+) and a transformer-based (SegFormer) architecture on the SegmentMeIfYouCan benchmark, including LostAndFound, RoadObstacle21, RoadAnomaly21, and Fishyscapes. Our results show the optimal Wasserstein order is architecture-dependent: second-order objectives dominate on the convolutional backbone, third-order objectives on the transformer backbone, and our framework surpasses comparable baselines on most metrics, with a single deterministic forward pass.

摘要（中文）：语义分割网络在固定的类别集合上运行，因此在部署期间出现分布外（OOD）对象时会失效，这是自动驾驶等安全关键应用中的一个关键限制。可靠识别OOD对象需要校准良好的认知不确定性，然而常见的基于Softmax的置信度得分仍然过于自信，而贝叶斯替代方法如蒙特卡洛Dropout或深度集成则需要成本高昂的重复前向传播。证据深度学习（EDL）通过将类别概率建模为从单次确定性前向传播中学习到的Dirichlet分布，提供了一种高效的替代方案。现有的EDL公式依赖于欧几里得目标函数，将预测推向单纯形的顶点，从而鼓励过度自信，而非为陌生输入保留不确定性。我们转而采用基于Wasserstein的目标函数，该函数尊重概率单纯形的几何结构，并在统一的证据框架内研究Wasserstein阶数对分割精度和OOD检测的影响。我们在SegmentMeIfYouCan基准测试上，对卷积架构（DeepLabV3+）和基于Transformer的架构（SegFormer）评估该框架，测试集包括LostAndFound、RoadObstacle21、RoadAnomaly21和Fishyscapes。结果表明，最优的Wasserstein阶数依赖于架构：二阶目标在卷积骨干网络上占优，三阶目标在Transformer骨干网络上占优，并且我们的框架在大多数指标上超越了可比基线，且仅需单次确定性前向传播。
